jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Who You Are**



You are a highly organized, detail\-oriented project professional who enjoys bringing structure, clarity, and follow\-through to complex work. You are comfortable coordinating multiple priorities, maintaining accurate project information, communicating with a variety of stakeholders, and identifying issues before they become larger problems. You take ownership of your commitments, learn quickly, and bring a collaborative, client\-focused mindset to every interaction.


**About The Role**



As a Project Coordinator within the Project Management Office (PMO), you will support Project Managers and Program Managers in the planning, coordination, tracking, and successful delivery of client\-facing technology projects. You will help maintain accurate project schedules, documentation, action items, risks, dependencies, financial information, and status reporting so project teams and stakeholders have timely visibility into progress and emerging concerns. This role is well suited for someone who can balance detail\-oriented administrative execution with proactive communication, sound judgment, and a desire to grow within project management.


**Must be based in the United States of America.** The role may support multiple projects, clients, and internal teams simultaneously and may occasionally coordinate with stakeholders across different time zones.


**Other responsibilities include:**


* Support Project Managers and Program Managers with project planning, coordination, tracking, and follow\-through from initiation through closeout.
* Maintain accurate project schedules, milestones, deliverables, action items, decision logs, risk registers, dependency trackers, and other project controls.
* Coordinate project meetings, prepare agendas and materials, capture notes and decisions, distribute follow\-up actions, and monitor completion.
* Prepare recurring project status updates, dashboards, and health reports using current and validated project information.
* Track project progress against scope, schedule, budget, resource plans, and key client commitments; escalate variances and emerging risks promptly.
* Coordinate information and handoffs among Project Management, Program Management, Solutions Architecture, Engineering, Logistics, Finance, vendors, subcontractors, and client stakeholders.
* Support project financial administration, including purchase\-order and invoice status, time and expense tracking, budget updates, cost documentation, and forecast inputs as assigned.
* Maintain organized, complete, and audit\-ready project records in Smartsheet, NetSuite, Microsoft 365, and other approved systems; ensure Smartsheet project data, schedules, dashboards, and reports remain current and accurate.
* Assist with resource coordination, onboarding activities, site or field\-readiness documentation, logistics tracking, and project communications as needed.
* Proactively identify missing information, schedule conflicts, unresolved decisions, and delivery risks; research issues and coordinate resolution with the appropriate owners.
* Support project closeout by confirming deliverables, documentation, financial information, lessons learned, and handoff requirements are complete.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of PMO templates, reporting standards, workflows, and project coordination practices.


**Desired skills and experience:**


* Two to four years of experience in project coordination, project administration, operations support, or a related field; equivalent professional experience will be considered.
* Experience supporting multiple projects, workstreams, customers, or stakeholders while managing competing priorities and deadlines.
* Working knowledge of project management fundamentals, including schedules, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks, issues, and status reporting.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills with exceptional attention to detail and consistent follow\-through.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate professionally with clients, vendors, subcontractors, and internal teams.
* Ability to collect, validate, organize, and summarize project information for project teams and leadership.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Microsoft 365 tools; comfort working with spreadsheets, trackers, shared documents, and presentation materials.
* Experience using Smartsheet is strongly preferred, including maintaining project sheets, updating dashboards and reports, and working with automated workflows or cross\-sheet data. Smartsheet experience is not required, but practical experience will be considered a significant advantage.
* Ability to identify gaps, ask effective questions, investigate unresolved items, and escalate concerns with appropriate context and urgency.
* Demonstrated ability to build trust, collaborate across functions, and maintain a client\-focused, service\-oriented approach.
* Self\-motivated and dependable, with the ability to work independently in a fully remote environment while staying connected to the broader team.
* A proactive, preventive mindset and eagerness to learn, grow, and take on increasing responsibility within project management.


**A Little About Us**



Our mission is to challenge and enable our employees to achieve great things.


**We live and breathe our core values:**


* **We Before Me:** We demonstrate empathy through our actions and solicit diverse voices and opinions. We put ourselves in each other's shoes, readily admit our mistakes, and generously share our time and knowledge.
* **Dare To Be Great:** We are big\-picture thinkers who focus on solutions to problems. We solicit and offer actionable feedback to others without hesitation. We embrace opportunities to improve ourselves, our teams, and our work. We aim to be the best of the best.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Sawhorse Productions is a Los Angeles based, Award winning full\-service creative studio turning ideas into unforgettable experiences through captivating branded content, viral social moments, and groundbreaking interactive experiences. We partner with industry\-leading brands, artists, and studios such as Walmart, Google, NBCUniversal, Fanatics, Toyota, Pepsi and Alo to deliver industry leading, innovative multi\-platform content. At Sawhorse, we believe in fostering a culture of collaboration, creativity, and relentless excellence while shaping the future of digital storytelling.


Our projects include:

* Branded content
* Social/Digital Content
* Broadcast commercials
* UGC Gaming platform experiences
* Interactive/Web3 activations (AR, VR, MR, AI)


We are seeking a highly organized, detail\-oriented Project Coordinator to provide administrative support to our Head of Production and Assistant Head of Production. This is a great opportunity for someone continuing to build experience in the film and production industry, and who thrives in a fast\-paced environment juggling multiple priorities under tight deadlines.

 **This role starts as a part\-time hourly position at 30 to 40 hours per week, with the potential to transition to a full\-time role based on fit and business need.**

**Our office is located in Studio City, Los Angeles. This is a primarily in\-office role, with occasional remote flexibility. General working hours are 9:30 AM to 6:00 PM PST with a 30\-minute break.**

 **Requirements**  

* Administrative Support: Manage day\-to\-day administrative duties for the Head of Production and Assistant Head of Production, including email management, call coordination, expense processing, travel planning, and general office management.
* Meeting Coordination: Schedule and coordinate conference calls, meetings, and events. Distribute meeting agendas and capture action items so nothing falls through the cracks.
* Calendar \& Deadline Tracking: Meticulously track and maintain project and production calendars to ensure deadlines and milestones are met across active productions.
* Deck \& Document Preparation: Tweak, proofread, and organize presentations, creative decks, and reports for both internal and client\-facing use.
* Staffing \& Bandwidth Tracking: Track staffing and department bandwidth to ensure sufficient personnel coverage across projects.
* Team Alignment: Show up engaged in high\-level department meetings and help keep the team aligned and in the loop on updates and project statuses.
* Office Operations: Support day\-to\-day office operations to keep the Studio City space running smoothly and the team focused on the work.


Qualifications* Experience: 1\+ year of professional experience working within a studio, network, agency, or production company in an administrative or equivalent capacity.
* Organization: Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Multi\-Priority Management: Ability to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines and work well under pressure.
* Software Proficiency: Proficiency with office and communication software including Slack, Google Workspace, Zoom, Microsoft Office, Excel, and Keynote.
* Proactive Mindset: A proactive, no\-task\-too\-small mindset with strong problem\-solving instincts.
* Anticipation: Ability to anticipate needs and gaps in admin support before they are voiced.
* Adaptability: Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities.
* Collaboration: Collaborative, positive, and solutions\-oriented mindset.
* Flexible Availability: Comfortable working weekends or late nights when project timelines require it.

  

Nice To Have’s* Prior entertainment industry or on\-set experience
* Familiarity with production management tools such as Airtable, Notion, or StudioBinder
* Interest in growing into a producer or production management role over time
* Experience supporting senior executives or department heads

  

**Benefits** **$40\.00 per hour,** with overtime after 8 hours


EEO Statement


Sawhorse Productions is an equal employment opportunity employer. All employees and applicants are evaluated on the basis of their qualifications, consistent with applicable state and federal laws. In addition, Sawhorse Productions will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. Sawhorse Productions will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and federal law.

We are a commercial painting contractor looking for a true **office\-driven Project Coordinator** who can own multiple jobs from the office side while tightly coordinating with the field, clients, and GCs.

* Use Excel (beyond basic), Bluebeam, Procore (or similar), and other construction tools daily
* Keep jobs moving by solving documentation and coordination issues before they become field problems

**Requirements**

* 1–3\+ years of construction project coordination, project engineering, or document control experience (commercial preferred)
* Proven experience with RFIs, submittals, change orders, and multi\-project tracking
* Comfortable working both independently and with field teams
* Strong written and verbal communication (client/GC\-facing)
* Higher\-level Excel skills and experience with construction software (Bluebeam, Procore, Planswift, or equivalent strongly preferred)
* Willingness to perform limited field inspections as needed
* Must be able to commute daily to our West LA office (90034 area)

**Do not apply if**:

* Your experience is primarily field superintendent, foreman, or crew leadership with little office\-side documentation ownership

* Health insurance

jobs.title: Hiring Now! Assistant Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
### **Description**

  

Arellano Associates (AA) is a professional community outreach firm specializing in the transportation, clean energy, and water sectors. We bridge the gap between government agencies and the public by combining meaningful, digital and in\-person engagement with innovative technology to deliver a transparent and accessible communication process for our client's projects.  

  

By creating engagement opportunities for stakeholders to have a genuine voice in the planning and decision\-making process, we build trust, encourage collaboration, and help reduce disparities; working together toward a more connected, sustainable, and equitable California.  

  

The Assistant Project Coordinator (APC) is a full\-time, entry\-level role on the front lines of that work, supporting public outreach and stakeholder engagement for a project team under the guidance of a Project Manager. The position calls for learning agility, the ability to pick up new tools, including AI, quickly and apply them well. It also calls for ownership and follow\-through, the discipline to get the details right on a public meeting, a mailer, or a project update, since those are the details that ultimately make an impact on the communities we serve. This position is also a launchpad into a career in public outreach and project delivery, with plenty of room to grow within the company.  

  

Check out some of the Projects we are working on and how we are making an impact to communities all throughout Southern California!: https://www.arellanoassociates.com/projects  

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* **Content Creation:** Draft written text for collateral materials including fact sheets, brochures, newsletters, posters, e\-communications, and social media content.
* **Messaging Support:** Help tailor draft content to project goals and different audiences, building an understanding of how messaging shifts depending on the community and client you're working with.
* **Event Coordination:** Support in\-person public engagement events such as public meetings, pop\-ups, and special events, including logistics, supplies, and staffing.
* **Public Interaction:** Engage directly with community members at outreach events, facilitate participation, and help gather public feedback that shapes project strategy.
* **Tech Tools \& AI:** Apply the latest tech tools, including AI tools such as ChatGPT, Copilot, and Claude, to communicate project information and gather public input, using platforms like ArcGIS, SurveyMonkey, MetroQuest, Poll Everywhere, Typeform, Google Forms, Constant Contact, Salesforce, SharePoint, and WordPress.
* **Creative Production:** Use Adobe Creative Suite programs, including InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, and Premiere Pro, for basic file creation and editing.
* **Vendor Coordination:** Coordinate vendor services including printing, catering, translation and interpretation, and toll\-free phone lines.
* **Database \& Website Management:** Keep stakeholder databases, project websites, and social media content current and accurate.
* **Digital Engagement:** Monitor public input coming through email, project websites, helplines, and online engagement tools, and flag issues or notable responses to your project manager promptly.
* **Task Tracking:** Organize and maintain project documentation, support scheduling, and help the team track progress and coordinate resources.
* **Project Support:** Complete tasks within timeframes and budget parameters, helping ensure timely and cost\-effective delivery.
* **Issue Communication:** Communicate issues and challenges to your project manager promptly.

  

### **What We Look For:**

 **In Every Team Member*** **Learning Agility:** You take feedback well and treat the unfamiliar as something to figure out rather than avoid. This industry and role will be new to most people who take it on, so you're the kind of person who asks a clarifying question instead of guessing. You are comfortable asking questions, jumping into something new, and curious about new technologies.
* **Ownership and Follow\-Through:** You follow through on what you say you will do, whether that's a deadline on a fact sheet or a task from a morning check\-in. When something's off, whether it's a typo you caught or a vendor that fell through, you speak up early instead of hoping it resolves itself, and you take pride in getting the details right.
* **Collaboration and Mentoring:** You work well with others and know a project runs better when everyone's pulling in the same direction. You help teammates succeed, whether that's covering an event when someone's out or walking a newer team member through a process you've already learned. Ultimately, you make the people around you better at their jobs.
* **Curiosity with Technology and AI:** You're comfortable picking up new software and tools, including AI tools like ChatGPT, Copilot, or Claude, and applying them to real tasks. Whether that's drafting a first pass at a newsletter or researching a project topic, you know good AI use means checking the work, not just accepting it.
* **Professionalism:** You represent yourself, AA, and our clients well in every interaction. From a public meeting to an internal email. You ask questions rather than guess, show up on time and prepared, and handle mistakes with maturity.

**For This Role*** **Public Interaction:** You're comfortable talking with members of the public, whether that's staffing a table at a community event, answering questions at a public meeting, or fielding a call from a concerned resident. You can translate technical project details into plain language, and you stay professional even when someone's frustrated. No professional outreach experience required, we'll help you build it.

jobs.description:
**Advance Digital Equity Across LA’s BEST Communities \- Join Us As A Digital Equity Program Coordinator Today!**

 **About LA’s BEST**



LA’s BEST is a public/private partnership between the City of Los Angeles, the Los Angeles Unified School District (LAUSD), and the private sector, working together to provide safe, engaging, and enriching afterschool programming for elementary school students. Established 38 years ago, LA’s BEST serves children in neighborhoods with the greatest needs but the fewest resources, ensuring access to meaningful learning experiences beyond the school day.

  

Through this public\-private partnership, LAUSD operates the program, the City of Los Angeles provides crucial public support, and the nonprofit entity advocates for funding and resources. This shared commitment allows LA’s BEST to provide high\-quality enrichment activities that nurture academic growth, social\-emotional well\-being for students while also supporting working families across Los Angeles.

  

At LA’s BEST, we believe that diversity fuels innovation, creativity, and success. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where every individual's unique perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences are valued and celebrated. As we continue to grow and evolve, we are dedicated to building a team that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve. We encourage applications from individuals of all races, ethnicities, genders, sexual orientations, abilities, ages, religions, and socioeconomic backgrounds. Join us in our mission to create an environment where everyone feels empowered to thrive and contribute their best work. Your voice matters, and we invite you to bring your authentic self to our team.

 **J****ob Overview \& Responsibilities**



Reporting to the Director of Evaluation, the **Digital Equity Program Coordinator** is responsible for coordinating and administering LA's BEST's Digital Equity initiative funded through the California Advanced Services Fund (CASF). The position serves as the primary operational lead for implementation of digital literacy programming serving both students and families across ten LA's BEST school sites.

  

Working closely with LAUSD, an external digital learning consultant/vendor, school principals, nonprofit staff, and grant stakeholders, the **Digital Equity Program Coordinator** oversees planning, scheduling, implementation, reporting, participant engagement, curriculum coordination, technology deployment, and program evaluation.

  

The **Digital Equity Program Coordinator** ensures that all grant deliverables, implementation milestones, and reporting requirements are completed on time while maintaining compliance with grant expectations, district requirements, and organizational standards. Programming includes both student\-focused digital literacy instruction (Digi Scholars) and parent/caregiver digital literacy programming (Parent Digital Connections). Core responsibilities may include but are not limited to:

  

Program Coordination \& Grant Administration (approximately 35%):


* Coordinate implementation of Digital Equity programming across all participating LA's BEST school sites.
* Manage overall project timeline and ensure all grant milestones are achieved.
* Serve as the primary liaison between LA's BEST, LAUSD, external consulting partners, and school site leadership.
* Monitor grant requirements, implementation benchmarks, and compliance documentation.
* Coordinate regular implementation meetings with internal staff and consulting partners.
* Track grant expenditures and coordinate purchasing requests with the Finance department.
* Prepare reports for organizational leadership and grant funders.

  



Program Operations \& Vendor Coordination (approximately 25%):


* Coordinate the work of the external curriculum and instructional consulting partner.
* Assist with scheduling instructors, consultants, and school site programming.
* Ensure instructional programming aligns with grant objectives and approved curriculum.
* Coordinate instructor training and onboarding.
* Monitor implementation quality across all school sites.
* Resolve operational issues affecting program delivery.

  



Family Engagement \& Community Outreach (approximately 20%):


* Coordinate outreach efforts supporting enrollment of students and families.
* Partner with school sites to recruit participants for student and parent programming.
* Coordinate multilingual outreach efforts and communication materials.
* Support community information sessions and family engagement events.
* Coordinate distribution of take\-home devices for eligible families.
* Maintain participant enrollment records and attendance documentation.

  



Technology, Data \& Evaluation (approximately 20%):


* Coordinate procurement, inventory, tagging, and deployment of digital devices.
* Maintain inventory records for grant\-funded technology.
* Collect participation, attendance, and outcome data.
* Monitor program fidelity and implementation consistency.
* Assist with grant reporting and evaluation activities.
* Develop dashboards and summaries demonstrating program impact.

  


**Core Competencies**


* Ability to maintain regular and consistent attendance.
* Strong project management and organizational skills.
* Ability to coordinate multiple workstreams simultaneously.
* Strong relationship management with internal and external stakeholders.
* Ability to work collaboratively across nonprofit and public\-sector environments.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage grant\-funded initiatives with attention to compliance requirements.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Experience coordinating vendors and consultants.
* Ability to collect, interpret, and report program data.
* Knowledge of digital literacy initiatives and educational technology.

jobs.description:
Project Access provides programs and services to over 27,000 children, families, and seniors living in affordable housing communities across the country. We strive to empower residents of affordable housing communities through our onsite services, aiming to create pathways for self\-reliance and personal growth.
  
  

Join the Project Access team and create impact in the lives of our residents. Hear from them and how their lives have changed: www.project\-access.org/success\-stories/
  
  

The opportunity
  
  

The Resident Services Coordinator designs and implements programs that enhance community life for residents of all ages. They serve as a vital link between residents and services, creating value through targeted initiatives that address community needs. This role requires an innovative, proactive individual who excels in an autonomous environment, driving positive long\-term outcomes through an understanding of the communities in which they serve.
  
  

What you'll do
  
  

Implement core programs and services, which include connecting, engaging, and empowering residents across four initiatives: Economic Stability, Education for Youth \& Families, Health \& Wellness, and Community Building.
  
Conduct outreach and survey resident needs through community engagement aligned with our four pillars.
  
Coordinate and oversee an after\-school program and teen program encompassing homework assistance and educational enrichment activities.
  
Independently plan, prepare, and facilitate resident\-facing workshops and group sessions. When external partners are unavailable, deliver core topics directly to maintain consistency and resident engagement.
  
Develop \& maintain partnerships with local providers to deliver services and workshops.
  
Plan \& facilitate community\-building events that foster safe and meaningful relationships between community members.
  
Provide residents with information \& referrals to access community resources and services, specifically connecting residents with nonprofit partners who deliver services within our four pillars framework.
  
Support food distribution needs in the community, including maintaining food bank partnerships and distribution management.
  
Develop and maintain strong relationships with the property management team, scheduling regular communication sessions.
  
Organize and conduct monthly outreach requirements including door\-to\-door outreach, digital/virtual outreach, and physical presence in high\-traffic locations.
  
Recruit, select, train, and oversee volunteers and interns who support programming at the Resource Center.
  
Use personal automobile to acquire program supplies and donations and attend offsite meetings (mileage reimbursed at IRS rate).
  
Publish monthly newsletters and calendar of events.
  
Collect \& submit program outcomes data with emphasis on social impact data collection to measure outcomes within our four pillars.
  
Provide input and adhere to budgets for resident service programs, including authority to utilize funds for contractors when needed.
  
  

What you'll bring
  
  

Bilingual English/Spanish or English/Farsi preferred
  
Two years of experience in multi\-family housing or related fields such as social services or community outreach; or a Bachelor's Degree in Social Work, Human Services, or related field.
  
  

**Experience in both:**  

after\-school programs or educational settings for youth
  
serving diverse populations, demonstrating cultural competency and community awareness.
  
Proficient with MS Office (Excel, Word, Publisher, Outlook). Basic with Adobe Acrobat, Canva, Salesforce, Concur.
  
Strong time management, administrative, and organizational skills.
  
Self\-starter, multi\-tasker, and strong communicator
  
The physical activity of this position includes minimal bending, walking, kneeling, reaching, and step climbing. Able to lift up to 30 pounds, which includes large boxes of food for a supplemental food distribution program.
  
Credentials/Certifications
  
Valid Driver’s License, clean driving record, and current automobile insurance
  
CPR \& First Aid certified (or obtained within 90 days of hire)
  
Successful completion of background check and LiveScan

This is a part\-time (29 hrs/wk), non\-exempt position

**Location:** Vintage Crossings Apartments, 700 East South St, Unit 100, Anaheim, CA 92805

**Benefits offered:**  

Term life insurance and an Employee Assistance Program

**Job Summary**

The Marketing Coordinator supports the day\-to\-day operations of the Marketing team, ensuring campaigns run smoothly across all channels and stores. This role manages Trello workflows, organizes assets and files, and communicates deadlines to keep projects on track. The person who will excel in this role has excellent attention to detail, and high\-level proofreading/editing skills.

The Marketing Coordinator also acts as a key liaison between the Marketing team, store teams, and creative partners assuring everyone what they need to execute effectively. Additional responsibilities include managing the marketing communications calendar, building and scheduling email campaigns in Alpine IQ, and tracking print production and delivery to store locations.

**Essential Functions and Responsibilities of the job include but are not limited to:**

The Clinical Research Coordinator III is responsible for supporting the management and oversight of clinical trials. This role involves working closely with a team to ensure the smooth execution of research studies under the guidance of the Investigator and CRC Manager.

  


**Essential Functions:**


***Overseeing Clinical Trials:***


* Ensure smooth conduct of study visits and clinical trials.
* Monitor study participants’ health throughout the trial.
* Schedule study visits within protocol\-required timelines
* Coordinate lab work, imaging, and other required procedures
* Document all aspects of the study visit and subject status.


***Data Collection and Analysis:***


* Collect and enter data obtained from study visits into source documents, study logs, and EMR, as well as EDC where data management personnel are not assigned.
* Assist data management team with resolution of queries


***Participant Interaction:***


* Educate study participants about study objectives and visit procedures.
* Communicate with study participants regarding any adverse events or side effects and the management of them.
* Administer applicable questionnaires.
* Monitor participants' adherence to protocol guidelines.


***Collaboration and Compliance:***


* Liaise with laboratories
* Liaise with Imaging vendors
* Liaise with pharmacy staff and infusion nurses
* Liaise with regulatory and quality assurance departments on protocol adherence and documents.
* Monitor study compliance with protocols and ethical standards.
* Ensure adherence to regulatory requirements.


***Record Keeping:***


* Maintain research records, including source documents, study logs, case report forms, and EMR
* Direct specimen collection, labeling, packaging, transport, shipping, and storage.


***Logistics and Supplies:***


* Ensure all necessary equipment and supplies are in stock and functional.

***Education:*** Bachelor's degree preferred in a health\-related field


***Experience***: \+3 years of experience in Clinical Research


**Skills:**


***Regulatory***

***Finance***


* Stipend payments
* Manage site budgets
* Insurance Coordination


***Subject Interaction***


* Recruit, interview, screen, enroll, and randomize subjects

* Collect medical history
* Conduct study visits
* Triage patients' questions


***Administrative***


* Source documentation
* EDC completion
* Query resolution
* AE/SAE documentation and reporting
* Address protocol violations and deviations
* Order/ maintain supplies


***Clinical Skills***


* Phlebotomy preferred
* Vital Signs
* EKG
* Order and organize lab reports
* IP Administration
* Manage Medical Records


***Others***


* Support training and answer questions of other staff members
* Support monitoring visits
* Leads sponsor communication
* Manage subject visits during managers’ absence
* Liaise with Investigators in manager’s absence

jobs.description:
**Title:** Events Marketing Manager


**Reports to:** Chief Marketing Officer


**Location:** Brooklyn, NY or Marina del Rey, CA — onsite Monday–Friday


**Who is Flip?**



There are 3 runaway categories in B2B AI — coding, legal, and customer support. We're at the center of the third, with a one\-of\-one market position and hundreds of diehard fan clients, from Under Armour to Tory Burch to some of the largest healthcare institutions in the country.



The market is dividing into two camps: generic tooling\-and\-FDE players building custom agents from scratch, and industry\-specific solutions winning on client love due to speed of ROI. We're firmly the latter. Retail and healthcare alone represent $5B\+ TAMs each, and we're still early.



We built the company on a simple idea: the best way to grow is to have a reference list as long as your customer list. We're a team of 100\+ now, with offices in NYC, LA, and the UK. Many people here will tell you it's the best place they've worked and the hardest they've worked. Both are true.


### **The Role**



Events are one of the biggest ways we grow across the three industries we serve — retail, healthcare, and transportation. From major trade shows and conferences to client experiences (Flippin' Legends), brand activations, and internal company events, you'll own Flip's event presence end to end.



You know the B2B trade show world inside and out, love planning the work and working the plan, and hold everyone around you to the same standard. Our creative and content teams bring the ideas — your job is to execute them exceptionally. Not just done, but done right, on time, and on budget.


### **What You'll Own**


* **Trade shows \& conferences.** Own Flip's presence end to end. Identify the right events across retail, healthcare, and transportation, negotiate sponsorships and booth packages, manage all logistics, and ensure Flip shows up in a way that turns heads and drives pipeline. Retail industry trade show experience is a strong plus.
* **Pre\-event planning.** Build detailed event plans and timelines well in advance. Coordinate across sales, marketing, and leadership to align on goals, messaging, and on\-site experience. Manage all vendor relationships, contracts, and deadlines.
* **Budget management \& ROI.** Own event budgets from estimate through reconciliation, delivering maximum impact within a reasonable spend. Track and report ROI for every event — leads generated, pipeline influenced, brand impressions, follow\-up conversion — and use that data to prioritize the events that deliver.

* **A natural collaborator** who translates creative and content teams' ideas into flawless execution.
* **Relentless attention to detail.** You love a checklist, own every open item, and don't stop until everything is closed out.
* **Adaptable and calm under pressure.** If you're a chaos\-wrangler who brings order to complexity, we want to meet you.

### **More About Us**


* We're international, spanning the US, UK, and Canada
* We've raised \+$30M to date including our recent $20M Series A \- backed by Ridge, Next Coast, ScOp, Bullpen Capital, Data Point and Forum Ventures, as well as founders \& executives from Amazon Alexa, Ada, Attentive, and Simon Data
* We are hiring two Customer Content Marketers in this role; one for our eCom/retail vertical and one for our Healthcare vertical.
* Comprehensive healthcare and unlimited vacation, including a mandatory half week for everyone over July 4, and a full week off at the end of the year
* In office 5 days/week

jobs.title: Account Manager, Integrated Marketing
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

Great work rarely falls apart because nobody cared. It falls apart in the spaces between people, disciplines, decisions, and deadlines. The Account Manager, Integrated Marketing is the person who closes those spaces and keeps complex client work organized, connected, and moving.

At Rocket Launch, one client initiative may bring together strategy, advertising, creative, digital marketing, public relations, media, web, social media, production, and a small constellation of outside partners. You will turn approved direction into clear plans, useful assignments, realistic timelines, and unmistakable next steps, so everyone knows what is happening, why it matters, and what they own.

You will work alongside Account Directors and discipline experts, applying the judgment of an experienced agency account manager to spot missing information, conflicting deadlines, unclear ownership, and handoffs that are quietly preparing to become tomorrow's emergency.

We are looking for someone proactive, practical, exceptionally organized, and enjoyable to work with. Someone who understands how integrated agency work comes together, brings calm to motion and clarity to complexity, and occasionally finds a smarter worksheet, cleaner Monday board, or better way to keep everyone aligned.

**What Will You Make Happen?**

* Manage the day\-to\-day coordination of multiple integrated marketing accounts and projects from kickoff through delivery, maintaining clear plans, timelines, milestones, dependencies, approvals, and next steps.
* Partner closely with Client Leaders to translate approved strategy, scopes, briefs, and priorities into organized workback schedules, clear assignments, and coordinated next steps for the right teams.
* Connect the work across marketing, advertising, creative, digital, public relations, media, web, social media, production, and outside partners, making sure handoffs happen and connected deliverables stay aligned.
* Coordinate and facilitate project kickoffs, status meetings, and client working sessions that earn their place on the calendar. Prepare the agenda, gather the facts, identify needed decisions, document actions and owners, and follow through.
* Maintain reliable account and project information and concise status updates so Client Leaders and project teams can quickly understand progress, priorities, decisions, risks, and next steps.
* Make sure assignments are truly ready before work begins, including the objective, deliverables, specifications, source materials, budget parameters, due dates, reviewers, and approval path.
* Manage the routing, review, feedback, approval, and delivery of briefs, copy, creative, web content, media materials, proofs, and final assets without allowing feedback to disappear into the mist.
* Coordinate approved work with printers, photographers, videographers, translators, media vendors, fabricators, installers, freelancers, and other production partners, including quotes, specifications, schedules, proofs, and delivery details.
* Track project scope, estimates, approved budgets, outside costs, and changing requirements. Understand the effect on timing and resources, then raise potential variances promptly with the appropriate Client Leader or business operations contact.
* Stay ahead of the work. Monitor risks, bottlenecks, dependencies, and competing deadlines; offer practical options and raise decisions when they fall outside your authority.
* Make day\-to\-day work easier to manage. When a shared worksheet, better Monday board, cleaner notes system, or simple workflow adjustment would reduce confusion or rework, set it up, recommend it, and help the team use it.
* Be a steady, generous teammate. Communicate respectfully, stay constructive when priorities shift, share what others need to know, and help people leave conversations clear about what happens next.

**What Will You Bring?**

* Four or more years of account management, client services, or closely related project\-management experience in an integrated agency environment.
* Demonstrated success coordinating multiple concurrent client accounts, multi\-channel campaigns, or integrated projects with overlapping teams, deadlines, approvals, and outside partners.
* A working understanding of how strategy, account service, creative development, copy, digital marketing, paid media, public relations, websites, social media, analytics, and production connect during delivery. You do not need to perform every discipline, but you should understand how the pieces affect one another.
* Strong command of agency account and project fundamentals, including briefing, workback schedules, milestones, dependencies, resource coordination, routing, approvals, risk tracking, scope awareness, and closeout.
* Exceptional organization and attention to detail, paired with the judgment to know which details matter most to timing, quality, scope, and the client experience.
* Excellent written communication. Your agendas are useful, your recaps are clear, your action lists identify owners, and your status reports tell people what they actually need to know.
* Confident, tactful verbal communication with clients, agency leaders, specialists, vendors, and partners. You can ask a direct question, surface a concern, and keep the relationship intact.
* A proactive, solutions\-oriented approach. You anticipate needs, investigate gaps, offer workable options, and follow through without waiting to be reminded.
* Experience coordinating creative or production vendors and managing specifications, quotes, proofs, schedules, deliveries, and final assets.
* Practical budget and scope awareness, including the ability to track estimates and outside costs and recognize when a request needs leadership review or a scope adjustment.
* Comfort in a fast\-moving, hands\-on agency where priorities can change, several disciplines may contribute to one outcome, and being unflappable is a genuine professional advantage.

jobs.title: Key Account Manager - Critical Industries
jobs.description:
At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:**


Strategic Program Director
\_\_


In this role, you’ll develop, implement, and manage the strategy and relationship with assigned data center\-related accounts for the ABB Electrification (EL) business, specifically related to the Industry, Building and Channel (IBC) organization. The position will have significant cross\-functional responsibilities across the ABB EL. As the point person for the ABB IBC relationship within those accounts, this position is responsible for growing share of wallet, profitability, and elevating customer satisfaction. Coordinates executive relationships within the accounts, sets goals, tracks pipeline, organizes sales activities, monitors current projects, and manages the resolution of the strategic customer challenges.


The work model for the role is: remote (\#LI\-Remote) and willingness to travel as needed is required.

**Your role and responsibilities:**

* **Lead Strategic Account Planning:** Develop and implement account plans and Statements of Work (SoW) to drive growth across divisions and locations.
* **Drive Customer\-Centric Sales Strategy:** Understand key business drivers and risks (e.g., sustainability, digitalization, cybersecurity) to shape tailored sales strategies and targets.
* **Build Trusted Relationships:** Engage decision\-makers within data center organizations, delivering comprehensive ABB solutions aligned with customer needs and profitability goals.
* **Enable Competitive \& Coordinated Execution:** Monitor market trends and competitors, apply standardized sales tools (e.g., Salesforce), and ensure a unified approach to sales planning and issue resolution.

**Our Team Dynamics**


Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters \- because the progress we make here creates real impact out there.

**Qualifications for the role:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Marketing or related field and a minimum of 10 years of experience within the industry OR Associate’s degree and a minimum of 12 years of experience within the industry.
* Experience working with data center customers is a plus.
* Strong understanding of the Electrification products
* Proven ability to conduct market analysis and develop business plans with a structured, strategic mindset; experienced in building strong relationships with electrical contractors, distributors, and channel partners. Brings a technical background (preferably in the data center market), strong communication skills, and an agile, collaborative leadership style that fosters teamwork and innovation.
* Solid technical understanding of 3\-phase AC power systems including, but not limited to: medium and low voltage switchgear, medium and low voltage motor control centers, switchboards, panelboards, and ancillary electrical distribution products and experience with quoting projects for contractors  

Solid technical understanding and field sales experience selling power monitoring and control software, associated metering and communications systems, direct current, and battery energy storage/microgrid solutions.
* Candidates must already have work authorization that would permit them to work for ABB in the US.

**What's in it for you**

We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger

jobs.title: Account Manager - Defense
jobs.description:
**About ISC**


Established in 1971, ISC began building custom power cables \& assemblies for Gateway, Kingston, and Xerox. With over 50 years of manufacturing experience, ISC is capable of meeting tight deadlines and changing forecasts while maintaining quality. Our products are in use worldwide in commercial and military aircraft, lifesaving medical devices, weapon systems, inflight entertainment, power systems, and countless commercial, industrial \& computer applications. Our facility is environmentally controlled, engineered for manufacturing flexibility, includes dedicated assembly labs for isolated program management, and a cleanroom facility. With dedicated professionals and assemblers regularly operating two full shifts, ISC operates with the most current high\-speed tooling, material handling, and test equipment.

 **Job Overview**


The **Account Manager (AM)** owns execution of customer programs across the full quote\-to\-cash lifecycle for assigned accounts. This role serves as the primary point of contact and customer advocate while driving internal coordination to ensure on\-time delivery, margin performance, and overall program success.


This is a hands\-on, operations\-focused role within a fast\-paced contract manufacturing environment. The Account Manager operates with a high level of ownership and accountability, partnering closely with Sales, Operations, Engineering, Sourcing, Accounting, and Customer Experience to successfully execute both new and existing programs. Success in this role requires direct involvement in customer communication, production coordination, scheduling, and order execution

 **What You'll Do:**

**Customer Ownership**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and advocate for assigned customer accounts
* Build and maintain strong, long\-term customer relationships
* Lead customer communications including meetings, calls, and periodic site visits
### **Program \& Order Execution**

* Own execution of customer accounts through the full quote\-to\-cash lifecycle, from initial quotation through shipment and cash collection
* Support onboarding of new customers and new programs, ensuring successful launch and internal alignment
* Provide proactive order status updates, delivery schedules, and open order reporting to customers
* Drive on\-time delivery performance across assigned accounts
### **Cross\-Functional Coordination**

* Collaborate with Sales, Operations, Engineering, Manufacturing, Purchasing, Accounting, and Customer Experience to meet customer requirements
* Coordinate manufacturability, feasibility, and delivery commitments with internal teams
* Drive accountability and clear communication across cross\-functional stakeholders
### **Commercial \& Pricing Management**

* Manage RFQs, re\-quotes, and ongoing pricing activities
* Coordinate material costs, labor inputs, and pricing updates with internal teams
* Support margin performance through effective pricing and cost awareness
### **Planning \& Forecasting**

* Manage customer forecasts, blanket orders, and Kanban programs
* Coordinate material pipelines and demand changes with Supply Chain and Production teams
* Support alignment between customer demand and internal production planning
### **Issue Resolution \& Continuous Improvement**

* Proactively identify and resolve delivery, quality, or supply chain issues impacting customer commitments
* Manage customer escalations and drive timely resolution
* Track quote outcomes, including closed\-lost business, and provide feedback to support continuous improvement
### **Systems \& Reporting**

* Utilize ERP/MRP systems to track orders, forecasts, and account performance
* Provide customer forecasts and sales\-related reporting to Sales Leadership
* Maintain accurate documentation of customer requirements and program details
### **Additional Responsibilities**

* Perform other duties as required to support business needs

 **Must\-Have Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or equivalent required
* 2\+ years of experience in account management, program management, or related roles within a manufacturing environment
* Experience managing customer orders, delivery schedules, forecasts, and open order reporting
* Experience coordinating cross\-functionally with production, planning, purchasing, engineering, or supply chain teams
* Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment while maintaining strong attention to detail
* Experience handling delivery expedites, schedule changes, or supply chain\-related issues
* Exposure to quoting, RFQs, pricing coordination, or cost\-related discussions
* Working knowledge of ERP/MRP systems and manufacturing workflows

jobs.title: Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
**L.A. Hydro Jet \& Rooter Services** is seeking a **Key Account Manager** to join our team! The Key Account Manager (KAM) will be responsible for protecting, strengthening, and growing LA Hydro\-Jet's (LAH) most important customer relationships.

  

**What Sets L.A. Hydro\-Jet Apart:**


* **Competitive Pay:** **$80,000\-$100,000 \+****, plus incentive program**
* **Comprehensive Benefits:** Health, vision, dental, and life insurance
* **Retirement Plan:** 401K plan \+ match
* **Time Off:** Vacation and paid holidays

**Position Summary**

This person will serve as the primary relationship owner for an assigned portfolio of key accounts, developing strong connections with decision\-makers, understanding each customer's business and service needs, and proactively identifying opportunities to expand LAH's share of their business across multiple service lines. The KAM will accomplish this through regular customer contact, account planning, quarterly or semiannual business reviews, site visits, relationship\-building activities, and close coordination with LAH's operations, sales, estimating, and service teams to ensure the customer receives consistent value and strong support. Success will be measured primarily by year\-over\-year revenue growth within assigned accounts, customer retention, increased penetration of LAH services, and the strength of the overall customer relationship. The KAM will be expected to understand where each account stands financially, identify why an account is growing or declining, maintain a pipeline of expansion opportunities, and take action when business is at risk. Ultimately, the role is successful when key customers view LA Hydro\-Jet as a trusted partner and increasingly choose LAH as their primary—or preferred—service provider.

**WHAT L.A. HYDRO\-JET NEEDS FROM YOU:**
* 3\-5\+ years of B2B account management, strategic customer success, relationship management, or consultative sales experience.
* Demonstrated experience managing a book of business, large customer relationships, or multi\-location accounts.
* Track record of retaining and growing existing customer revenue.
* Strong consultative selling, cross\-selling, negotiation, and opportunity\-development skills.
* Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, including comfort presenting to customer leadership.
* Ability to analyze account revenue, service mix, trends, and opportunities using CRM and basic reporting tools.
* Strong organizational skills with disciplined follow\-up and calendar management.
* Valid driver's license, a clean MVR, and ability to travel locally throughout LA Hydro\-Jet's service territory.
* Availability for occasional early\-morning, evening, weekend, customer, or industry events as business needs require.
**What Sets You Apart:**
* Experience in property management, facilities, commercial services, plumbing, HVAC, restoration, waste, construction, or another B2B field\-service industry.
* Experience with property\-management companies, facility teams, restaurants/hospitality groups, multifamily operators, or other multi\-site customers.
* Experience conducting quarterly business reviews (QBRs), account\-planning meetings, or executive customer presentations.
* Experience with ServiceTitan or a comparable CRM/field\-service platform.
* Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, communications, or a related field is preferred but not required in place of strong relevant experience.

### **Role Expectations \& Work Environment**


* This position is expected to spend meaningful time with customers and in the field rather than working exclusively from a desk.
* The role may involve customer\-site visits, office meetings, business meals, industry events, and approved entertainment activities.
* The employee must maintain professional judgment regarding gifts, entertainment, confidentiality, customer policies, and conflicts of interest.
* Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals to perform the essential functions of the role.
* Act as the primary relationship owner when an assigned customer has a complaint, service failure, or escalation.
* Coordinate with Operations and department leadership to understand root cause, corrective action, and customer communication.
* Stay engaged until the customer confirms that the issue has been resolved appropriately.
* Escalate material retention risks or competitive threats promptly to leadership.

### **Required Job Traits**



**Trait**

  

**Why It Matters**

  

**What Strong Performance Looks Like**

  


**Relationship Builder**

  


Creates trust and loyalty with customers.

  


Develops genuine relationships at multiple levels of the account.

  


**Proactive / Self\-Starter**

  


The role cannot depend on inbound calls.

  


Creates reasons to contact customers and advances opportunities without being prompted.

  


**Commercial Mindset**

  


Customer satisfaction alone is not enough.

  


Comfortably asks for additional work and seeks a larger share of customer spend.

  


**Ownership Mentality**

  


Major accounts require clear accountability.

  


Treats account performance as personal responsibility and acts quickly when revenue or satisfaction declines.

  


**Emotional Intelligence**

  


Strategic accounts involve different personalities and pressures.

  


Reads the room, adapts communication, and handles difficult conversations professionally.

  


**Curiosity / Consultative Thinking**

  


Growth comes from understanding customer operations.

  


Asks strong questions about properties, budgets, pain points, vendor structure, and future plans.

  


**Organization / Follow\-Through**

  


Large portfolios create many commitments and touchpoints.

  


Maintains disciplined follow\-up, CRM hygiene, review cadence, and next steps.

  


**Resilience / Persistence**

  


Sales and relationship\-building include rejection and delay.

  


Follows up appropriately withou

jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative – PCBA KING
jobs.description:
Outside Sales Representative – PCBA KING

**PCBA KING \| U.S. Field Sales**

**Pay:** $40,000–$60,000 per year

Job Description

PCBA KING is looking for a driven, competitive **Outside Sales Representative** to develop new business and grow our customer base across the U.S.

**This is a true boots\-on\-the\-ground outside sales position.** We are looking for someone who will literally **knock on doors, visit customers and prospects in person, follow up on leads, and hand\-deliver line cards and sales materials.**

This is **not an order\-taking or desk sales role.** We want a hunter who enjoys getting out into the market, meeting customers face\-to\-face, opening doors, and creating new business from scratch.

What You'll Do

* **Visit customers and prospective customers in person**
* **Knock on doors and introduce PCBA KING to new businesses**
* **Visit and qualify leads face\-to\-face**
* **Hand\-deliver line cards and sales materials**
* Prospect aggressively for new accounts within your territory
* Cold call, email, network, and prospect in person
* Connect with purchasing, procurement, engineering, operations, and supply\-chain professionals
* Develop relationships with OEMs, electronics manufacturers, technology companies, and other B2B customers
* Identify customer needs related to **PCB and PCBA manufacturing**
* Generate RFQ opportunities and work with our team to support customer requirements
* Follow up consistently and persistently with prospects
* Build and manage an active sales pipeline
* Turn cold prospects into long\-term customers
* Maintain and grow relationships after opening an account
* Take ownership of your territory and sales results

Who We're Looking For

We want a **true sales hunter** who is:

* Comfortable walking into a business and starting a conversation
* Willing to spend significant time in the field
* Persistent and comfortable hearing “no”
* Competitive, self\-motivated, and results\-driven
* Confident meeting new customers face\-to\-face
* Excellent at prospecting and follow\-up
* Able to build relationships from the ground up
* Organized and capable of managing a territory independently
* Professional in appearance and communication
* Focused on generating new business rather than waiting for inbound opportunities

Preferred Experience

Outside sales or business\-development experience is strongly preferred.

Experience selling **PCBs, PCB assemblies (PCBA), electronics manufacturing services (EMS), contract manufacturing, electronic components, or related technology products** is a major advantage.

Experience calling on **OEMs, electronics manufacturers, engineering teams, purchasing departments, procurement teams, and supply\-chain professionals** is highly valued.

What Success Looks Like

We are looking for someone who wakes up thinking about **where the next customer is coming from.**

You should be willing to get in your car, visit companies, knock on doors, deliver a line card, introduce **PCBA KING**, find the right decision\-maker, uncover an opportunity, generate RFQs, and keep following up until you earn the business.

**Find the opportunity. Open the door. Build the relationship. Win the business.**

How to Apply

Please submit your resume and tell us:

* What products or services you've sold
* Who you've sold to
* Your outside/field sales experience
* The U.S. territory or geographic market you know best
* Your experience with PCB, PCBA, EMS, or electronics manufacturing
* The largest new account you've personally opened

If you're a hunter who would rather be **in front of customers than sitting behind a desk**, we want to hear from you.

**Work Location:** In person / Field Sales

Pay: $50,000\.00 \- $60,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Hyakunousha**

Hyakunousha (百農社) is the parent company of OMUSUBI, a brand dedicated to connecting people and enriching communities through Japanese culinary culture. Rooted in the tradition of omusubi—a symbol of warmth, care, and nourishment—we are committed to fostering a people\-first, genuinely caring workplace.

As we expand into the United States, our goal is to introduce the heart of Japanese cuisine and the spirit of *omotenashi*: exceptional hospitality delivered with sincerity.

**Position Overview**

The Marketing Officer will play a key role in executing local marketing initiatives and strengthening brand presence in the Los Angeles market. This position is responsible for coordinating marketing campaigns, social media activities, community engagement events, and product launch programs while ensuring alignment with the overall brand strategy developed by the Hong Kong Marketing Team.

The successful candidate is passionate about food, customer experience, and brand building, with the ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced and entrepreneurial environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Marketing Campaigns \& Brand Communications**

* Execute local marketing campaigns and promotional activities across online and offline channels.
* Coordinate the implementation of marketing calendars, seasonal promotions, and store\-opening initiatives.
* Work closely with headquarters to ensure brand consistency and effective communication in the U.S. market.
* Coordinate the development and distribution of marketing materials, advertising assets, and promotional content.

**Social Media Management**

* Manage and maintain the brand's social media platforms, including content scheduling, publishing, and community engagement.
* Create and localize social media content that resonates with U.S. consumers.
* Monitor social media trends and identify opportunities to enhance brand visibility and engagement.
* Track performance metrics and provide recommendations to improve campaign effectiveness.

**Events \& Community Marketing**

* Plan, organize, and execute marketing events, store activations, local partnerships, and community outreach programs.
* Coordinate BTL (Below\-the\-Line) marketing activities to drive customer traffic and increase brand awareness.
* Establish relationships with local organizations, influencers, media partners, and community groups.
* Evaluate event performance and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

**New Product Development (NPD) Support**

* Support the launch and promotion of new products in the U.S. market.
* Gather consumer insights and market intelligence to support product development and marketing strategies.
* Conduct competitor and industry research to identify market opportunities and emerging trends.
* Coordinate marketing support materials for new product launches.

**Customer Experience \& Feedback Management**

* Monitor customer feedback from social media, online review platforms, and other customer touchpoints.
* Work with operations teams to address customer concerns and enhance customer satisfaction.
* Analyze customer feedback trends and provide recommendations for service and product improvements.
* Prepare regular reports on customer sentiment and market insights.

**Reporting \& Administration**

* Track marketing activities and campaign performance against established objectives.
* Coordinate with external vendors, agencies, and partners to ensure timely project execution.
* Monitor marketing budgets and maintain accurate records of expenditures.
* Prepare regular reports and presentations for the Head of Marketing.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 2 years of experience in marketing, preferably within retail, food \& beverage, hospitality, or consumer brands.
* Experience in social media marketing, event management, and campaign execution.
* Strong organizational and project management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Proactive, hands\-on, and results\-oriented mindset.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and work independently.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications and social media management tools.
* Experience with Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar design tools is an advantage.
* Fluency in English is required. Chinese (Mandarin and/or Cantonese) is a plus.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Increased brand awareness and customer engagement in the Los Angeles market.
* Successful execution of marketing campaigns, events, and product launches.
* Growth in social media audience and engagement metrics.
* Effective collection and utilization of customer feedback to enhance products and services.
* Strong collaboration between U.S. operations and the Hong Kong Marketing Team.

**Our Culture**

At Hyakunousha, we work as ONE TEAM. Our workplace values care, respect, transparency, and collaboration. We encourage creative thinking, cross\-team support, and building a diverse, non\-hierarchical, equitable environment where everyone can grow.

We value passion and integrity over technical perfection.

If you believe in meaningful hospitality and want to grow with a team that cares deeply about people, we’d love to meet you.

**Apply \& Join Our U.S. Launch**

If you’re ready to help bring OMUSUBI by Hyakunousha to Los Angeles, please send your full resume and expected salary to: careers.us@hyakunousha.com

Pay: From $80,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

Cardinal Health’s Global Medical Products and Distribution (“GMPD”) segment, focuses on U.S. and International Products and Distribution businesses. * Experience in sales, account/relationship management, or customer success preferred
* Strong written and verbal communication skills including active listening, experience in developing and delivering presentations to both small and large groups

jobs.title: Supervisor Clinical Research Coordinator (Orthopedics)
jobs.description:
**Work Location**

Orange, California  

  

**Work Shift**

Day – 08hrs (United States of America)
**Why CHOC?**

At CHOC, we strive to be the leading destination of children’s health by providing exceptional and innovative care. We are responsible for the overall health of our community’s pediatric population in our hospitals, clinics, and practices. And because of our breadth of care, your career at CHOC can be as diverse and fulfilling as you determine. CHOC’s compensation structure, benefits offerings, and career development programs are geared to helping you achieve your professional and personal goals. Apply now to see where your career at CHOC can take you.


**Environmental Sustainability Statement**

Driven by the connection between children's health and a healthy environment, we commit to creating a healthcare model that incorporates environmental sustainability aligned with our mission to protect children's health and patient safety.


**Job Summary**

The Clinical Research Coordinator Supervisor (CRC\-Su) functions independently and is responsible for the complete coordination of multiple assigned human subjects’ (clinical) research projects and is expected to perform all core Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) responsibilities. The Supervisor serves as a mentor, an educator, and a leader with first\-line supervisory oversight (e.g., involved with hiring, reviewing, and terminating other associates). Study management includes but is not limited to assessing feasibility of clinical research protocols, preparing materials needed for regulatory review and submission to the Institutional Review Board (IRB), identifying potential study participants, coordinating and collecting research data/specimens, completing study records in an accurate and timely manner, participating in quality assurance audits, managing study materials and supplies, communicating across multiple teams, and archiving records in accordance with appropriate policies and procedures. The Supervisor will be responsible for financial components of clinical research projects, documentation of investigator product (drug or device), development of source documents and/or case report forms and running research/project team meetings. In this role, the Supervisor may support investigator\-initiated Investigational New Drug (IND) or Investigational Device Exemption (IDE) applications, monitor or audit studies in the Research Institute, educate and mentor clinical staff, research team members, and other coordinators, and may be requested to coordinate multi\-center studies. The Supervisor is responsible for evaluating CRC performance and assists the Site Manager in resolving operations workload, protocol implementation, and data collection issues. The Supervisor may also participate in one or more workgroups or committees within the Research Institute with a focus on CRC operations. The Supervisor is the most senior position in the Clinical Research Coordinator series.
**Pay Range**

Minimum $90,563 Midpoint $120,016 Maximum $149,427
*Rate of pay is determined by various factors, including but not limited to knowledge, skills, competencies, experience, education, as well as position requirements.*

**Experience**

Required: Minimum six (6\) years of clinical research coordination experience.


Preferred: Clinical research experience in a hospital setting and/or pediatric clinical research experience and demonstrated leadership experience.  



  

**Education**

Required: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent additional experience can be accepted in lieu of education.


Preferred: Master’s degree in a relevant field.


**Specialized Skills**

Required: Working knowledge of key Microsoft Office programs (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Demonstrate strong interpersonal skills. Able to communicate effectively both orally and in writing. Be detail oriented. Able to work under pressure in a fast\-paced environment while managing multiple competing priorities. Working knowledge of human subjects’ regulatory requirements and International Council for Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Pharmaceuticals for Human Use Guidelines for Good Clinical Practice (ICH\-GCP). Ability to conduct informed consent. Strong knowledge of research sample identification, processing, and storage. Ability to manage conflict and to create a culture of accountability within their assigned team. Demonstrate good time and priority management and is capable of problem\-solving.


Preferred: Working knowledge of Cerner or equivalent electronic medical record system.  



  

**Licensure**

Required: Basic Life Support (BLS) \- American Heart Association. If incumbent does not have certification at time of hire or promotion, certification is expected to be obtained within 6 months of assuming position. With management approval, the time in which to obtain certification may be extended past 6 months due to extenuating circumstances. Association of Clinical Research Professionals Certified Professional (ACRP\-CP), Certified Clinical Research Professional (CCRP) or Certified Clinical Research Coordinator (CCRC) \- If incumbent does not have certification at time of hire or promotion, certification is expected to be obtained within 12 months of assuming position. With management approval, the time in which to obtain certification may be extended past 12 months due to extenuating circumstances.


Preferred: Phlebotomy certification.


**Work Environments \- Functional Demand:**

Light \- Moderate energy level Lift and carry 25\-35 lbs. Push/pull 50\-100 lbs. (ie. empty bed, stretcher).

-----------------------------------

Bending, Carry Objects, Climbing, Keyboard use/repetitive motion, Pinching/fine motor activities, Push/Pull, Reaching forward, Reaching overhead, Sitting, Squat/kneel/crawl (Squad \& Knee), Standing, Talk or hear, Taste or smell, Twisting, Walking, Wrist position deviation
**Physical Activity Lifting**

Lifting

jobs.description:
At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:**


Strategic Program Director
\_\_


In this role, you’ll develop, implement, and manage the strategy and relationship with assigned data center\-related accounts for the ABB Electrification (EL) business, specifically related to the Industry, Building and Channel (IBC) organization. The position will have significant cross\-functional responsibilities across the ABB EL. As the point person for the ABB IBC relationship within those accounts, this position is responsible for growing share of wallet, profitability, and elevating customer satisfaction. Coordinates executive relationships within the accounts, sets goals, tracks pipeline, organizes sales activities, monitors current projects, and manages the resolution of the strategic customer challenges.


The work model for the role is: remote (\#LI\-Remote) and willingness to travel as needed is required.

**Your role and responsibilities:**

* **Lead Strategic Account Planning:** Develop and implement account plans and Statements of Work (SoW) to drive growth across divisions and locations.
* **Drive Customer\-Centric Sales Strategy:** Understand key business drivers and risks (e.g., sustainability, digitalization, cybersecurity) to shape tailored sales strategies and targets.
* **Build Trusted Relationships:** Engage decision\-makers within data center organizations, delivering comprehensive ABB solutions aligned with customer needs and profitability goals.
* **Enable Competitive \& Coordinated Execution:** Monitor market trends and competitors, apply standardized sales tools (e.g., Salesforce), and ensure a unified approach to sales planning and issue resolution.

**Our Team Dynamics**


Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters \- because the progress we make here creates real impact out there.

**Qualifications for the role:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Marketing or related field and a minimum of 10 years of experience within the industry OR Associate’s degree and a minimum of 12 years of experience within the industry.
* Experience working with data center customers is a plus.
* Strong understanding of the Electrification products
* Proven ability to conduct market analysis and develop business plans with a structured, strategic mindset; experienced in building strong relationships with electrical contractors, distributors, and channel partners. Brings a technical background (preferably in the data center market), strong communication skills, and an agile, collaborative leadership style that fosters teamwork and innovation.
* Solid technical understanding of 3\-phase AC power systems including, but not limited to: medium and low voltage switchgear, medium and low voltage motor control centers, switchboards, panelboards, and ancillary electrical distribution products and experience with quoting projects for contractors  

Solid technical understanding and field sales experience selling power monitoring and control software, associated metering and communications systems, direct current, and battery energy storage/microgrid solutions.
* Candidates must already have work authorization that would permit them to work for ABB in the US.

**What's in it for you**

We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger

jobs.description:
**About YoloCare**

YoloCare builds and maintains websites for healthcare facilities, including nursing homes and assisted living facilities. We work directly with the marketing directors and administrators to keep their websites looking and functioning well.

**The Role**

We're looking for an Account Manager who's comfortable being the main point of contact for a book of healthcare clients, someone who can talk through a website update on a client call as well as build several new web pages. You don't need to code, but you do need to be genuinely tech\-savvy: comfortable in a CMS, able to speak the language of our design and dev team, and quick to understand what's actually going wrong when something breaks. You’ll need to be a quick learner when it comes to technology.

**Responsibilities**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for an assigned portfolio of healthcare clients, building trusted, long\-term relationships
* Manage day\-to\-day client communication, status updates, requests, questions, and expectation\-setting
* Write and edit website copy (page updates, service descriptions, small content changes) that fits each client's voice and meets healthcare industry standards
* Navigate our CMS and basic web tools confidently enough to make simple updates, QA changes, and clearly scope requests for the dev/design team
* Coordinate with internal design, development, and SEO teams to keep client projects and requests moving
* Track account health: renewals, scope, satisfaction, and opportunities to expand services
* Run client check\-ins and status calls, and follow up with clear next steps
* Flag risks (technical issues, dissatisfaction, scope creep) early and proactively

**What We're Looking For**

* 2\+ years in account management, client services, or a similar client\-facing role
* Strong written communication — you can write clean, clear website copy and client emails alike
* Comfortable learning and working inside a CMS (WordPress experience a plus)
* Organized and able to juggle multiple client accounts and priorities at once
* Healthcare, agency, or web services background is a plus, not a requirement
