jobs.title: Assistant Clinical Research Coordinator - Pediatric CHAMP Program
jobs.description:
The overall goal of the position is to support the developing research enterprises of the Child Health Advanced Molecular Phenotyping (CHAMP) Program, which is designed to help investigators better understand childhood disease by making high\-quality human biological samples and molecular data more accessible across UCSF.


Many serious pediatric illnesses remain difficult to explain using traditional clinical information alone. CHAMP addresses this gap by supporting the careful collection, processing, preservation, and study of biological samples from children across a wide range of diseases and clinical settings. The goal is to make it easier for researchers to connect what is happening in a child's body at the molecular and cellular level with the clinical course of illness.


CHAMP is built around two complementary goals. The first is to create a coordinated infrastructure for collecting biofluids and tissues from willing participants, especially children with severe, rare, or poorly understood diseases. Whenever possible, samples are obtained from the sites most relevant to disease and are processed using protocols designed to preserve their value for both current and future technologies.


The second goal is to pair these samples with advanced molecular profiling platforms that can generate detailed information about immune responses, gene expression, cellular states, antibodies, pathogens, and other features of disease biology. These data can then be used by investigators across UCSF to generate new hypotheses, identify disease mechanisms, and ultimately improve diagnosis and treatment for children.


CHAMP operates under IRB\-approved protocols that allow collection of human biofluids and tissues, including biopsy and post\-mortem specimens, across organ systems and age groups. The program has developed workflows for rapid processing, cryopreservation, and live cell preservation so that valuable samples can be studied with the best available technologies.


The Assistant Clinical Research Coordinator will perform independently or with general direction at the fully operational journey level of the series to execute, manage, and coordinate research protocols, as directed by the Clinical Research Supervisor and/or Principal Investigator (PI); may coordinate the data collection and operations of two concurrent clinical research studies under the guidelines of research protocols, UCSF and regulating agency policies.


Duties may include, but will not be limited to supporting the management and coordinating the tasks of single or multiple clinical research studies, depending on their size and complexity; act as intermediary between services and departments while overseeing data and specimen management; manage and report on study results; create, clean, update, and manage databases and comprehensive datasets and reports; manage Investigator’s protocols in the Committee on Human Research online system, as well as renewals and modifications of protocol applications and the implementation of new studies; participate in the review and writing of protocols to ensure institutional review board approval within University compliance; help assure compliance with all relevant regulatory agencies; oversee study data integrity; implement and maintain periodic quality control procedures; interface with departments to obtain UCSF approval prior to study initiation; maintain all regulatory documents; report study progress to investigators; participate in any internal and external audits or reviews of study protocols; and perform other duties as assigned.


  
Required Qualifications:


* High School Diploma; or equivalent experience
* Excellent verbal and written communications and presentation skills ; excellent organizational skills; and excellent interpersonal skills to work effectively in a diverse team
* Attention to detail; strong interpersonal skills; excellent, effective verbal and written communication skills to coordinate with subjects, team members and outside institutions
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Windows
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, team\-based environment; project management and coordination skills; ability to prioritize tasks and meet multiple deadlines on concurrent projects
Ability to establish cooperative working relationships with patients, co\-workers, \& physicians

Avive Solutions, Inc. (https://avive.life) is a growth stage Automated External Defibrillator (AED) company with a connected response system that is rapidly gaining market share. We are a mission driven team that is quite literally saving lives. Sudden Cardiac Arrest (SCA) is a leading cause of death in the United States, and we are on a mission to change that! We are a dynamic organization that builds elegant, creative solutions to solve complex problems. Ultimately, our mission is for all cardiac arrest victims to have rapid access to life\-saving defibrillation.

Avive is taking a fresh approach to addressing this decades\-old problem by innovating AED technology, coupled with a first\-of\-its\-kind software platform solution to enable a quicker and more streamlined response to SCA emergencies. We believe that this unique combination of deploying advanced – yet still accessible – hardware, and software, has the potential to revolutionize out\-of\-hospital cardiac arrest response and massively impact SCA survival rates.

Check out this short video that shows a glimpse of how our team is working to re\-think cardiac arrest response and save lives! https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=2p4zfOWo62E

Learn more about working at Avive: https://avive.life/careers/

**About the Role:**
The Events \& Field Marketing Coordinator supports the successful execution of Avive's trade show, field marketing, training, and sales enablement programs. This hands\-on role owns the logistics, inventory management, shipping, and operational coordination that keep Avive's events and field marketing programs running smoothly. Working closely with the Events Marketing Manager, Growth Marketing Managers, Operations, and Sales, this individual ensures people, materials, equipment, and event assets are organized, available, and delivered on time. This role thrives in a fast\-paced environment and adapts quickly to changing priorities.
### **What You'll Do:**



Event Logistics and Scheduling


* Support logistics and operational activities for trade shows, conferences, field activations, and company events.
* Cross\-check the Asana trade show request board against the master schedule and staff calendars to identify conflicts or missing information.
* Prepare event materials and coordinate shipping, tracking, and status updates.
* Support on\-site event setup, execution, and teardown as needed.
* Coordinate post\-event returns, inventory updates, and shipment reconciliation.
* Coordinate printing and production of marketing materials.

  



Field Equipment Management


* Coordinate loaner AED requests and manage Avive's fleet of AEDs, CPR manikins, and other field and training equipment.
* Maintain equipment schedules and availability for trade shows, field activations, trainings, customer demonstrations, and other engagements.
* Maintain field equipment in a constant state of readiness, including device charging, REALConnect fleet management, cleaning, maintenance, and replacement.
* Coordinate packing, shipment, and return of field equipment, ensuring assets are tracked, inspected, accounted for, and prepared for future use.
* Coordinate marketing\-owned AED donations and supporting logistics.

  



Inventory and Shipping


* Manage the storage and inventory of swag, collateral, trade show materials, booth supplies, staff apparel, and field activation materials.
* Maintain organized storage areas and conduct periodic inventory audits to ensure accuracy.
* Coordinate inbound and outbound shipments for Marketing, Sales, and channel partners, maintaining accurate tracking information.
* Monitor inventory levels and coordinate replenishment, repair, or replacement as needed.
* Support outbound and return shipping for events and field activations.

  



Booth and Event Operations


* Attend trade shows and other in\-person marketing events to support the commercial team and engage prospects.
* Assemble event kits and activation materials.
* Support field activations, CPR/AED trainings, customer events, product demonstrations, and event logistics.
* Represent Avive professionally while supporting customers, prospects, and partners at events.

  



Marketing Operations Support


* Fulfill marketing requests from Sales and support preparation of materials for meetings, trainings, and customer presentations.
* Coordinate printing and production of marketing collateral and swag.
* Maintain marketing storage areas and organizational systems.
### **Required Skills \& Experience:**

* 1–3 years of experience in event coordination, marketing operations, field marketing, logistics, or a related role.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Event Management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.
* Willingness to travel approximately 15–25% for trade shows and field events.

### **Bonus Points For:**

* Experience supporting trade shows, conferences, field marketing programs, or customer events.
* Experience coordinating inventory, shipping, fulfillment, or equipment logistics.
* Experience coordinating vendors, shipments, or event logistics across multiple stakeholders.
* Familiarity with project management tools such as Asana.
* Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a customer\-service mindset.
* Self\-motivated with the ability to work independently and proactively solve problems.
* Flexible and adaptable in a fast\-paced environment with changing priorities.
* Experience working with CRM or marketing platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar systems.

jobs.title: Development Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Reports to:** Executive Director

**Employment Type:** Hourly non\-exempt

**Location:** Onsite at Circus Center (755 Frederick Street, San Francisco)

**Compensation:** $30/hour

**Benefits:** PTO, sick time, commuter benefits, and discounts on classes

**Job Type:** Part\-Time, \~25 hours/week

**Position Summary**

The Development Coordinator is responsible for advancing Circus Center's fundraising, donor relations, grant management, and government contract administration. This role leads the organization's annual end\-of\-year campaign, researches and submits grant applications, manages funder relationships, maintains the donor database, and serves as the primary administrator for the San Francisco Department of Children, Youth, and Their Families (DCYF) contract. The position works closely with the Executive Director, Director of Community Engagement, Marketing Director, Board members, and external partners to support the organization's financial sustainability and mission\-driven goals.

**Key Responsibilities**

Fundraising and Donor Engagement

* Lead the planning and execution of the annual end\-of\-year fundraising campaign, including strategy development, timeline management, and donor segmentation.
* Track fundraising progress and campaign performance against established goals; prepare regular reports for the Executive Director and Board.
* Maintain and strengthen donor relationships through personalized communication, stewardship, and engagement activities.
* Prepare donor acknowledgment letters, impact reports, fundraising updates, and other donor communications.
* Develop materials to support board solicitations and fundraising outreach.
* Assist in the development of long\-term fundraising strategy in collaboration with the Executive Director and Board.

Grants and Sponsorships

* Research and track prospective foundation, corporate, and government funding opportunities aligned with organizational priorities.
* Write, compile, and submit grant applications, proposals, letters of inquiry, and supporting materials.
* Develop grant application budgets in coordination with the Executive Director and accounting consultant.
* Manage grant compliance and reporting, including reimbursement requests for government contracts such as DCYF and Grants for the Arts.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned funders; monitor communications and respond to inquiries in a timely manner.

Database and Administrative Support

* Maintain accurate and complete donor records in the donor management system (Keela).
* Generate reports to track donor profiles, giving history, engagement levels, campaign success, and pledge fulfillment.
* Manage pledge tracking and follow\-up to ensure timely contributions.
* Provide administrative support to the Executive Director as needed for donor relations.

Communications

* Collaborate with the Marketing Director to draft donor\-facing communications, including emails, letters, and campaign materials.
* Prepare and distribute donor correspondence, acknowledgments, and fundraising appeals.

DCYF Contract Administration

* The Development Coordinator serves as the primary administrator for the DCYF contract, ensuring compliance, accurate reporting, and effective coordination across internal and external stakeholders.
* Prepare and submit monthly invoices and reimbursement requests for DCYF\-eligible expenses.
* Gather and organize all invoices and financial documentation for transactions to be allocated to the DCYF contract.
* Communicate with the Fiscal Program Specialist to address questions, provide supporting information, and resolve issues.
* Coordinate with the accounting consultant to obtain general ledger and expense detail; ensure DCYF expense reporting aligns with actual organizational costs.
* Partner with the Director of Community Engagement to develop the DCYF workplan in the Contract Management System (CMS), including key programming, services, projections, performance measures, and program budget.
* Maintain the DCYF Contract Management System (CMS), including updates to the workplan, program activities, and participant data.
* Draft participant forms and coordinate with partner sites to collect required participant data for group activities.
* Work with the Director of Community Engagement, Executive Director, accountant, and other staff to compile records and documentation for fiscal compliance reviews.
* Coordinate with program sites to align programming dates, confirm site contracts, and ensure consistent communication regarding scheduling and activity details.

**Qualifications**

Required Qualifications

● Experience: 2\-3 years of professional experience in a nonprofit development, fundraising, or grant writing role

● Grant \& Fundraising Skills: Proven experience in writing, submitting, and managing grants from foundations, corporations, and government entities, including compliance and reporting

● Technical Skills: Strong skills in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook)

● Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills for drafting proposals, donor correspondence, and reports, and for building relationships with funders

● Organizational Skills: Strong organizational and time\-management skills to manage multiple projects with competing deadlines, such as the end\-of\-year campaign and various grant cycles.

**Preferred Qualifications**

● Education: A Bachelor's degree in a related field such as Communications, Nonprofit Management, Business, or English

● Government Contract Experience: Experience administering a government contract or grant, specifically in managing compliance, invoicing, and reporting requirements

● Specific Industry Knowledge: Experience working in a performing arts, arts education, or similarly mission\-driven nonprofit organization

● Database Management: Previous experience with the Keela platform or a similar CRM used for donor tracking and reporting

● Budgeting

jobs.title: Client Services Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**


The Client Services Coordinator supports the Ophthalmic Society \& Global Relations team by coordinating and administering programs and operations for managed society and SF Match clients. Serving as a primary point of contact for applicants, training programs, medical schools, managed societies, members, and other customers, this role provides responsive service by phone, email, and in person; processes applications and required documentation; maintains accurate databases and records; supports enrollment, registration, and renewal activities; and escalates service issues to management when appropriate. The coordinator also contributes to program, meeting, interview, and event logistics while helping identify opportunities to improve workflows and service delivery.

**Role and Responsibilities**

**1\. Client Support**

* Manage assigned client programs and projects.
* Support new projects and workflow improvements in collaboration with management and team members.
* Complete and maintain required client documentation.
* Maintain website content as assigned and review content against requirements, reporting inconsistencies as directed.
* Produce e\-blast layouts and distributions.
* Create, extract, and produce data or spreadsheet reports for approved projects, studies, or client needs.
* Contact clients for follow\-up information and relay relevant information to the appropriate internal teams as directed.
**2\. Customer Relations**

* Support customers and members by email, phone, and in person, researching questions to provide accurate responses.
* Serve as the primary and initial point of contact for inquiries.
* Liaise between internal teams, managers, and staff to support effective communication and streamlined processes.
* With management direction, help identify process improvement opportunities and communicate findings and proposed solutions across teams.
**3\. Database Management**

* Coordinate and assist with multiple databases simultaneously, including data entry and updates, payments and revenue processing, registration, dues, products, record updates, and prescribed data\-cleanup procedures.
* Maintain accurate database records and coordinate information changes to programs, administrative offices, or client information as directed.
* Manage product and meeting builds.
* Recommend strategies for improved processes and procedures.
* Support accounting\-related tasks, including processing and closing batches.
**4\. Enrollment \& Renewal Management**

* Manage renewal and enrollment processes for client programs, including membership, registration, or match participation, as applicable.
* Produce meeting, membership, financial, and product inventory reports.
* Coordinate membership projects and committee activities.
* Coordinate and oversee membership application processes.
**5\. Program and Event Support**

* Coordinate logistics such as shipments, materials, and scheduling for assigned client meetings, interviews, or program events.
* Coordinate and process registrations for meetings, interviews, or program events.
* Assist with pre\-event, onsite or virtual, and post\-event management and operations.
* Support program planning activities, including agendas, participants, and materials.
* Coordinate exhibitors or vendors, including marketing, floor plans or logistics, registration, and onsite needs, when applicable.
* Manage onsite or virtual registration and check\-in activities for assigned clients.
* Prepare meeting minutes or summaries as assigned.
* Support processes for abstracts, grants, awards, or application/interview review committees, when applicable.
* Coordinate program planning committee activities, including participants, scheduling, materials, logistics, and reports, when applicable.
**Qualifications, Skills, and Education Requirements**

* Strong administrative and customer service experience, with professional verbal and written communication skills and the ability to work effectively with leadership, staff, member volunteers, applicants, customers, and external partners.
* Experience with database maintenance and record keeping, report preparation, data accuracy, project coordination, and managing a high volume of detailed work; ability to protect confidential client and match\-related information is essential.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and Adobe Acrobat Professional; experience creating reports in Excel and working with database or CRM platforms such as Personify or Salesforce is valuable. Experience with website maintenance, electronic surveys, listservs, or e\-blasts is beneficial.
* Previous experience with nonprofit membership associations, the meeting industry, academic medicine, residency recruitment, or other public\-facing service environments is preferred. Bachelor's degree preferred, or two years of equivalent experience.
* Ability to work a San Francisco hybrid schedule (40\-60% in office) and travel to 2\-5 out\-of\-state meetings per year, including weekend travel; trips generally range from 3 to 8 days.
**Compensation and Benefits**
-----------------------------

**Salary: $83,404 annually**


Salary listed reflects compensation for San Francisco\-based hybrid employees. Compensation may vary based on geographic location, experience, and internal equity considerations.

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator
jobs.description:
### **Role Summary**


Are you an organized, collaborative Human Resources professional who thrives in a fast\-paced environment? We are seeking an engaging Talent Acquisition Coordinator to support our Talent Management team with full\-cycle recruiting and onboarding operations! In this key role, you will work under the direction of the Talent Acquisition Manager and partner directly with Talent Acquisition Specialists, Recruiters, and hiring managers. You will manage the new hire experience from offer acceptance through initial onboarding and New Hire Orientation (NHO). Additionally, you will oversee Applicant Tracking System (ATS) operations, process requisition workflows, track recruiting expenses, and facilitate manager hiring trainings. If you are passionate about delivering top\-tier customer service, managing HR data with accuracy, and creating a seamless candidate journey, this position offers an inspiring opportunity to grow your HR career!

### **Duties \& Responsibilities**

#### **Candidate Onboarding \& Orientation**

* Serve as the primary liaison to new hires following offer acceptance, ensuring consistent and complete pre\-onboarding communication.
* Ensure all hiring forms and onboarding requirements are fully completed prior to the new team member's first day.
* Facilitate New Hire Orientation (NHO), including coordinating all logistics to prepare and finalize the orientation program.
* Manage e\-filing systems and oversee the creation of compliant electronic employee files.
* Cross\-train regularly on basic HR partner responsibilities to support clients as needed, including managing Day 1 Onboarding workflows (e.g., completing the Form I\-9 process and collecting required paperwork).
* Own newly opened or aged requisitions from inception through closure.
* Conduct requisition intake reviews for accuracy, manage timely approvals, consult with hiring managers, and coordinate with recruiters for job board postings.
* Serve as the primary point of contact to recruiters and participate in weekly recruiting calls to review search status, interview progress, and filled roles.
* Review and process Offer Authorization Request forms through required HR approval steps.
* Conduct compensation research, recommend rates as needed, track declined offers due to pay, and share data anomalies with the Compensation and Recruiting teams.
* Ensure all candidate applications are properly dispositioned and filled requisitions are closed in a timely manner.
* Manage and maintain the Applicant Tracking System (ATS)—ensuring data accuracy, cleanliness, and timely website postings, while recommending process enhancements.
* Perform accurate data entry into the Human Resources Information System (HRIS).
* Facilitate training sessions for hiring managers, recruiters, and interview panels to ensure consistent, legal, and fair applicant evaluation processes.
* Review and code monthly vendor invoices and maintain the central Recruiting expense tracker.
* Maintain regular communication with key internal and external stakeholders regarding search progress and priorities.
* Help plan, execute, and participate in community recruiting events.
* Document and maintain Talent Acquisition policies and procedures to ensure compliance with applicable employment laws and regulations.
* Participate in special HR projects and initiatives as assigned.
* Other duties as assigned.

### **Required Qualifications**

#### **Education \& Experience**

* **Education:** High School Diploma or GED equivalent.
* **Work Experience:** Minimum of two (2\) or more years of related Human Resources and/or office administration experience.

#### **Key Skills \& Abilities**

* **Language Skills:** Proficiency in English paired with bilingual fluency (verbal and written) in eithe**r Chinese or Spanish.**
* **Software Proficiency:** Proficient computer skills, including Microsoft Word and Excel; experience maintaining data accurately in an HRIS and Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
* **Organizational \& Prioritization Skills:** Exceptional organizational skills, strong attention to detail, and proven prioritization abilities to manage multi\-task demands in a fast\-paced setting.
* **Communication \& Interpersonal Skills:** Excellent written, verbal, and phone communication skills with stellar customer service capabilities for every internal and external partner.
* **Problem\-Solving \& Discretion:** Strong administrative problem\-solving skills, critical thinking, initiative, and the ability to handle confidential details and ambiguity.
* **Event Logistics \& Teamwork:** Experience in event/meeting planning, participation, and facilitation, with a strong comfort level working within a collaborative team.

### **Desired Qualifications**

* Experience with recruiting expense tracking, invoice processing, or HR compliance documentation.
* Prior experience delivering or supporting manager\-level HR training modules.

### **Location and Work Type**

* **Work Type:** Full\-Time, Non\-Exempt Position (40 hours per week).
* **Work Setting:** Hybrid Model (2 days per week on\-site)
* **Schedule:** Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM.
* **Physical \& Travel Requirements:** Occasional local travel within the SF Bay Area (up to 25 lbs. lifting capability required for recruiting event setup).

**If you're interested, please reply to this advertisement or directly email your resume to me at DSalgado@teemagroup.com or by calling/texting (949\) 295\-5951\.**  

**I strive to reply within 48 hours. Looking forward to connecting with you soon. Thank you!**


\#Workwolf

We are seeking an experienced and results\-driven **Support Account Manager** to join our team. Your mission will be to drive the adoption and technical success of the Betterworks solution, acting as the primary point of contact for all product support issues. jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Alex**
--------------


Alex is the AI recruiter for hiring great people.


Alex interviews, screens, and schedules every candidate – over voice, video, and text – so talent teams hire more great people, faster, without adding TA headcount. The recruiter stays in control: every shortlist is approved by a human, and every relationship and offer is owned by the customer's team.


We're past 1M\+ interviews, integrate with 33\+ ATS platforms, and 96% of candidates prefer interviewing with Alex. We're revenue\-generating, well\-funded, backed by premier investors, and are focused on enterprise customers: selling to VPs of Talent Acquisition, CHROs, and CFOs at large employers who are rethinking how hiring gets done at scale.

**About the Role**
------------------


Every Alex account is run by a pair. A Forward\-Deployed Engineer owns the technical deployment — the ATS integration, the workflows, the support queue. You own the relationship and the revenue. You're joining the AM team early, and your input will shape the function. This role is based in office in San Francisco.


You'll carry a book of accounts: retaining and growing revenue, deepening the relationship, and finding the strategic expansion paths.

* **Own NRR for your book** — renewals end to end, plus the upsells and expansions that grow an account past its initial booking.
* **Multi\-thread the relationship** — exec sponsors, champions, and the recruiters using Alex daily, so a single departure doesn't take the account with it.
* **Drive adoption** — onboard users, run trainings, and watch usage closely enough to spot which teams need a nudge before it surfaces in a renewal.
* **Build the business case, inside and out** — arm your champion to sell Alex to their own leadership, then turn those wins into case studies that help close the next deal.
* **Lead QBRs with business stakeholders**, using usage data and our roadmap to open expansion paths. Set success criteria at kickoff so renewals confirm next steps rather than force them.
* **Work the pair with engineering** — route technical asks to your FDE rather than absorbing them, and pass expansion signals back the other way.

**About You**
-------------

* 5\+ years in Account Management, Customer Success with a revenue number, or an AE carrying a renewal and expansion book, at a SaaS company. You can name the target you carried and how you hit it.
* You've owned renewals end to end — timeline, pricing, negotiation, close — and you're comfortable asking for money.
* You've gotten a customer's team to change how they work, not just gotten a contract signed.
* Credible with executives and with recruiters on the same day.
* Technically fluent, not technically hands\-on: you can hold a real conversation about an ATS integration and know when to bring in your FDE.
* A data\-driven storyteller: you act on usage metrics before a renewal is at risk, and turn a customer win into collateral that helps win the next one.
* A commercially confident builder: you'd rather have the pricing conversation early than let it sit, and you’re excited to build playbooks for this function at you go.
* Bonus: experience at a high\-growth startup.


This might not be the role for you if you prefer a support role without a number attached, or you don't want to work in person. We're in office in SF 5 days a week.

**What's in it for you?**
-------------------------

* Shape the foundation of our Account Management org, with an engineer paired with you on every account you run.
* Competitive compensation, equity, and growth potential.
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance, unlimited PTO, company\-paid team lunches, a beautiful office in SF, and great company events.


If you've gotten this far and our culture resonates with you, we want you to apply. Your first conversation will be with Alex, our AI recruiter.


Compensation Range: $150K \- $200K

jobs.title: Influencer Marketing Associate (College Grad 2027)
jobs.description:
**About Solace**
----------------


Healthcare in the U.S. is fundamentally broken. The system is so complex that 88% of U.S. adults do not have the health literacy necessary to navigate it without help. Solace cuts through the red tape of healthcare by pairing patients with expert advocates and giving them the tools to make better decisions—and get better outcomes.


We're a Series C startup, founded in 2022 and backed by Inspired Capital, Craft Ventures, Torch Capital, Menlo Ventures, Signalfire, and IVP. Our U.S. based team is lean, mission\-driven, and growing quickly.


Solace isn't a place to coast. We're here to redefine healthcare—and that demands urgency, precision, and heart. If you're looking to stretch yourself, sharpen your edge, and do the best work of your life alongside a team that cares deeply, you're in the right place. We’re intense, and we like it that way.

***Read more in our Bloomberg funding announcement*** ***here******.***

**About the Role**
------------------


As an Influencer Marketing Associate at Solace, you'll help the team find great creators, build strong working relationships, and keep influencer campaigns moving from outreach through launch and reporting. This is an early\-career role for a recent graduate who understands internet culture, communicates well, and is excited to learn how creator marketing works behind the scenes.


You don't need years of agency or talent\-management experience. You do need strong judgment, excellent follow\-through, and genuine curiosity about creators and the communities they build. You'll learn from experienced marketers while taking on meaningful execution work from day one.


Because Solace works in healthcare, you'll also learn how to create compelling marketing while handling patient stories, claims, disclosures, approvals, and sensitive information with care.

**This is a hybrid in person role in our Redwood City office, 3 days a week.**

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Creator Research \& Outreach**

* Research creators across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, podcasts, newsletters, and other emerging channels based on audience fit, content quality, credibility, and campaign goals.
* Build creator shortlists and organize relevant information such as audience, content style, contact details, prior partnerships, and performance signals.
* Support creator outreach using approved messaging and keep responses, follow\-ups, and next steps organized.
* Stay close to creator culture and surface new voices, formats, trends, and conversations that may be relevant to Solace.

### **Campaign Coordination**

* Help turn campaign strategy into clear creator briefs, timelines, deliverable lists, and launch trackers.
* Coordinate scheduling, content submissions, review rounds, approvals, and go\-live dates across multiple creators.
* Maintain accurate records for contracts, usage rights, deliverables, payment status, contact history, and campaign notes.
* Perform an initial check of submitted content against the brief, required disclosures, format requirements, and approved messaging before escalating for final review.
* Flag missed deadlines, unclear deliverables, or other campaign risks early and help the team resolve them.

### **Performance \& Team Support**

* Pull basic campaign metrics and organize results so the team can see which creators, messages, and formats are performing.
* Help prepare campaign recaps and document learnings for future creator selection and briefs.
* Keep the influencer roster, campaign trackers, folders, and Notion pages clean and current.
* Coordinate with brand, creative, performance, partnerships, legal, and compliance teams when campaigns require additional review or support.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* 0–2 years of relevant experience. Internships, student organizations, your own content, freelance projects, campus ambassador work, talent or entertainment experience, and side projects all count.
* You are genuinely interested in creators, social platforms, digital culture, and why certain content earns trust and attention.
* You are highly organized and can keep many small details moving without losing track of deadlines.
* You write clear, warm, professional messages and understand that every creator interaction represents the Solace brand.
* You have good judgment and know when to move something forward independently versus when to ask for help.
* You take feedback well, make changes quickly, and do not get defensive when a first draft needs work.

jobs.title: BDR Hunter US
jobs.description:
**About Trustero**


Trustero is the AI\-driven advisor for Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC). Powered by a patented multi\-agent AI architecture and our proprietary Trust Graph, Trustero automates evidence collection, control monitoring, gap analysis, and security questionnaire response — helping security, compliance, and risk teams get and stay audit\-ready across frameworks like SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, HITRUST, NIST, PCI DSS, SOX, and more. Enterprise, mid\-market, and MSSPs use Trustero to turn GRC from a manual, reactive burden into a continuous, AI\-powered program. Learn more at trustero.com.

**The Role**


Trustero is hiring a Business Development Representative (BDR) to fuel our top\-of\-funnel pipeline growth across the US and EU territories. This is a pure hunter role — you will be responsible for sourcing, mapping, and opening doors at target enterprise and mid\-market accounts. You’ll engage security, compliance, risk, and IT leaders (CISOs, Heads of GRC, VPs of Security) who are actively seeking ways to modernize and scale their GRC programs through AI.


This is a high\-impact, high\-visibility role for an ambitious pipeline builder who thrives on multi\-channel cold outreach, strategic account mapping, and qualifying high\-value sales opportunities in a fast\-moving market.

**What You'll Do**

* Prospect and generate qualified sales meetings/opportunities through outbound multi\-channel outreach (cold email, cold calling, LinkedIn, and video touchpoints).
* Own the initial stages of the sales funnel, mapping target accounts and identifying key decision\-makers across security, compliance, risk, and IT departments.
* Conduct initial discovery conversations to evaluate fit, pain points, and buyer readiness, effectively qualifying leads before handing them off to Account Executives.
* Build a solid baseline understanding of buyers' compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, NIST, PCI DSS, SOX, GDPR) to articulate how Trustero’s multi\-agent AI delivers ROI and continuous audit readiness.
* Partner closely with Enterprise Account Executives to execute strategic account\-based marketing (ABM) strategies and targeted territory campaigns.
* Maintain rigorous CRM hygiene, tracking touchpoints, account intelligence, and opportunity handoffs in Salesforce/HubSpot.
* Represent Trustero at virtual events and industry webinars, following up rapidly on leads to convert interest into qualified meetings.
* Consistently meet or exceed monthly/quarterly targets for qualified meetings set and opportunities generated.

 **What We're Looking For**

* Proven hunter mentality: a track record of high\-volume, quality outbound prospecting and self\-sourcing meetings in B2B tech/SaaS.
* 1–3 years of outbound business development or sales development experience (SDR/BDR), ideally within cybersecurity, GRC/compliance, or enterprise software.
* Demonstrated ability to navigate complex enterprise org charts and comfortably initiate conversations with executive buyers (CISO, CCO, VP/Head of GRC).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with an ability to deliver concise, compelling value propositions.
* Familiarity with modern sales engagement platforms (e.g., Outreach, Salesloft, Apollo) and CRM platforms.
* Relentless curiosity, high emotional intelligence, and resilience in handling objections and building dynamic cold touchpoints.
* Fluency in English required; additional European languages (e.g., German, French) are a major plus for EU territory coverage.

**Nice to Have**

* Prior experience prospecting for AI\-native, cybersecurity, or SaaS compliance platforms.
* Basic understanding of GRC frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, etc.) or security workflows.
* Experience running account\-based outbound motions against Fortune 2000 or mid\-market accounts.

We enhance business productivity by enabling our clients to outsource their HR function to one strategic partner and allowing them to focus on operating and growing their core businesses. Our full\-service HR solutions include features such as payroll processing, human capital consulting, employment law compliance and employee benefits, including health insurance, retirement plans and workers’ compensation insurance.  

  

TriNet has a nationwide presence and an experienced executive team. Our stock is publicly traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol TNET. If you’re passionate about innovation and making an impact on the large SMB market, come join us as we power our clients’ business success with extraordinary HR.  

  

**Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that many potential applicants discourage themselves from applying to jobs unless they meet every single requirement. TriNet always strives to hire the most qualified candidate for a particular role, ensuring we deliver outstanding results for our small and medium\-size customers. So, if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every single qualification in the job description, nobody’s perfect – and we encourage you to apply. This role, coupled with TriNet emphasis on continuous learning and defined career paths, will lay the foundation for a successful sales career. If you are somebody looking to accelerate your sales development career with a high growth, stable company and rewarding mission, then come join us!  

  

**What you will do**

* Bachelor's Degree preferred

**Skills and Abilities**

Minimal

jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager
jobs.description:
Epicus Group is a professional project and construction management firm providing owner’s representative consulting services, including workplace strategy, capital program planning, and facilities management. Our work spans the Life Sciences, Energy, and Government sectors, where we deliver comprehensive management and advisory services. We serve as an unbiased advocate for our clients, providing leadership and strategic guidance to navigate complex real estate challenges while minimizing risk and maximizing outcomes.

As we continue to expand our portfolio of exciting projects in Northern California, we are seeking a passionate Assistant Project Manager to join our growing team and deliver exceptional outcomes for our clients. This role will help lead capital projects as the owner’s representative, bringing comprehensive knowledge of the real estate development lifecycle, approval processes, and regulatory requirements.

The Assistant Project Manager will support the development and maintenance of strong client relationships, serving as a key point of coordination for internal stakeholders and external partners. In this role, you will assist in facilitating clear communication, contributing to strategic decision\-making, and supporting efforts to enhance the performance of the client’s real estate assets. If you thrive in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment, bring a proactive and detail\-oriented mindset, and are passionate about delivering exceptional results while growing within a forward\-thinking firm, we invite you to join Epicus Group.

**Your Role:** 

As an Assistant Project Manager, you will interface with Epicus clients and project teams through a successful process of strategic real estate planning, design, and construction of new buildings, tenant improvement buildouts, and facilities assignments. Some of the ways you will support our projects are:

* Support all phases of capital projects, including planning, design, construction, and close\-out, ensuring successful delivery within scope, budget, and schedule.
* Assist with stakeholder engagement, needs assessments, qualitative program reviews, business case development, and entitlement management to define and verify project goals and objectives.
* Serve as the key point of coordination between clients, architects, engineers, contractors, consultants, and city officials, fostering strong partnerships and effective collaboration throughout the project lifecycle.
* Support procurement efforts for design, construction, peer reviews, and specialty consultant services, including drafting scopes, evaluating proposals, negotiating contracts, and authorizing contract execution and purchase orders.
* Assist in preparing and implementing the project execution plan, project kick\-off activities, meetings, presentations, and ongoing project communications to ensure alignment with client objectives and company goals.
* Support the design and construction phases, including oversight of architectural and engineering drawings, bid documents, contractor coordination, and agency approvals to ensure program, budget, and schedule conformance.
* Provide construction administration support, including oversight of meetings, progress reporting, RFIs, submittals, cost control, schedule management, FF\&E coordination, and contractor performance.
* Track and monitor project budgets and schedules using web\-based project controls; perform meaningful financial and schedule analysis and proactively identify and resolve potential risks, changes, or impacts.
* Assist in organizing and evaluating value engineering alternatives in collaboration with owners and design teams to support financial and performance objectives.
* Support project administration, including resource planning, contract compliance, forecasting, invoicing, progress draw reviews, issue resolution, and strategic decision\-making.
* Coordinate architects’ review of contractor and vendor onsite activities to verify compliance with contractual documents, design intent, schedules, and workmanship standards.
* Observe and report on construction activities and construction\-related issues, ensuring timely escalation and resolution.
* Coordinate and document project meetings; clearly communicate project status, risks, and mitigation strategies to stakeholders.
* Support and collaborate with Project Managers and internal team members, contributing to accountability, performance development, and achievement of project milestones.
* Assist with project close\-out process, ensuring all deliverables, documentation, financial reconciliation, and contractual requirements are completed successfully.
* Support business development efforts, including leading RFQ/RFP responses, proposal development, presentations, interviews, and contract negotiations, and ensuring a seamless transition from business development to project execution
* Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities to strengthen brand presence and support business development initiatives.

**Qualifications:**

* Minimum 3 years of experience
* Bachelor’s or associate degree in engineering, architecture, construction management, business, or related field.
* Certification as a Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified Construction Manager (CCM) or LEED AP is desired.
* Experience in the Northern California market, having strong relationships with clients, design firms, general contractors, and stakeholders
* Knowledge of the real estate development lifecycle, approval processes, and regulations, from programming, entitlement and design through construction and operations.
* Highly motivated, ambitious and demonstrated business acumen, with a track record of exceeding targets. Expert at building relationships and earning trust.
* Detail\-oriented and analytical, excellent communication skills, strong organization and time management skills, and ability to operate independently.
* Advanced MS Office

jobs.title: Project Coordinator

**Who You Are**



You are a highly organized, detail\-oriented project professional who enjoys bringing structure, clarity, and follow\-through to complex work. You are comfortable coordinating multiple priorities, maintaining accurate project information, communicating with a variety of stakeholders, and identifying issues before they become larger problems. You take ownership of your commitments, learn quickly, and bring a collaborative, client\-focused mindset to every interaction.


**About The Role**



As a Project Coordinator within the Project Management Office (PMO), you will support Project Managers and Program Managers in the planning, coordination, tracking, and successful delivery of client\-facing technology projects. You will help maintain accurate project schedules, documentation, action items, risks, dependencies, financial information, and status reporting so project teams and stakeholders have timely visibility into progress and emerging concerns. This role is well suited for someone who can balance detail\-oriented administrative execution with proactive communication, sound judgment, and a desire to grow within project management.


**Must be based in the United States of America.** The role may support multiple projects, clients, and internal teams simultaneously and may occasionally coordinate with stakeholders across different time zones.


**Other responsibilities include:**


* Support Project Managers and Program Managers with project planning, coordination, tracking, and follow\-through from initiation through closeout.
* Maintain accurate project schedules, milestones, deliverables, action items, decision logs, risk registers, dependency trackers, and other project controls.

The Office of Livable Streets (OLS) is tasked with prioritizing strategic planning, community engagement, research, policy, design, implementation, and long\-term management. Their goal is to create streets that are livable, supporting safety, accessibility, inclusion, resiliency, active modes, community cohesion, and economic vitality citywide. Additionally, they aim to enhance New York City's pedestrian, bicycle, and micromobility networks, providing comfortable, connected, green, and reliable transportation options across the five boroughs. They place special emphasis on Priority Investment Areas, mode shift, and reimagining streets. The office also develops innovative new programs, design typologies, project delivery, and analysis tools to meet the demands of a rapidly changing population with evolving needs and technologies.

The candidates will prepare design presentations and graphics for community meetings, stakeholder engagement, and internal coordination.

Together with the Director of Business Operations and the Program Manager, the Project Coordinator supports a diverse range of high\-visibility projects, from initiation to completion, ensuring alignment with organizational goals. These include development and implementation of dashboards and research administration process reengineering. This role involves organizing and coordinating resources, taking meeting minutes, tracking deliverables, and maintaining schedules across multiple teams for projects of varying complexity.

Effective oral, written, communication, interpersonal skills. jobs.title: PALS Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**ORGANIZATION OVERVIEW**



Founded in 1980, Urban Resource Institute (URI) is the nation’s largest provider of domestic violence shelter services and a leader in supporting homeless families. Operating 24 shelters across New York City, URI provides 3,700 beds nightly in purpose\-built shelters that offer trauma\-informed services including counseling, childcare, case management, and more. URI’s Justice Initiatives extend support beyond shelter, offering programs in economic empowerment, legal advocacy, youth prevention, and abusive partner intervention. URI also develops permanent affordable housing as part of its long\-term commitment to safety, stability, and healing.


**POSITION OVERVIEW**



The position supports families participating in the PALS program by assessing and addressing animal welfare needs throughout their shelter stay. Responsibilities include coordinating veterinary and behavioral services, providing pet welfare education, assisting clients with pet\-friendly resources and housing options, and collaborating with shelter staff and community partners.


**Salary: $49,000**


**MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**


* Conduct comprehensive assessments for families seeking shelter and participation in PALS and offer ongoing support to ensure animal welfare issues are addressed, including assisting with safety planning, ensuring access to appropriate pet supplies, addressing medical needs, and overseeing the discharge planning process.
* Work closely with shelter staff and community partners to coordinate timely access to veterinary care for pets, including a vet exam, spay/neuter, vaccinations, micro\-chipping, basic care, and treatment related to animal abuse.
* Conduct preliminary pet assessments for animal behavior concerns and coordinate access to behavior therapy, where appropriate. Provide ongoing pet welfare education to clients, including an initial PALS orientation, case conferences and individual and group counseling, to support the continuum of care for adults, children and pets residing in shelter.
* Assist clients to identify and access “pet friendly” practices, including obtaining orders of protections for pets, exploring suitable temporary or permanent housing options, and addressing pet ownership issues.
* Identify, secure and monitor all necessary pet supplies and products related to PALS and oversee the inventory management process.
* In partnership with other PALS team members, coordinate and/or facilitate staff training related to animal welfare safety, including identifying signs of animal abuse, proper pet care and handling, and accessing appropriate community resources.
* Work closely with animal welfare partners to coordinate fostering, boarding and animal surrender, where appropriate.
* Represent URI at coalitions, taskforces and committees to ensure the continuation of solid collaborative approaches.
* Other duties as requested based on department, program and/or organizational needs.


**SPECIFICATIONS FOR EDUCATION/CERTIFICATIONS/LICENSES**


* High School Diploma or GED equivalent
* College Degree a plus
* Driver’s license, a plus


**REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE**


* Commitment to the vision and mission of Urban Resource Institute.
* Demonstrated sensitivity and experience with and/or knowledge of domestic violence within and against disenfranchised communities, including individuals who identify as lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer, and/or HIV\-affected, the elderly, and individuals with mental health issues.
* Experience working with the Department of Homeless Services (DHS) is a plus.
* Strong commitment to equity and social justice, including a focus on self\-awareness and engagement of continuous learning around issues of diversity, equity, and inclusion.
* Must possess a demonstrated ability in delivering client services, including communication, and listening skills, understanding of human interaction and personality development, writing, and recording case documentation.
* Proven ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
* Strong organizational skills that reflect an ability to perform and prioritize multiple tasks seamlessly and adaptable to various competing demands.
* Experience with animal sheltering and/or knowledge of companion animal welfare required.
* Knowledge of basic handling of animals, signs of animal abuse/cruelty and common animal illnesses.
* Knowledge of and interest in the link between domestic violence and animal abuse, and strong desire to be a bridge between the human welfare and animal welfare communities.
* Strong organization, engagement and inter/intra agency collaborative skills.
* Strong clinical skills, including assessment, intervention, referral and advocacy.
* Must be self\-directed and able to work independently and meet deadlines.
* Must be extremely comfortable working with Microsoft Office applications.
* Experience in program development and implementation, a plus.
* Bilingual English/Spanish, a plus.
* Occasional lifting (up to 35 pounds) and travel required.
* Acknowledge and application of self\-care and work\-life balance for self and others.
* Must have the ability to be flexible with work schedule due to program needs.


At URI we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment. We actively seek a diverse candidate pool and encourage candidates of all backgrounds and abilities to apply. **Position:** Program Specialist – Urban Agriculture


**Location:** 565 Morris Ave, Bronx, NY 10451


**Salary Range:** $30 per hour


**Hours:** 25 Hours per week


**Employment Type:** Part\-Time, Non\-Exempt


**About Us**


Founded in 1876, The Boys’ Club of New York (BCNY) is a youth development organization with the mission to empower boys and young men, ages 7 to 21, by providing effective programs and a supportive community. BCNY provides evidence\-based programs to address the evolving social, emotional, health, creative, educational, and vocational needs of our members in meaningful, lasting ways. BCNY develops programs to cultivate positive qualities in members and strives to continually deepen and broaden our impact.


**Job Summary**


We have an opportunity for a passionate and knowledgeable Program Specialist to oversee and instruct urban agriculture programming for boys ages 12\-18 years old. The Program Specialist will collaborate with the Junior Director and Teen Director to create and deliver engaging programming that supports the social, emotional, physical, and behavioral health of our Junior and Teen members via engagement with indoor and outdoor gardens and planting initiatives at our clubhouse in Mott Haven, the Bronx, as well as with partner organizations. The Program Specialist will also oversee garden maintenance such as watering schedules and regular upkeep, required to uphold quality youth programming. We are seeking a reliable, highly motivated candidate with experience in urban gardens and an interest in cultivating and ensuring green space initiatives for youth.


**Responsibilities**


* Collaborate with the Junior Director and Teen Director to plan and conduct activities for a balanced, fun, and youth\-driven program of instruction, demonstration, and practice that provides students with skills related to urban gardening and hydroponics.


* Collaborate with wellness, nutrition, and cooking programs to integrate urban agriculture content with related programming.


* Create schedules for and delegate watering and plant upkeep for clubhouse members and staff.


* Maintain inventory of tools, supplies, seeds, and equipment. Coordinate with Junior \& Teen Directors to ensure materials are replenished.


* Teach lessons to groups of 5\-10 adolescents to build skills in gardening and plant life.


* Monitor and document member attendance, engagement, and skill growth to help guide ongoing program refinement and improvement.


* Model and enforce adherence to sound health and safety practices for each member.


* Engage with members and use appropriate strategies to preemptively defuse inappropriate behavior and encourage positive interactions.


* Review instructional content, methods, and members’ performance in order to assess strengths and weaknesses, and engage in curriculum revision, development, or elimination.


* Responsible for completing and the timely submission of all program reports relative to this position, including but not limited to supply requests, lesson plans, and timesheets.


**Knowledge Skills and Abilities**


* Successfully manage projects with high standards of quality and attention to detail. Work with flexibility, efficiency, enthusiasm, and diplomacy as part of a team. Results\-oriented with a learning approach and good judgment.
* A passion for environmental conservation and green spaces
* 2 years’ experience in community gardens, greenhouses, hydroponics labs, or other sustainable sources of planted fruits/vegetables
* At least one year’s experience working with a group of school\-aged children
* Comfort with different education techniques and openness to new developments in the field
* Strong communication and organizational skills
* Ability to adapt to a changing environment and to address the varying needs of the boys in our program
* Able to manage boys individually and in groups
* Committed to a set schedule agreed upon by Clubhouse Director and Associate Clubhouse Director
* Familiarity/knowledge of Mott Haven, the Bronx, and/or the surrounding neighborhood preferred


*The Boys’ Club of New York is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other status protected by law. If you have a disability or other protected need requiring an accommodation, please contact Human Resources.*

jobs.title: Reporting & Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**  
Trusted by over 40,000 salons worldwide, Milbon has been exclusively partnering with salons and stylists for over 60 years. As the \#1 professional haircare company in Japan, with a rapidly expanding global footprint, we honor stylists for their expert skills, knowledge and professionalism. Through our continuous collaboration with stylists, we are able to find groundbreaking solutions that push the boundaries of the haircare industry.

**Position Overview**

The Reporting \& Operations Coordinator is a full\-time hybrid role based in New York, NY, with work\-from\-home flexibility. This role supports business operations through the preparation, maintenance, and distribution of business reports and operational data. This position is responsible for recurring reporting, data management, report development, and operational support while assisting with internal IT coordination and administrative functions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Prepare, maintain, and distribute recurring business reports to support sales and operational decision\-making.
* Analyze, validate, and organize data from multiple sources, ensuring accuracy and consistency across reports.
* Develop and enhance reporting tools, templates, and dashboards based on business needs.
* Support promotional rebate reporting, including data collection, reconciliation, documentation, and coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
* Respond to reporting requests and provide insights to support business operations and performance tracking.
* Coordinate employee device procurement, deployment, inventory management, and basic IT support.
* Serve as a liaison with external vendors for equipment setup, system\-related issues, and technical support.
* Assist with business systems support, including Microsoft Dynamics Business Central (BC) and Direct Sales platforms.
* Provide administrative and operational support to the Business Operations team and contribute to process improvement initiatives.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams on projects and other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Minimum 3 years of office administration, reporting, operations support, or related experience.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

**Preferred**

* Experience in creating reports, dashboards, and business performance analyses.
* Background in Sales Operations, Business Operations, or a related function.
* Working knowledge of ERP systems, such as Microsoft Dynamics Business Central.
* Experience using Tableau, Power BI, or similar data visualization tools.
* Interest in reporting, business intelligence, and data\-driven decision\-making.

**Compensation**  
The annual salary range for this position is $50,000 \- $55,000 \+ semi\-annual bonus. Compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, and other job\-related factors.

**Location**  
Hybrid (New York, NY) Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. This position follows a hybrid work schedule and requires onsite attendance at our New York headquarters approximately one day per week.

**Benefits include**

* Medical, Dental \& Vision Insurance
* Simple IRA with Company Match
* Semi\-Annual Bonus Opportunity
* Generous Paid Time Off and Sick Leave
* Paid Maternity, Paternity \& Prenatal Leave
* Life and Disability Insurance
* Employee Product Discounts
* Commuter Benefits

Milbon USA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. As a global organization, we value diversity, inclusion, and cross\-cultural collaboration. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees and make employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law.

* Vision insurance

jobs.title: Administrative Coordinator, Legal & Sporting
jobs.description:
The National Women’s Soccer League (NWSL) is one of the fastest\-growing professional sports leagues in the U.S., powered by 16 clubs and a deep roster of the world’s best players, and built on record\-shattering fan, media and commercial growth. Now in its 14th season, the league’s momentum continues to accelerate, with viewership and attendance numbers growing rapidly, social media fandom on the rise, team valuations massively increasing and new top sponsors investing in the NWSL brand. This unprecedented growth in audience, media reach, and franchise value reflects the NWSL’s expanding fan base and increasing dominance in the sports\-media landscape and popular culture.

  

The future of the NWSL is now — and we’re looking for world\-class talent like you to help us continue the momentum.

### **The Role**


We are seeking an Administrative Coordinator to provide dedicated administrative and strategic support to the Chief Legal Officer (CLO) and Vice President, Sporting (VPS). The ideal candidate will demonstrate exceptional judgment and discretion, strong communication and organizational skills, and the ability to prioritize in a fast\-paced environment. This individual should proactively anticipate the needs of both executives, ensuring smooth daily operations and effective communication across departments.

### **What You Will Own \& Drive**

* Deliver strategic administrative support to the CLO and VPS, including managing schedules, coordinating travel, handling correspondence, and organizing meetings.
* Act as a liaison between the CLO and VPS, and other internal departments and external stakeholders, ensuring seamless communication and timely updates on key initiatives.
* Prepare materials for executive commitments, including presentations, press / speaking engagement briefings, project plans, and meeting summaries.
* Facilitate cross\-functional projects by working closely with the CLO and VPS, and other executives.
* Schedule and attend meetings, take detailed notes and document action items for follow\-up.
* Monitor and prioritize incoming communications, ensuring timely responses and efficient workflow.
* Maintain confidentiality and exercise discretion in handling sensitive information.
* Assist in documenting processes and workflows to enhance operational efficiency
* Assist in managing document retention policy

### **What You Will Bring**

#### **Core Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 3\+ years of progressive experience supporting senior executives or leadership teams.
* **Executive Support:** Proven ability to coordinate complex projects and manage rigorous executive follow\-up to ensure deliverables are met.
* **Communication:** Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to draft clear, concise professional correspondence.
* **Technical Proficiency:** Proficiency in Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Slides, Docs), Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint), and Slack.
* **Operational Skills:** Excellent organizational, time\-management, and problem\-solving abilities, with a proven track record of prioritizing tasks in a dynamic environment.
* **Adaptability:** Flexibility to work non\-traditional hours, including evenings and weekends, to support executive needs as they arise.

#### **Preferred Qualifications**

* **Strategic Foresight:** Demonstrated ability to "look around corners"—anticipating potential obstacles and proactively recommending ways to optimize an executive’s time.
* **Process Improvement:** Experience not only managing recurring cadences but also identifying and implementing opportunities for process improvement.
* **Crisis \& Priority Management:** Advanced ability to navigate urgent, competing priorities while maintaining a focus on long\-term strategic goals.
* **Autonomous Execution:** Highly self\-started and capable of working independently

### **Our Investment in You**


In addition to working in an incredible, inclusive, and committed\-to\-diversity culture, we offer:

* **Competitive Compensation:**$75,000\-$85,000 (Salary is contingent upon candidate qualifications and functional business needs).
* **Time \& Flexibility:** Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO), sick days, and an end\-of\-year office closure.
* **Hybrid Work Model:** Three days in\-office and two remote days per week.
* **Robust Health Coverage:** Medical, Dental, Vision, and Mental Health benefits for employees and dependents.
* **Financial Future:** 401k with employer match and safe harbor contributions.
* **Comprehensive Benefits \& Perks:** Commuter Benefits, Short/Long\-Term Disability, Life Insurance, Gym On\-Site, Voluntary Pet Insurance, and more!

### **Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
