jobs.title: Social Media Coordinator-Part Time
jobs.description:
**THE ROLE**

**The Social Media Coordinator is responsible for creating, editing, and posting high\-quality content across Instagram, TikTok, and other relevant social media platforms to support Century 21's brand presence and drive customer engagement and store visits. Serves as a day\-to\-day steward of the Company's voice across social channels, working closely with senior leadership and the marketing team to plan, produce, and execute content that reflects the energy of the store and its merchandise. Expected to stay current on platform trends and translate them into content that is timely, professional, and on\-brand.**

 **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS****Content Creation \& Execution**

* **Creates, edits, and posts high\-quality photo, video, and written content across Instagram, TikTok, and other relevant social media platforms.**
* **Plans and maintains a content calendar that aligns with merchandise arrivals, promotions, seasonal moments, and store events.**
* **Captures in\-store content, including product features, styling, and store atmosphere, to drive awareness and in\-store visits.**
* **Adapts content style and format to fit the conventions and best practices of each platform.**
* **Edits photo and video assets using relevant editing and design tools to ensure a consistent, polished brand look.**

**Community \& Brand Engagement**

* **Monitors and responds to comments, messages, and mentions in a timely, professional, and on\-brand manner.**
* **Builds engagement with followers and the broader online community to strengthen brand affinity and loyalty.**
* **Represents the Company positively and does not disparage the Company, its brand, or its business partners in any public or professional setting.**
* **Ensures all content is original, professional, and free of disparaging, defamatory, offensive, or otherwise inappropriate material.**
* **Ensures content does not infringe on the rights of any third party, including copyright, trademark, or rights of privacy or publicity.**

**Collaboration \& Reporting**

* **Executes social media content and posting schedule in support of the Company's brand and marketing objectives.**
* **Partners with marketing and store teams to identify content opportunities tied to merchandise, promotions, and events.**
* **Tracks post performance and engagement metrics and shares learnings to inform future content decisions.**
* **Communicates proactively with senior leadership on content plans, results, and any needs beyond the current scope of work.**

**Compliance \& Professionalism**

* **Maintains and protects the confidentiality of proprietary Company information and does not disclose it to any third party.**
* **Performs all duties in a timely, professional, and compliant manner, adhering to applicable laws and Company policy.**
* **Understands that all content and creative work product created in connection with this role is the property of the Company.**

 **QUALIFICATIONS****To perform this job successfully, the candidate must be able to perform each essential duty above at the highest level. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.*** **Demonstrated experience creating and posting content on Instagram, TikTok, and other social media platforms, ideally in a retail, fashion, or lifestyle brand setting.**
* **Working knowledge of photo and video editing/creation tools (e.g., Adobe Creative Suite, CapCut, Canva, or similar).**
* **Strong understanding of current social media trends, platform algorithms, and native content formats (Reels, Stories, short\-form video, etc.).**
* **Comfort using platform analytics and insights to gauge performance and refine content strategy.**
* **Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong attention to detail and brand voice.**
* **Highly organized with the ability to manage a content calendar and posting schedule while adapting to changing priorities.**
* **Ability to work independently, meet deadlines, and communicate proactively with leadership.**
* **Comfortable capturing content on the sales floor and coordinating with store teams with minimal disruption to the guest experience.**
* **High degree of professionalism and discretion in handling confidential and proprietary information.**
* **Reliable availability, with flexibility based on business needs, including occasional evenings or weekends for time\-sensitive content.**
* **Strong computer skills, including proficiency with relevant social media, editing, and scheduling platforms.**

 **COMPENSATION****$30\.00/hourly wage** **WORKING CONDITIONS****Location: Hybrid The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, talk, hear; use hands to finger, and handle controls. The employee frequently is required to reach with hands and arms. The employee is required to stand, walk, and stoop. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus.****Century 21 NYC is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, or genetic information.**

jobs.title: Outreach Coordinator
jobs.description:
#### **Outreach \& Business Development Coordinator**

* ABA Day by Day, LLC \| Newark, NJ
* PartTime \| 25 Hours per Week \| Hybrid


About ABA Day by Day



ABA Day by Day is a growing behavioral health and developmental services organization serving children, adolescents, adults, and families throughout New Jersey. Our programs include Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA), center\-based services, Respite, and services for individuals eligible through the New Jersey Division of Developmental Disabilities (DDD).



As we expand our Newark center and community\-based programs, we are seeking an energetic, relationship\-driven \*\*Outreach \& Business Development Coordinator\*\* to help increase community awareness, strengthen referral partnerships, and generate sustainable growth across our ABA, Respite, and DDD programs.


#### **Position Overview**


The Outreach \& Business Development Coordinator will be responsible for developing and maintaining referral relationships with organizations and professionals who serve children and individuals with developmental disabilities.



This is a \*\*growth\-focused position\*\*. The ideal candidate is comfortable initiating relationships, presenting services, conducting follow\-up, developing referral pipelines, and representing the organization in professional and community settings.



Candidates with backgrounds in \*\*pharmaceutical sales, medical sales, physician liaison services, healthcare business development, or medical\-practice outreach\*\* are strongly encouraged to apply.



The successful candidate will understand that effective healthcare outreach extends beyond distributing marketing materials. This role requires identifying potential referral sources, getting in front of decision\-makers, communicating the value of our services, maintaining relationships, and converting outreach activity into qualified referrals and strategic partnerships.


#### **Key Responsibilities**


Business Development \& Referral Growth


* Develop and execute outreach strategies to increase referrals for ABA, centerbased services, Respite, and DDD programs.
* Establish relationships with pediatricians, developmental pediatricians, psychologists, neurologists, therapists, social workers, case managers, and other healthcare professionals.
* Build referral relationships with schools, Child Study Teams, earlyintervention providers, childcare centers, preschools, familysupport organizations, and other childfocused agencies.
* Develop relationships with organizations serving adolescents and adults with intellectual and developmental disabilities to support growth of DDD services.
* Identify new referral sources and partnership opportunities throughout Newark and surrounding New Jersey communities.
* Conduct inperson visits, introductory meetings, presentations, telephone outreach, email campaigns, and ongoing relationship management.
* Represent ABA Day by Day at community events, professional meetings, resource fairs, networking events, and other outreach opportunities.

#### **Medical \& Community Partnerships**

* Develop relationships with medical practices and healthcare organizations that regularly encounter children who may benefit from developmental or behavioral services.
* Educate referral partners about ABA Day by Day's programs, eligibility criteria, intake process, service areas, and available funding pathways.
* Maintain regular contact with highvalue referral partners rather than relying on onetime outreach.
* Identify opportunities for crossreferrals, educational presentations, community events, and collaborative programming.
* Develop relationships with parent advocacy groups, familysupport organizations, and community organizations serving individuals with developmental disabilities.


Center Growth \& Strategic Outreach



Support enrollment and referral development for our Newark center, including:


* Early Childhood/Preschool: Build relationships with earlyintervention programs, childcare centers, preschool programs, pediatric providers, and organizations serving families of children ages 25\.
* SchoolAge/AfterSchool: Develop relationships with schools, Child Study Teams, social workers, case managers, and families seeking structured afterschool behavioral and socialdevelopment services.
* Respite: Build referral pipelines with families, community agencies, caremanagement organizations, and professionals serving children eligible for New Jersey developmental disability services.
* DDD Services: Establish relationships with support coordinators, transition programs, schools, community organizations, and professionals serving adolescents and adults with intellectual and developmental disabilities.
* Employer \& Community Partnerships: Identify opportunities to partner with employers and community organizations whose employees or members may benefit from access to developmental and behavioral health resources.

#### **Referral Pipeline Management**

* Maintain an organized outreach and referral pipeline.
* Track contacts, meetings, followups, referrals, referral sources, and partnership outcomes.
* Establish consistent followup schedules for prospective referral partners.
* Identify which outreach channels are generating qualified referrals and recommend adjustments to outreach strategy.
* Provide regular reports to leadership regarding outreach activity, referral trends, opportunities, and barriers.
* Collaborate with Intake, Operations, and Clinical Leadership to ensure prospective referrals receive appropriate followup.


Qualifications


#### **Required**

* Experience in sales, business development, healthcare outreach, medicalpractice relations, provider relations, or a comparable relationshipbased role.
* Demonstrated ability to develop professional relationships and generate new business or referral opportunities.
* Strong interpersonal, presentation, communication, and followup skills.
* Comfortable conducting both telephone/email out

jobs.title: Event Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**Title:** Events Marketing Manager


**Reports to:** Chief Marketing Officer


**Location:** Brooklyn, NY or Marina del Rey, CA — onsite Monday–Friday


**Who is Flip?**



There are 3 runaway categories in B2B AI — coding, legal, and customer support. We're at the center of the third, with a one\-of\-one market position and hundreds of diehard fan clients, from Under Armour to Tory Burch to some of the largest healthcare institutions in the country.



The market is dividing into two camps: generic tooling\-and\-FDE players building custom agents from scratch, and industry\-specific solutions winning on client love due to speed of ROI. We're firmly the latter. Retail and healthcare alone represent $5B\+ TAMs each, and we're still early.



We built the company on a simple idea: the best way to grow is to have a reference list as long as your customer list. We're a team of 100\+ now, with offices in NYC, LA, and the UK. Many people here will tell you it's the best place they've worked and the hardest they've worked. Both are true.


### **The Role**



Events are one of the biggest ways we grow across the three industries we serve — retail, healthcare, and transportation. From major trade shows and conferences to client experiences (Flippin' Legends), brand activations, and internal company events, you'll own Flip's event presence end to end.



You know the B2B trade show world inside and out, love planning the work and working the plan, and hold everyone around you to the same standard. Our creative and content teams bring the ideas — your job is to execute them exceptionally. Not just done, but done right, on time, and on budget.


### **What You'll Own**


* **Trade shows \& conferences.** Own Flip's presence end to end. Identify the right events across retail, healthcare, and transportation, negotiate sponsorships and booth packages, manage all logistics, and ensure Flip shows up in a way that turns heads and drives pipeline. Retail industry trade show experience is a strong plus.
* **Pre\-event planning.** Build detailed event plans and timelines well in advance. Coordinate across sales, marketing, and leadership to align on goals, messaging, and on\-site experience. Manage all vendor relationships, contracts, and deadlines.
* **Budget management \& ROI.** Own event budgets from estimate through reconciliation, delivering maximum impact within a reasonable spend. Track and report ROI for every event — leads generated, pipeline influenced, brand impressions, follow\-up conversion — and use that data to prioritize the events that deliver.
* **On\-site execution \& team leadership.** Lead the team on the ground at every event. Manage setup, staffing, scheduling, and real\-time problem solving. Ensure every detail is executed to plan and the Flip team is set up to have meaningful conversations and capture every lead.
* **Post\-event follow\-through.** Debrief the team, report results, coordinate with sales on lead follow\-up, and document learnings. Every event should make the next one better.
* **Brand activations, swag \& content.** Partner with creative and content to bring activations to life; source and track event merchandise and collateral; coordinate photo, video, and client interview capture for social and post\-event promotion.
* **Internal events.** Plan and coordinate events for the Flip team — company meetings, offsites, industry parties, and client dinners.

### **What We're Looking For**


* **3\+ years managing B2B trade shows and industry conferences**, with end\-to\-end ownership of logistics, sponsorships, and on\-site execution.
* **Retail industry familiarity is a strong plus** — you know its major trade shows and how buyers show up at them.
* **Exceptional organizational and project management skills** — multiple events and deadlines at once, without dropping a detail.
* **Proven budget ownership and ROI fluency.** You've built and managed event budgets, negotiated with vendors and organizers, and used performance data to inform future strategy.
* **Strong leadership on the ground** — comfortable directing teams and vendors in a fast\-paced environment, and holding partners accountable without losing the relationship.
* **A natural collaborator** who translates creative and content teams' ideas into flawless execution.
* **Relentless attention to detail.** You love a checklist, own every open item, and don't stop until everything is closed out.
* **Adaptable and calm under pressure.** If you're a chaos\-wrangler who brings order to complexity, we want to meet you.

### **More About Us**


* We're international, spanning the US, UK, and Canada
* We've raised \+$30M to date including our recent $20M Series A \- backed by Ridge, Next Coast, ScOp, Bullpen Capital, Data Point and Forum Ventures, as well as founders \& executives from Amazon Alexa, Ada, Attentive, and Simon Data
* We are hiring two Customer Content Marketers in this role; one for our eCom/retail vertical and one for our Healthcare vertical.
* Comprehensive healthcare and unlimited vacation, including a mandatory half week for everyone over July 4, and a full week off at the end of the year
* In office 5 days/week

jobs.title: New York City, Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Join the Glowbar Team:**


Glowbar is reinventing the facial with custom, 30\-minute treatments led by expert estheticians, designed to deliver results. Since launching in NYC in 2019, we’ve grown fast, with locations across the Northeast and more on the way.


The Operations Coordinator is the operational backbone that keeps Glowbar studios stocked, growing, and running smoothly. You own inventory across the studio network — from monthly purchase orders to ecomm product ordering to HQ supply and collateral — and you get hands\-on with New Studio Openings, traveling to support procurement and on\-site setup. You're the first line of our support inbox, managing timebound responses and company service level agreements (SLA) and overseeing our offshore support partner, and you keep studios connected and equipped through systems administration, resource management, and internal communications like our weekly newsletter and intranet. If you love variety, thrive on staying organized across a dozen moving pieces, and want a front\-row seat to Glowbar's growth, this is the role for you.

**What You’ll Do:**


You keep the engine running behind the scenes so studios can focus on clients. Every week, you'll:

* Manage the monthly studio purchase order process, ensuring every studio is fully and accurately stocked with product and supplies
* Own ecommerce product ordering and fulfillment, shipping orders in a timely manner and flagging resourcing needs as volume scales
* Manage HQ supply and collateral ordering, keeping field teams and marketing initiatives fully equipped
* Manage vendor relationships to help ensure quality, cost efficiency, and on\-time delivery of products and services
* Manage New Studio Openings (NSO), end to end, through procurement and hands\-on setup, traveling on\-site to help execute set up to turnover
* Conduct weekly NSO meetings to ensure stakeholders are driving towards deadlines according to the company playbooks
* Partner with the NSO and Training team, Studio Development Real Estate, and Field Area Managers to coordinate deliveries, ordering, and studio setup ahead of each opening
* Manage the support inbox, resolving client inquiries related to memberships, bookings, and general customer experience within company required SLA
* Oversee and manage our remote/offshore support partner, ensuring quality, consistency, and SLA adherence in day\-to\-day client interactions
* Serve as systems and platform admin owner, acting as the corporate liaison for platform set\-up, troubleshooting, and new product/studio configuration across POS/Schedule platform, proprietary company platforms and across Google Marketplace
* Support onboarding of new hires across email, Slack, and core systems (BLVD, Prospr, Method) and vendor accounts
* Own studio resources and communications, including the weekly newsletter and intranet, keeping field teams informed and aligned
* Maintain and update operational playbooks, policies, and SOPs (Operations Manual, NSO Playbook) so field resources stay current and accurate

**Who We’re Looking For:**

* 2\+ years of operations experience (i.e. restaurant, retail, hotel, salon/spa, or comparable) with a proven track record of superior customer service
* Quick study and high level of confidence working in a variety of systems and platforms
* Ability to manage multiple projects through prioritization and planning skills; demonstrated ability to wear multiple hats and work in a scrappy environment (ready to roll up your sleeves)
* Exceptional attention to detail and follow\-through
* Highly motivated and results\-oriented, resourceful and creative
* Eager to join a fast\-growing team and collaborate closely across functions
* Exceptional customer\-first mindset, both internal and external
* Outstanding interpersonal, written, and organizational skills
* Comfortable managing vendor and remote/offshore partner relationships
* Forward\-thinking problem solver with a strong work ethic
* Passion for beauty, skincare, learning, and trying new things every day
* Bachelor’s degree preferred
* Ability to travel to support New Studio Openings (approximately 20–30% of the time, with heavier travel during opening weeks)

**Your Glow Package (Compensation \& Benefits):**

* Annual bonus potential tied to company EBITDA performance
* Annual compensation increase eligibility
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance largely covered by Glowbar
* Unlimited PTO and sick leave
* 6 Paid holidays
* DailyPay \- access part of your paycheck before payday at no cost
* Disability, accident, critical illness, and life insurance coverage
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with free mental wellness support
* Commuter benefits to help save on transit and parking
* Free annual Glowbar membership ($780 value) and two annual guest passes ($170 value)
* 25% employee discount off skincare products
* $150 employee referral bonuses for bringing great people to the team
* $15 product credit for every first\-time client you refer

*We’re the DOPEST — and we mean it. Join us, and let your career truly glow!*

jobs.description:
**JOB SUMMARY:** The Operations Coordinator will work in cooperation, and directly in conjunction with the Shelter Director; to coordinate and ensure the overall operational, safety, and maintenance of the shelter facility.


Operations Coordinator is responsible for, but not limited to:

* Responsible for all Facility and other assigned programs and/or areas
* Provides the operational supervision of facility staff, other assigned programs staff, and oversees external vendors
* Responsible for securing coverage for all shifts when needed.
* Collaborate with Shelter Director to ensure goals are met according to contractual obligations
* Work with senior management for initial/renewal programmatic reports and/or proposals
* Coordinates inventory procurement, control and expenditures procedures
* Coordinate and ensure the implementation of all Occupational Safety and Health Administration
* (OSHA), DHS, OTDA regulations and guidelines, including Universal Precautions Policies and Procedures
* Identify and ensure adequate and appropriate resources are assigned to program/projects to ensure the program/project design is controlled, and goals are achieved
* Provide On\-Call coverage\-24/7 for emergency and crisis intervention regarding all aspects of operations\-related systems
* Developing operations goals and objectives, and policies and procedures, and implementing changes to existing standards, policies, and procedures
* Designing and delegating preventative/scheduled operations activities
* Managing the collection, presentation, and reporting of operations data
* Maintaining, revising, and updating operations logs, records, and forms
* Manage facilities inventory and material and supply needs, and oversee the purchasing process
* Overseeing the internal and external operations\-related systems, tests, and inspections
* Performing monthly walk\-throughs to inspect operations at all facilities, including all major building systems
* Maintain all records regarding compliance with City and State regulations, including NYS section 491 regulations
* Ensuring regulatory compliance and that all required licenses and certificates from the Fire  

Department, Buildings Department, Department of Health, and all other pertinent city and state agencies are current and valid
* Coordinating and certifying the implementation of all city, state, and federal building codes and industry standards, including Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) and Universal Precautions Policies and Procedures
* Recruiting, supervising, monitoring, and evaluating staffs; ensure they have successfully perform routine daily, weekly, and periodic tasks
* Establishing and implementing schedules and work assignments
* Maintaining awareness of new trends and developments in the fields of safety, residential management, maintenance, food service, and housekeeping, and incorporating new developments into the facilities as appropriate
* Conducting, attending, and participating in facility and professional group meetings in order to maintain and improve professional competence
* Maintaining ongoing communication with social services concerning operational issues
* Attend professional meetings, educational conferences, and in\-service trainings in order to maintain and improve professional competence
* Managing the collection, presentation, and reporting of data regarding all activities related to safety and/or infractions.
* Attend professional meetings, educational conferences, and in\-service trainings in order to maintain and improve professional competence
* Provide coverage for other areas as directed/needed
* Attention to detail, organized and efficient.
* Maturity, integrity and sound judgment.

**Qualifications:**

* 3\-7 years facilities management experience, preferably in a residential facility
* Fire Safety Certification is a Plus.
* Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Certification preferred
* Valid Driver License, if authorized to drive agency vehicle
* Knowledge of operating related equipment, tools, and materials used in the facility
* Knowledge of city, state, and federal building codes and industry standards
* Proficiency in software applications, including word processing, spreadsheets, and databases
* Commitment to the mission of Care for The Homeless
* Proven ability to work collaboratively well with diverse groups
* Proven ability to handle multiple tasks effectively under pressure
* Strong organizational skills, detail\-oriented, and efficient
* Maturity, integrity, and sound judgment

 **Physical Demands and Working Environment:**

* Regularly stand, sit, and walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; talk or hear; and taste or smell
* Lift and/or carry up to 25 pounds

 **Pay:** $70,000

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
### **Our Story**


Since 2023, our mission has been clear: to be the north star of patient equity.


Every day, we strive to bridge the gaps in healthcare access and outcomes to ensure that every patient, regardless of background or circumstance, receives the care they deserve. As a member of our team, you'll be at the forefront of innovation, working alongside passionate individuals who share your dedication to creating best\-in\-class, patient\-centric products in healthcare. Together, we're revolutionizing the way people understand their health and working with the world's top researchers to accelerate innovation.

### **About Novellia**


Novellia is the first and only company that lets anyone in the U.S. gain access to nearly a decade of their health data in under 30 seconds — 100% free. All your health records, across every doctor, in one place, always up to date.


We are the only patient\-powered real\-world data platform delivering comprehensive, patient\-authorized longitudinal health insights to accelerate biopharma innovation. Unlike traditional RWD providers who deliver fragmented institutional data, we empower patients to access 20\+ years of their health records, then transform these complete health journeys into fit\-for\-purpose datasets for evidence generation, regulatory submissions, and market access. We are growing 5x year over year, have raised close to $30M in funding, and are backed by tier\-1 investors including Spark Capital, Khosla Ventures, and Bling Capital.


Working with the world's top researchers, we turn health insights into life\-changing action for millions of people around the world.

### **About the Role**


Most marketing teams in healthcare operate like it's 2009\. Dense white papers. Forgettable webinars. Conference booths with too many pens and not enough personality.


We're building something different.


We're looking for a Marketing Coordinator who understands scientific communications or life sciences marketing, loves the science, and has been quietly frustrated by how badly the industry communicates it. You want to take what you know about real\-world evidence, patient data, and clinical research and turn it into content that people actually want to read, watch, and share.


We are looking for someone who gets things done. You are the kind of person who has a color\-coded project tracker, who follows up without being asked, and who can hold five balls in the air without dropping any of them. You bring that operational energy to a creative team and make the whole machine run faster. You will work directly with our Head of Marketing and execute across channels including events, social, and sales collateral.

### **What You Will Do**

**Own execution.** You take tasks from brief to done. That means coordinating timelines, tracking deliverables, managing review cycles, chasing approvals, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks. You are the person who makes the calendar real.

**Support content production across channels.** You will assist in producing materials across events (pre/post logistics, run\-of\-show, vendor coordination), social (scheduling, community monitoring, asset coordination), and sales enablement (one\-pagers, decks, collateral updates). You know good ideas from bad and you can contribute creative thoughts.

**Translate the science into plain language.** Your background in scientific communications or life sciences marketing means you understand what we actually do. You can read a study abstract, understand what it means, and help shape how we talk about it in a way that lands outside of a journal.

**Keep the team on track.** You maintain the marketing calendar. You run status checks. You flag blockers before they become problems. You are the connective tissue between strategy and execution.

**Grow into more.** Budget management, vendor relationships, creative execution, and campaign ownership are on the path ahead. This role is designed to expand as you do.

### **What We Are Looking For**

**Experience:** 1 to 3 years in scientific communications, journalism, marketing, or communications within life sciences, healthcare, or health data. Agency or in\-house both work.

**Project management, first.** This is the non\-negotiable. You are deeply organized. You manage multiple workstreams at once. You build systems for yourself even when no one asks you to.

**Scientific fluency.** You are comfortable with clinical research, real\-world evidence, or health data concepts. You do not need a science degree. You need to have worked alongside scientists or clinicians long enough to understand the vocabulary and earn the trust.

**Creative curiosity.** You have opinions about what makes content good. You notice when something lands differently than the rest of the category. You can write a clear sentence and you care about the difference between a sharp headline and a mediocre one.

**Fast\-moving and unbothered.** Priorities shift. Timelines compress. You adapt without drama and keep moving. You ask good questions when you need clarity and make reasonable calls when you do not.

**Low ego, high output.** You take the work seriously. You do not take yourself too seriously. You find something slightly absurd about how stiff and self\-important healthcare marketing usually is, and you want to fix that.

### **Tools You Are Comfortable With (or Willing to Learn Fast)**

* Project management: Notion, Slack, etc.
* Design basics: Canva, Figma, or Adobe Creative Suite
* Google Workspace (you live in Docs, Slides, and Sheets)

### **What This Is Not**


This is not a social media manager role. You will touch social, but it is one channel among several.


This is not a pure writing role. You will contribute to content, but execution and coordination are the job.


This is not a good fit if you prefer slow\-moving environments, long approval chains, or heavily siloed work. We move fast, we are small, and everyone's fingerprints are

At **MMGY Global,** we believe nothing shapes your view of the world like travel. Every day, we share our clients’ stories from a perspective that inspires people to see the world differently. Our personalized service and strategy connect media, consumers and influencers across the globe, taking people to new places and changing their views for the better. At MMGY, we inspire people to go places.


We have an immediate opening for an **Account Coordinator****, PR** in **New York**. **DO YOU LOVE TO TRAVEL?** If you are looking for a PR agency home where your career path is our priority, let’s talk. If you are outgoing, energetic, innovative, resourceful and love to write, then this job is for you.


With industry\-leading benefits and a hybrid telework policy, we have half\-day Summer Fridays and are closed the week between Christmas and New Years. Our Culture Crew throws killer team events and we have a robust by\-level training program. Plus, the more business trips you take, the more Road Warrior benefits you receive to buy upgrades, lounge passes and more. Yes, work/life balance is a real focus for us.

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator
jobs.description:
**TL;DR:** We’re looking for a Recruiting Coordinator to run scheduling, candidate experience, and recruiting ops. You’ll work closely with recruiters, founders, and hiring managers to keep things tight, fast, and high quality from first touch through onsite and close.


As you ramp, you’ll naturally take on broader, more strategic work across the team.

**Background**


Listen Labs is the world's fastest AI research platform, built so every company can understand what their customers want, why, and what to do about it. Our AI conducts in\-depth interviews, analyzes conversations, and delivers executive\-ready insights in hours, not weeks. Born out of a Harvard research project, Listen is trusted by teams at leading brands like Google, Microsoft, Anthropic, Perplexity, Sweetgreen, Replit, and Nestlé to bring real customer voices into their biggest product, marketing, and growth decisions.

**Company highlights — entirely product\-led:**

* **World\-Class Team:** Founded by serial entrepreneurs — Alfred (Bemlo, YC W22\) and Florian (IOI medalist, ICPC World Finalist) — and built with talent from Google, Meta, Tesla, Amazon, Jane Street, and X, alongside Bain, Goldman Sachs, McKinsey, and Sequoia\-backed startups like Applied Intuition, Scale AI, and Rippling. Over 30% of our team are former founders, and multiple are competitive programming medalists.
* **Hypergrowth:** Since launching, Listen has grown annualized revenue 15x and completed over 2 million interviews — backed by $100M in total funding led by Ribbit Capital, with Sequoia, Conviction, and Pear VC participating.
* **Traction:** Already serving 15% of Fortune 100s. Enterprise wins and expansions across Anthropic, Microsoft, Nestlé, Perplexity, Sweetgreen, and more — with teams telling us research that used to take six to eight weeks now happens in days.

**What You’ll Do**

* Own scheduling end\-to\-end. Make sure candidates and interviewers show up prepared and on time.
* Run a clean, thoughtful candidate experience, especially onsites. Make it feel smooth and human.
* Keep everyone in the loop. Candidates, recruiters, and hiring managers. No confusion, no dropped balls.
* Work closely with the team to unblock issues quickly and keep things moving.
* Keep Ashby accurate so we have a real view of what’s going on.
* Make things better. Fix broken workflows, tighten processes, and improve how we run.
* Take on ad hoc projects as they come up. This could help stand up a new hiring push, improve how we operate, or jump in wherever leverage is highest.

**Who You Are**

* 2\+ years in recruiting coordination, recruiting ops, or something similar in a fast\-paced environment.
* Detail\-oriented to a fault. You catch things others don’t.
* Very reliable and responsive. People trust you.
* Can juggle a lot without getting flustered.
* Care about candidate experience and making things feel seamless.
* Good judgment. Can handle sensitive info without issues.
* You like people. You’re naturally warm and easy to work with.
* You don’t wait around. If something’s broken, you fix it.
* Interested in growing into broader ownership over time.
* Experience with Ashby is helpful but not required.

**Life at Listen Labs**

* **Health, covered:** Full medical, dental, and vision. FSA/HSA and life insurance are available too.
* **Competitive compensation:** Backed by world\-class investors including Sequoia, Ribbit Capital, Conviction, and Pear VC — we hire the best and treat them accordingly, with meaningful equity ownership.


	+ The range for this role is $85,000 \- $105,000 base. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors, including but not limited to skill set, experience, and work location. If this range doesn't match your expectations, we still encourage you to apply.
* **Annual Learning Stipend:** Books, courses, conferences, coaching, language lessons — almost anything that makes you sharper.
* **Annual Wellness Stipend for your health and headspace:** Gym memberships, race fees, massages, ergonomic gear, and more.
* **Monthly Stipend for AI tools:** A dedicated budget for the software and GPU credits that make you faster.
* **Fed, daily:** A private chef serves lunch and dinner in our SF office; NYC and London teams get daily meal credit.
* **Flexible time off:** A take\-what\-you\-need vacation policy.
* **We celebrate together:** Company offsites and events like our annual holiday party — every win is a team win.
* **Room to grow:** As an early member of the team, you'll own end\-to\-end processes from scratch and grow alongside the company.

jobs.description:
KATZ Radio Group  



Current employees and contingent workers click here **to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.**

  



As the nation’s largest media representation firm, Katz Media Group delivers local relevance at scale. Whether you want one idea that sounds local in a hundred different markets or a hundred unique ideas, we have your solution.


Over our long history, the Katz name has been synonymous with leadership in the media industry. Founded in 1888, Katz was the nation’s first media representation firm. Today, Katz Media Group is comprised of two divisions, Katz Radio Group and Katz Television Group. Collectively, the company represents both the on\-air and online assets of more than 4,000 radio stations and 800 television stations, making Katz Media Group the largest media representation company in America. In addition to our deeply rooted media expertise, our unique regional sales structure is key to driving our clients’ success. Katz Media Group is based in New York City, with 15 regional offices across the country, providing advertisers and agencies with local expertise and insights across the nation.


Be a part of the largest media representation company in America. At Katz Media Group, we have the best, brightest and boldest talent in the media industry — individuals who deliver unparalleled value for our business partners and clients. We are looking for people who can grow, think, dream and achieve. Every employee brings inspiration and imagination to our constantly evolving and expanding business. If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At Katz Media we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

At Katz Media Group, we strive for success and support our teams that are dedicated to excellence in client service. * Monitor campaign performance and assist in compiling data for client reporting and renewals.
* Manage deadlines and deliverables to ensure all client expectations are met or exceeded.
* Serve as a liaison between sales, programming, and operations to ensure alignment and communication.
* Assist with billing and reconciliation to ensure accuracy and timely processing.
  



**What You'll Need:**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (especially Excel and PowerPoint); Salesforce experience is a plus.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* A collaborative mindset and a passion for delivering exceptional client service.
  



**What You'll Bring:**

* Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return
* Ability to work within standardized procedures and an understanding of when to escalate
* Skills to solve straightforward problems using established procedures
* Close attention to detail, following up until issues are resolved
* Common courtesy when communicating with coworkers and outside contacts

Salary to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to relevant experience, knowledge, skills, other job\-related qualifications, and alignment with market data.

  

$19\.78 \- $24\.73

New York, NY: 125 West 55th Street, 10019

Regular

Full time  



**Pay Type:**


Hourly

iHeartMedia’s benefits offering is flexible and offers a variety of choices to meet the diverse needs of our changing workforce, including the following:

* Employer sponsored medical, dental and vision with a variety of coverage options
* Company provided and supplemental life insurance
* Paid vacation and sick time
* Paid company holidays
* A Spirit day to encourage and allow our employees to more easily volunteer in their community

* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) at no cost – services include telephonic counseling sessions, consultation on legal and financial matters, emotional well\-being, family and caregiving

* 1\+ years of business\-to\-business (B2B), Business to consumer (B2C) Direct marketing, outside sales or community outreach experience

* Willing and able to travel locally up to 100% of time within assigned sales territories in this NYC market area requiring reliable transportation or access to public transportation
* Willing and able to work core business hours, Monday \- Friday 8am\-5pm and nights and weekends, when required
* Reside within commuting distance to New York Metropolitan area

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working with communities of all different ethnicities, cultural backgrounds, diverse populations and/or underserved communities
* Previous outside sales and territory management experience
* Valid driver's license, good driving history and current automobile insurance
* Insured, dependable vehicle with current driver's license

* Established professional relationships with non\-profits, community sources CBO's, religious/faith\-based organizations FBO's in designated sales territory
* Demonstrated knowledge of Essential Plan Market Place marketing rules and regulations preferred, training in all lines of businesses will be provided
* Previous outside sales and territory management experience
* Act as a team player \- work collaboratively with others (both inside the sales unit as well as outside) to achieve goals, relate to others in an open and accepting manner, keep others up to date on information they need, contribute ideas and support decisions made by the team and the organization, treat people with dignity and respect

jobs.title: Account Manager I, Eats SMB
jobs.description:
**About the role and team**  

  

Account Management at Uber means navigating ambiguity, earning trust fast, and solving problems that don't come with a script. In this role, you will own the growth and success of a portfolio of SMB restaurant partners, acting as their primary advisor to unlock the full potential of the Uber Eats platform. It is a high\-stakes environment where your ability to build long\-term partnerships directly impacts the livelihood of local businesses and Uber's mission to move the real world.  

  

The work is fast\-paced and requires a grit\-based mindset; you will deal with shifting priorities, handle tough negotiations, and build lasting partnerships. We are looking for resourceful owners who are energised by the complex reality of Account Management and can stay resilient through the inevitable "no" to find creative solutions for our partners. If you thrive on autonomy and are motivated by seeing the tangible impact of your work on the community, this is where you will grow.  

  

**This role will be based in New York, following the hybrid schedule of Tuesday \- Thursday in office.**  

  

**What you'll do*** Build and grow long\-term partnerships by understanding what matters most to your restaurant partners \- doing the right thing long term.
* Manage partner portfolios with urgency and discipline, using data\-driven insights to track KPIs and identify opportunities for optimization.
* Navigate ambiguity and complexity to resolve merchant issues, unblock growth, and ensure high\-levels of partner satisfaction.
* Adapt your approach based on market dynamics and partner needs to influence the adoption of new features, marketing products, and services.
* Collaborate across operations, marketing, and product teams to share local market knowledge and shape regional strategies that scale.

**Basic Qualifications*** 3\+ years of experience in account management, operations, sales or customer\-facing functions.
* Ability to negotiate with external partners and overcoming objections to gain commitment.
* Ability to handle high\-ambiguity environments and pivot quickly based on shifting business priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to build and leverage data\-driven insights for portfolio sales lifecycle\-management.
* Fluency in the local language of the market, and professional proficiency in English.
* High school diploma or equivalent.

**Preferred Qualifications*** Proficiency in Salesforce and Google Sheets/Excel for data\-driven decision making.
* Demonstrated problem\-solving ability to solve gaps in merchant processes.
* Stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence without authority.

  

For New York City, NY\-based roles: The total on\-target earnings (OTE) range for this position is USD $99,286 \- USD $110,000\. The OTE includes a base salary range of USD $69,500 per year \- USD $77,000 per year and an annualized cash variable incentive target of USD $29,786 \- USD $33,000\.  

  

The cash variable incentive target is based on individual sales performance and its payment is based on the terms of the Sales Incentive Plan.  

  

An equity award and other forms of compensation may be included in the offer. You will also be eligible for various benefits.  

  

**Ready to Ride?**  

  

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook \- it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves \- we'd love to hear from you.  

  

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.
  

  

Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in\-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full\-time in\-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.  

  

Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

jobs.title: Key Account Manager - Critical Industries
jobs.description:
At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:**


Strategic Program Director
\_\_


In this role, you’ll develop, implement, and manage the strategy and relationship with assigned data center\-related accounts for the ABB Electrification (EL) business, specifically related to the Industry, Building and Channel (IBC) organization. The position will have significant cross\-functional responsibilities across the ABB EL. As the point person for the ABB IBC relationship within those accounts, this position is responsible for growing share of wallet, profitability, and elevating customer satisfaction. Coordinates executive relationships within the accounts, sets goals, tracks pipeline, organizes sales activities, monitors current projects, and manages the resolution of the strategic customer challenges.


The work model for the role is: remote (\#LI\-Remote) and willingness to travel as needed is required.

**Your role and responsibilities:**

* **Lead Strategic Account Planning:** Develop and implement account plans and Statements of Work (SoW) to drive growth across divisions and locations.
* **Drive Customer\-Centric Sales Strategy:** Understand key business drivers and risks (e.g., sustainability, digitalization, cybersecurity) to shape tailored sales strategies and targets.
* **Build Trusted Relationships:** Engage decision\-makers within data center organizations, delivering comprehensive ABB solutions aligned with customer needs and profitability goals.
* **Enable Competitive \& Coordinated Execution:** Monitor market trends and competitors, apply standardized sales tools (e.g., Salesforce), and ensure a unified approach to sales planning and issue resolution.

**Our Team Dynamics**


Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters \- because the progress we make here creates real impact out there.

**Qualifications for the role:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Marketing or related field and a minimum of 10 years of experience within the industry OR Associate’s degree and a minimum of 12 years of experience within the industry.
* Experience working with data center customers is a plus.
* Strong understanding of the Electrification products
* Proven ability to conduct market analysis and develop business plans with a structured, strategic mindset; experienced in building strong relationships with electrical contractors, distributors, and channel partners. Brings a technical background (preferably in the data center market), strong communication skills, and an agile, collaborative leadership style that fosters teamwork and innovation.
* Solid technical understanding of 3\-phase AC power systems including, but not limited to: medium and low voltage switchgear, medium and low voltage motor control centers, switchboards, panelboards, and ancillary electrical distribution products and experience with quoting projects for contractors  

Solid technical understanding and field sales experience selling power monitoring and control software, associated metering and communications systems, direct current, and battery energy storage/microgrid solutions.
* Candidates must already have work authorization that would permit them to work for ABB in the US.

**What's in it for you**

We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger

jobs.title: Small Business Account Manager
jobs.description:
At Trustpilot, we're on an incredible journey. We're a profitable, high\-growth FTSE\-250 company with a big vision: to become the universal symbol of trust. We run the world's largest open customer review platform, and while we've come a long way, there's still so much exciting work to do. Come join us at the heart of trust!


As a SMB Account Manager, you are responsible for retaining and growing a defined portfolio of existing customers in the US market. You act as the commercial owner of each relationship — driving renewals, expanding accounts, and positioning Trustpilot as a long\-term partner that delivers measurable business value.



You combine commercial acumen with relationship depth, collaborating closely with Customer Success Managers to ensure adoption, satisfaction, and sustainable revenue growth.



You are accountable for contributing to strong Gross Renewal Rate (GRR) and Net Revenue Retention (NRR) results by executing defined renewal processes, maintaining Salesforce accuracy, and supporting customers to achieve measurable value.


**What you'll be doing:**


* Retention \& Renewal: Own the end\-to\-end renewal process, delivering high Gross Renewal Rates (GRR) and predictable retention.
* Growth \& NRR: Drive portfolio expansion through upsell and cross\-sell to achieve strong Net Revenue Retention (NRR) and overall portfolio growth.
* Account Planning: Build and maintain detailed account plans, stakeholder maps, and accurate forecasts in Salesforce.
* Customer Engagement: Lead commercial and strategic conversations, including business reviews and contract discussions.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Customer Success to ensure value realization, with Marketing on customer stories, and with Product on feedback loops.
* Operational Excellence: Ensure accurate data, forecasting discipline, and pipeline visibility across your portfolio.


**Who you are:**


* You have experience in account management, renewals, or a similar customer\-facing role within a SaaS or subscription\-based company.
* Strong understanding of retention, NRR, upsell, and cross\-sell motions.
* Solid commercial awareness with the ability to link product value to customer outcomes.
* Skilled at managing a large portfolio and keeping accurate account data in CRM systems.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and negotiation skills.
* Comfortable analysing account performance data and forecasting renewals.
* Able to work cross\-functionally and thrive in a fast\-moving, target\-driven environment.
* A good understanding of the digital advertising/search marketing industry – preferred.


**What's in it for you:**


* A competitive base salary of $70,000\-77,000 gross per year (depending on level and experience), plus a competitive commission structure. The base salary range stated doesn't include any variable pay such as bonuses or commission, or other benefits.
* A range of flexible working options to dedicate time to what matters to you
* 20 vacation days \+ 2 personal days \+10 paid holidays per year
* Two (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community
* Rich learning and development opportunities supported through the Trustpilot Academy, and Blinkist
* Full health insurance
* 401k matching your contributions dollar\-for\-dollar up to 4% of your base salary
* 24/7 Employee Assistance Plan and full access to Headspace, a popular mindfulness app to promote positive mental health
* Paid parental leave for employees who have been employed for over 6 months with full full scope of benefit after 12 months
* Regular opportunities to connect and get to know your fellow Trusties, including company\-wide celebrations and events, ERG activities and team socials
* A friendly, fun and open office complete with a rooftop, gaming room and fully stocked fridge with ever changing snacks and drinks
* Dog friendly office


**Still unsure?**  

We want everyone to feel welcome at Trustpilot. We're excited to hear about your experiences and how you can help us create a great culture for our team. So don't worry if you don't tick every single box \- we'd still love to hear from you!



\#LI\-JL1

 **About us**



Trustpilot began in 2007 with a simple yet powerful idea that is more relevant today than ever — to be the universal symbol of trust, bringing consumers and businesses together through reviews. Trustpilot is open, independent, and impartial — we help consumers make the right choices and businesses to build trust, grow and improve.



Today, we have more than 350 million reviews and 60 million monthly active users across the globe, with 149 billion annual Trustpilot brand impressions, and the numbers keep growing. We have more than 1000 employees and we're headquartered in Copenhagen, with operations in Amsterdam, Denver, Edinburgh, Hamburg, London, Melbourne, Milan and New York.



We're driven by connection. It's at the heart of what we do. Our culture keeps things fresh –– it's built on the relationships we create. We talk, we laugh, we collaborate and we respect each other. We work across borders and cultures to be the universal symbol of trust in an ever\-changing world. With vibrant office locations worldwide and over 50 nationalities, we're proud to be an equal opportunity workplace with diverse perspectives and ideas.



Our purpose to help people and businesses help each other is a tall order, but we keep it real. We're a great bunch of humans, doing awesome stuff, without fuss or pretense. A successful Trustpilot future is driven by you –– we give you the autonomy to shape a career you can be proud of. If you're ready to grow, let's go.


**Join us at the heart of trust.**


*Trustpilot is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Trustpilot will consider all applications for employment w

**New York, New York**


**Sales Account Manager**


**Pay from $85,000 to $135,000 per year**


Uline, a name millions of businesses across North America know and trust, is looking for an experienced Sales Account Manager to build our growing New York, New York market.


Your role on our Sales team is to help businesses from every industry discover quality products with speed and service you’ll be proud to deliver.


**Why Sales at Uline?**

* **“CEO” of Your Territory \-** Identify growth opportunities within your markets. Meet with existing customers on\-site and build relationships.
* **Be a Part of a Winning Team \-** Join our New York City sales team for comradery, training, and department meetings via regular trips to the office.
* **Learn from the Best \-** Receive 4 weeks of Uline\-specific sales training followed by a 12\-week mentorship program and continuous career development.

Responsible for selling Masimo’s Acute Care product portfolio and developing strategic relationships with a variety of clinical leaders in targeted hospitals. * Conduct and assist clinical specialists with Physical Inventories as part of the sales process.
* Conduct presentations that discuss Masimo’s value proposition.
* Drive all products sales in assigned Masimo territory.
* Identify and develop working relationships with clinical thought leaders at strategic accounts to position the benefits in care processes and patients’ outcomes of Masimo’s wireless Pulse CO\-Oximetry and Floor Monitoring solutions.

* Responsible for articulating information in clinical studies regarding Masimo technologies.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Successful history managing customer interactions, with excellent organizational and time management skills.
* Superior written and verbal communication skills and exceptional ability to lead group presentations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Successful history of selling innovative, paradigm shifting patient care solutions a significant plus.

Demonstrated ability in building clinical champions.

**Education**

Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

The anticipated salary for this position is $90,000 plus benefits. This position also qualifies for variable compensation up to $140,000 at 100% of annual sales objectives.

jobs.description:
**About Suno**
==============


We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.


Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.


Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

**About the Role**
==================


Suno is building its relationships with partners to create new and unique musical experiences that our technology makes possible. We're exploring how we can work across studios, agencies, education, health and wellness, and consumer platforms — companies finding new ways to collaborate, tell stories, learn, heal, and bring generative music into products people already love. The agreement is the starting line. What matters is what partners are able to build, how well we support them along the way, and what we learn from them; that is where this role lives. You'll own the operational and relationship layer: onboarding partners, helping them actively explore how to use the product, gathering and synthesizing their feedback, and leaving behind the process and materials the team can build on. You'll work day to day with our Growth and Commercial Strategy leads, Product Manager, and Product Marketing Manager. You'll be the person partners hear from most. This is a hands\-on role supporting partners across a wide range of industries in a new business, with no established playbook. It is a three\-month contract engagement starting immediately, with the possibility of converting to a full\-time role for the right fit.

**What You'll Do**
==================

* Design and run onboarding for beta partners, from account and access setup through kickoff, enablement, and billing, while creating repeatable processes as you go
* Serve as the primary day\-to\-day contact for partners, fielding questions, coordinating with Engineering and Support on issues, and driving them to resolution
* Manage program logistics and tracking, improving our existing partner tracker so that partner status, open issues, and next steps are always clear to the team
* Build strong relationships with partners and drive adoption, monitoring usage and proactively re\-engaging partners whose integrations have stalled
* Collect partner feedback through a consistent cadence of check\-ins, identify patterns across the cohort, and translate them into actionable input for Product and Marketing
* Keep partners warm and informed with regular updates on roadmap, milestones, and new capabilities
* Support the commercial motion alongside the Growth and Commercial Strategy leads, including qualifying inbound interest, preparing for partner conversations, and keeping evaluation and contracting steps moving with Legal and Finance
* Cultivate partner advocacy with Product Marketing, including case studies and reference commitments

**What You'll Need**
====================

* 4\+ years in customer success, partner operations, technical account management, or program management, ideally supporting partners at an early\-stage company
* Experience owning post\-sale relationships end to end, including onboarding, adoption, and renewal conversations
* Enough technical fluency to be credible with a technical audience — comfortable with API concepts, documentation, and understanding an issue well enough to escalate it clearly

jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
amfAR, The Foundation for AIDS Research, is seeking a dynamic and strategic Social Media Manager.

amfAR is a leading nonprofit advancing scientific discovery to improve global health, with a primary and enduring commitment to ending the HIV/AIDS epidemic. As a catalyst for breakthrough science, amfAR supports innovative research in HIV and other diseases where viruses and the immune system play a critical role. Since 1985, amfAR has raised more than $950 million and awarded in excess of 3,900 grants to scientists worldwide.

**PRIMARY FUNCTION:**

The Social Media Manager will lead the execution and growth of amfAR’s social media presence, prioritizing Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn and YouTube (while also being proficient in Facebook and X). Reporting to the Director of Integrated Marketing, this role will develop and produce compelling digital storytelling that highlights amfAR’s scientific leadership, global impact, and philanthropic community. This hands\-on content role will not only shape strategy, but will also create original content, including video, photography, and written posts, as well as capture real\-time moments that bring amfAR’s mission to life online.

A key part of this role will be covering amfAR’s high\-profile fundraising events and galas, producing dynamic social content that highlights the impact and community behind these gatherings.

The ideal candidate is adept at identifying trending stories and cultural moments, and who can use social media to translate mission\-driven work into content that informs, inspires, and mobilizes audiences.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Plan, create, edit, and schedule organic and sponsored social media content ensuring alignment with voice, brand, and organization initiatives.
* Develop and maintain integrated social media content calendar aligned with marketing campaigns, research announcements, special events, and advocacy initiatives.
* Create social media strategy for amfAR’s portfolio of domestic and international fundraising events and galas, including leading development of platform specific coverage live on\-site before, during, and after events (behind\-the\-scenes content, interviews, and highlight moments) in collaboration with Media Relations team.
* Liaise with sponsors and partners to develop unique content that aligns with amfAR’s mission and exposes new audiences to the organization.
* Work interdepartmentally among Public Information, Public Policy and Research teams to highlight amfAR’s grantees and supporters, translating complex research and policy topics into accessible, engaging digital content.
* Partner with Philanthropy team and find new ways for utilizing social media for fundraising, and building donor loyalty.
* Manage social listening and engage in organization\-related online conversations; respond to social media inquiries in a timely and courteous fashion.
* Collaborate with the media relations team to build and foster relationships with influencers and creators, developing platform\-specific content that supports brand campaigns, events and overall organizational goals.
* Monitor social media industry trends, tools, and applications and recommend actions and next steps.
* Create quantitative and qualitative analysis reports of social media content performance for the management team and Board of Trustees.
* Demonstrated ability and willingness to leverage AI technologies to support job responsibilities, improve workflows, and adapt to evolving business needs.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* 5\-7 years of social media management experience with a brand, nonprofit organization, media company, or digital agency and a proven history of growing social audiences.
* Proficiency in creating and producing niche\-specific content for social media platforms (especially with TikTok, Instagram, and LinkedIn).
* Technical knowledge and understanding of Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn Business Manager, and TikTok Ads Manager.
* Familiarity with social media management and listening platforms such as Sprout Social and Meltwater to support content planning, publishing, audience engagement, and performance analytics.
* BA in communications, marketing or a related field preferred.
* Experience with global health media and knowledge of HIV/AIDS issues and policies preferred, but not required.
* Excellent creative writing and oral communication skills with the ability to adapt tone for different audiences and platforms.
* Basic video editing capabilities required.
* Proficiency with common computer office applications.
* Strong team collaboration and interpersonal skills.
* Exceptional organizational skills and the ability to multi\-task and work in a fast\-moving environment.
* Flexibility to work extended hours and travel both domestically and internationally.

Outstanding benefits package that encompasses: medical, dental, life, STD, LTD, vision coverage, commuter, dependent care and medical FSA savings, 403B with a very generous employer match. Time off includes: vacation, personal, sick days, and Summer Fridays.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Digital Marketing & Ecommerce Agency
jobs.description:
You are the person who keeps things moving.

You know what needs to happen, who needs to do it, and when it needs to be done. You take notes because details matter. You follow up because deadlines matter. And you don't wait until something becomes a problem to address it.

You are organized without being rigid, direct without being difficult, and comfortable holding people accountable. When several projects are moving at once, you don't get overwhelmed — you create structure.

If that sounds like you, we'd like to meet you.

**About Us**

We are a growing boutique digital marketing agency based in downtown Manhattan, working with brands across food, fashion, health \& beauty, ecommerce and emerging consumer categories.

Our work spans ecommerce, content development, SEO, paid media, email marketing, and digital strategy.

We are a small, hands\-on team. That means everyone has an impact, ideas are welcome.

We are looking for a full\-time, in\-person Project Manager who can become a central part of our team and help make the agency run better every day.

**The Role**

As Project Manager, you will be at the center of our client work, coordinating projects across creative, web design, ecommerce optimization, email, and paid media.

Your job is simple to describe but challenging to do well: keep the work organized, keep the team aligned, and keep projects moving forward.

You will have visibility across multiple clients and projects simultaneously, making sure priorities are clear, resources are coordinated, deadlines are planned, and deliverables are completed accurately and on time.

You won't simply update project management software. We want someone who understands the work, anticipates what comes next, identifies problems early and actively helps the team solve them.

**What You'll Do**

* Manage multiple client projects, deliverables and timelines simultaneously
* Build and maintain clear project briefs and schedules
* Make sure every client deliverable is accounted for in our project management system
* Coordinate priorities, resources and dependencies across the team
* Follow up proactively with team members and hold people accountable to deadlines
* Identify potential delays, bottlenecks and risks before they become problems
* Communicate project status clearly to the internal team
* Help prioritize workloads when multiple projects compete for resources
* Ensure established workflows and Standard Operating Procedures are followed
* Recommend improvements to our processes and SOPs
* Help us continually make the agency more organized, efficient and effective

**What We're Looking For**

* 3\+ years of project management experience, preferably within a creative, digital, advertising or marketing agency
* Experience managing multiple complex projects and deadlines concurrently
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience
* Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail
* Strong written and interpersonal communication skills
* Confidence following up, asking questions and holding people accountable
* Ability to remain calm and solutions\-oriented when priorities change
* Strong sense of ownership and personal accountability
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving, collaborative environment
* Experience with Asana and Google Workspace
* Familiarity with Shopify and Klaviyo is strongly preferred
* Strong working knowledge of AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude, including using AI for research, organization, problem\-solving and productivity

**You'll Probably Love This Role If...**

You like checking things off a list.

You notice when something is missing before anyone else does.

You'd rather ask "Where are we on this?" today than discover tomorrow that something is late.

You enjoy creating order from a lot of moving pieces.

You're passionate about ecommerce, digital marketing, technology and AI, and you genuinely enjoy learning as they evolve.

And you're looking for a place where you can contribute ideas, improve how things are done and make a visible difference.

Bonus points if you are also a creative and conceptual thinker who enjoys brainstorming ideas, thinking strategically and helping turn a vision into something the team can execute.

**One Important Thing**

This is not a passive project management position.

We aren't looking for someone whose job ends with updating Asana. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, asks questions, follows through and helps the entire team do better work.

If you see yourself in this description, we'd love to hear from you.

Tell us a little about yourself, your project management experience, and why you think you'd be a good fit for our team.

This is a full\-time, in\-person position based in downtown Manhattan, with significant opportunity to learn, grow and take on greater responsibility as our agency grows.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $25\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Compensation Package:

* Bonus opportunities

Application Question(s):

* Q1: Some people keep lists to make sure things are done in order, while others keep lists so that they do not forget. How would you classify yourself? Can you give examples of the way you manage?
* Q2: Can you describe a time when you had to set priorities? What was your focus and what was the outcome?
* Q3: How do you balance between making sure details are correct and making sure projects are done at an efficient rate? What are the problems you have faced in making sure items are accurate? Give a specific example.
* Q4: Do you prefer to work under close supervision or with autonomy? In the workplace, what makes structure or lack of structure enjoyable? Give an example of an experience that illustrates your preference.
