jobs.title: Fulfillment Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Us:**


God’s Love We Deliver, a nonsectarian organization, is the New York metropolitan area’s leading provider of life\-sustaining meals and nutrition counseling for people living with severe illnesses. Begun as an HIV/AIDS service organization, God’s Love provides for people living with more than 200 individual diagnoses. God’s Love cooks and home delivers the specific, nutritious meals a client’s severe illness and treatment so urgently require. Meals are individually tailored for each client by one of our Registered Dietitians, and all clients have access to unlimited nutrition counseling. God’s Love supports families by providing meals for the children and senior caregivers of our clients. All of our services are provided at no cost to our clients.

 **About the Role:**


The Fulfillment Coordinator is responsible for coordinating the daily workflow of the Fulfillment floor to ensure the accurate, efficient, and timely packing of client meal orders. This role prepares the packing area, coordinates inventory availability, communicates order changes and substitutions, oversees labeling and route organization, and supports volunteers and staff throughout the production process. The Fulfillment Coordinator plays a key role in maintaining quality standards, food safety, and operational efficiency while ensuring client orders are completed accurately and on schedule.

 **Responsibilities:**

* Prepare the Fulfillment floor prior to the start of each shift by ensuring all required inventory, supplies, and workstations are organized and ready for volunteers.
* Communicate daily substitutions, product updates, and packing instructions to volunteers before each packing session.
* Monitor inventory levels throughout production and replenish meal components and supplies as needed to maintain workflow.
* Receive, organize, and sort route manifest labels by delivery route, including separating Healthy Start and minced/pureed client orders.
* Ensure all Healthy Start and other specialty meal orders are completed accurately and prioritized according to production schedules.
* Provide direction and support to volunteers during packing activities, answering questions and ensuring adherence to established procedures.
* Monitor quality, accuracy, and food safety standards throughout the packing process.
* Assists in maintaining the fulfillment room in an organized manner, including any shelf stable food components, thereby creating a positive work environment for staff and volunteers.
* Cover Fulfillment floor operations as needed during volunteer shift transitions or staff absences.
 **About You:**

**Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience in warehouse, fulfillment, food production, logistics, or related operations.
* Strong organizational, time management, and prioritization skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills, with the ability to identify and resolve operational issues quickly.
* Basic computer proficiency, including Microsoft Office applications.
* Strong leadership skills and collaboration skills, including coordinating teams, partnering across departments, and training and motivating volunteers.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
* Ability to coordinate workflow while maintaining production schedules.
* Ability to stand and walk for extended periods throughout the workday.
* Ability to frequently lift and move items weighing up to 50 pounds.
* Ability to bend, reach, push, pull, and carry materials throughout the facility.
* Ability to work in refrigerated production and warehouse environments as needed.
* Demonstrated agility in working in a fast\-paced food production and fulfillment environment, including frequent interactions with staff, volunteers, and multiple operational departments.
**Preferred:**

* Associates degree.
* Experience coordinating volunteers or production teams.
* Knowledge of food safety and sanitation practices.

jobs.title: Clin Research Coordinator II - School of Medicine Eagle Eye Suite
jobs.description:

We welcome candidates who can contribute to the excellence of our academic community. Description:

The Eagle\-Eye Suite is seeking a highly motivated and detail\-oriented Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) II to support groundbreaking ophthalmic research with a focus on glaucoma, axonal imaging, and ocular biomechanics. This position is funded by both the National Institutes of Health (NIH) and the Emory Eye Center. The CRC II will play a central role in recruiting, screening, and enrolling participants into clinical research studies; performing high\-quality optical coherence tomography (OCT) imaging of the optic nerve head and retina; preparing and maintaining Institutional Review Board (IRB) submissions; extracting retrospective data from EPIC; and manually segmenting OCT images to support AI research. The role requires frequent interaction with patients, research staff, and clinicians from Emory and VA clinics.  

ABOUT THE EAGLE\-EYE SUITE. Founded in July 2025 by Dr. Michaël Girard, the Eagle\-Eye Suite is the first AI\-powered imaging suite for eye health in the Georgia region. Located in Clinic B of the Emory Eye Center, the facility is dedicated to advancing diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment strategies for both eye and systemic diseases, with a strong emphasis on glaucoma research and biomechanics of the optic nerve head and axons.  

The Clinical Research Coordinator II handles administrative activities generally associated with the conduct of clinical trials.  

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:* Manages research project databases, develops flow sheets and other study related documents, and completes source documents/case report forms.
* Provides guidance to less experienced staff.
* Interfaces with research participants, determines eligibility and consents study participants according to protocol.

* Assists in developing recruitment strategies and conducting screenings for study participants including interviews and questionnaires.
* Supervises collection of study specimens and processing.
* Establishes case packages for study procedures, monitors scheduling of procedures and charges, coordinates other services as needed.
* Ensures compliance with research protocols, reviews case report forms and audits for accuracy with source documents, attends monitoring meetings with sponsors.
* Prepares regulatory submissions.
* With appropriate credentialing and training may perform phlebotomy or diagnostics.

jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
**Who we are:**



Illumia is an industry leader in bringing the best integrated technology solutions to education, healthcare, and business campuses worldwide. Illumia was built on the collective expertise of two legacy cultures, and brings together people, technology, and insight to pioneer the art of the experience across the communities we serve. Be a part of this exciting organization and improving the lives of people doing mission\-critical work.


**Why join our team?**



We strive to provide the best customer experience in the industry and have succeeded with a single, strong motivating principle: We serve our user community.



Our success and growth are directly attributed to our people. Our newly named company is dedicated to fostering a culture of integrity, respect, and continuous personal development. We maintain an entrepreneurial spirit, where creativity, innovative problem\-solving, and learning agility drive our day\-to\-day actions.


**What you will be doing:**



Illumia is seeking a strategic, hands\-on Social Media Manager to own our organic social media presence, our employee advocacy program, and the strategy for expanding our reach to new platforms. This role manages the enterprise social media calendar — coordinating content contributed by Growth Marketing, Events, Brand, Product Marketing, and Engagement teams alongside original brand content built to drive awareness and follower growth — and owns the Sprout Social advocacy program end\-to\-end, from content submission through results reporting. The ideal candidate is a self\-driven mover and shaker — genuinely passionate about social media, who takes ownership of the role and proactively finds ways to grow it, rather than waiting to be told what to do next. They are highly organized, data\-informed, and excited to build out Illumia's presence on new channels, including unlocking the untapped potential of our existing YouTube content.


### **Job Summary / Purpose**


**Who you will work with:**



This role partners closely with Growth Marketing, Events, Brand, Product Marketing, and Engagement teams to coordinate their content into the social media calendar. The Social Media Manager also works with the Senior Communications Strategist to ensure brand and messaging consistency across channels, with Human Resources on employee advocacy program adoption. This role reports to the Sr. Director, Marketing.


### **Key Responsibilities and Duties**


**Channel Strategy \& Expansion**


* Develops and executes a strategic plan for Illumia's social media presence to include platform expansion and messaging.
* Builds a specific plan to activate and grow a YouTube presence, leveraging Illumia's existing video and content assets that are currently underutilized.
* Recommends platform\-specific best practices and content formats to maximize reach and engagement on each channel.


**Social Media Calendar \& Content Coordination**


* Owns and manages the enterprise social media calendar, coordinating incoming content from marketing teams into a single, unified publishing schedule.
* Builds and publishes original brand content designed to drive brand awareness and follower growth across corporate social channels.
* Ensure consistent brand voice, quality, and publishing cadence across all scheduled content, regardless of the source team.


**Employee Advocacy Program (Sprout Social)**


* Owns and manages the Sprout Social employee advocacy program end\-to\-end: adding new content for employees to share, monitoring submissions and participation, and tracking results.
* Identifies and recommends improvements to increase employee adoption, participation, and reach through the program.


**Social Listening, Engagement \& Response**


* Monitors social channels daily for mentions, comments, and engagement (social listening), responding to posts and messages in a timely, on\-brand manner, as well as escalating or redirecting as necessary.
* Tracks engagement and sentiment trends and reports out regularly on social listening insights and response activity.


**Process, Documentation \& Reporting**


* Documents social media processes, workflows, and best practices to ensure consistency and continuity.
* Owns data analysis across all social programs — advocacy, organic content, and social listening — with insights and recommendations for improvement.


**What You'll Bring:**



Required Qualifications


* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
* 3\-5\+ years of experience in social media management or community management.
* Proven experience managing organic social media programs and content calendars across multiple platforms.
* Experience with social media management and social listening tools (e.g., Sprout Social, Hootsuite, or similar).
* Strong writing skills for social\-specific formats and platform\-native content.
* Strong project management, organizational, and time management skills.


Preferred Qualifications


* Direct experience with Sprout Social, including managing an employee advocacy program.
* Experience developing or executing a multi\-channel or platform expansion strategy (e.g., YouTube, TikTok).
* Experience with video content strategy or repurposing existing video assets for social distribution.
* Experience in B2B, SaaS, fintech, technology, or higher education industries.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Monday.com, HubSpot, or similar platforms.

These functions are the fundamental job duties required for successful performance.

jobs.title: Pro Sales Representative - Atlanta
jobs.description:
Position Purpose:  


The Pro Sales Representative works to build strong relationships with our Pro customers and executes a sales strategy to profitably grow sales for assigned accounts to support the organization's goals and increases the company's market share. This role is responsible for managing the full sales cycle of a designated portfolio, both existing and new, by identifying sales opportunities, managing a sales pipeline, and achieving assigned sales goals and gross margin targets. The Pro Sales Representative drives sales growth by proactively prospecting and engaging both new and existing B2B customers through high outbound activity, including cold calls, outreach initiatives. The Pro Sales Representative is also responsible for negotiating projects, developing tailored solutions to meet customer needs, closing sales, and resolving issues effectively and in a timely manner. The Pro Sales Representative must demonstrate broad product and services knowledge and utilize comprehensive business acumen and a knowledge of other functional departments to support the growth of their portfolio and effectively collaborate with cross\-functional partners.  


Key Responsibilities:  


10% \- Customer Review and Development \- Engage with sales leadership to review sales calls, provide account insights and sales plan opportunities with manager. Participate in training sessions focused on product knowledge (including, but not limited to, building supplies, construction jobs, etc.), process improvements, and strategic initiatives.  
30% \- Inbound Customer Engagement and Sales Growth \- Resolve order and delivery issues with a professional support team. Resolve customer challenges by investigating problems and developing sustainable and scalable solutions in collaboration with the in\-store Pro Sales teams and Pro Support team. Transact and tender, when necessary, with a professional support team. Follow\-up on completed orders for feedback.  
60% \- Outbound Customer Engagement and Sales Growth \- Research accounts, identify key players and generate interest. Achieve prospecting and sales goals effectively and consistently by proactively adjusting to market changes, closing sales and achieving sales plan. Source new sales opportunities through ongoing prospecting via inbound lead follow\-up and outbound warm/hot and cold calling. Drive incremental sales growth with assigned customer portfolio. Execute sales strategy by introducing both new and existing customers to our current capabilities, ensuring they understand how these solutions align with their specific needs. Strategically build and maintain strong customer relationships to foster long\-term partnerships by understanding and anticipating customer needs, offering custom solutions while effectively communicating competitive strengths. Effectively communicate competitive strengths and develop strategic goals to acquire incremental business.  


Direct Manager/Direct Reports:  


This Position typically reports to the Pro Sales Representative Manager  
This Position has 0 Direct Reports  


Travel Requirements:  


Typically requires overnight travel less than 5% of the time.  


Physical Requirements:  


Most of the time is spent sitting in a comfortable position and there is frequent opportunity to move about. On rare occasions, there may be a need to move or lift light articles.  


Working Conditions:  


Located in a comfortable indoor area. Any unpleasant conditions would be infrequent and not objectionable.  


Minimum Qualifications:  


Must be 18 years of age or older  
Must be legally permitted to work in the United States  


Preferred Qualifications:  


Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite  
Working knowledge of presentation software (e.g., Microsoft PowerPoint)  
Demonstrated ability to collaborate and work effectively with cross\-functional teams  
Demonstrated project management skills  
Ability to negotiate, handle complaints, settle disputes, and resolve grievances with both internal and external customers  
Excellent written and verbal communication skills  
Retail, proven inside sales or telephone sales experience  
Experience working with Salesforce.com or similar CRM  
Understanding and application of strategic planning to identify, target and execute plans for sales growth  
Highly motivated  
Understanding and application of strategic planning to identify, target and execute plans for sales growth in areas like building supplies, construction, and lumber

The knowledge, skills and abilities typically acquired through the completion of a high school diploma and/or GED.  


Preferred Education:  


The knowledge, skills and abilities typically acquired through the completion of a bachelor's degree program or equivalent degree in a field of study related to the job

2

3  


Minimum Leadership Experience:  


None  


Preferred Leadership Experience:  


None  


Certifications:  


None

Action Oriented  
Collaborates  
Communicates Effectively  
Customer Focus  
Drives Results

jobs.title: Part-Time Sales Representative — Metro Atlanta
jobs.description:
Part\-Time Sales Representative — Metro Atlanta

Tossie Advisory Group (TAG)

About the Role

Tossie Advisory Group is looking for a part\-time, locally\-based Sales Representative to grow subscriptions to the TAG Command Center — a suite of AI\-powered financial literacy and career tools built for hourly workers, veterans, and single\-income households across Metro Atlanta. TAG was founded and is owned by a retired military veteran and retired VA employee — after a career inside the federal system, he watched qualified people get screened out of opportunities they were fully prepared for, not for lack of experience, but because their paperwork never made it past the first filter. That's the reason TAG exists.

This is a relationship\-driven, community\-facing sales role, not a cold\-call boiler room job. You'll introduce local churches, community organizations, veteran groups, and individuals to TAG's tools and books — helping people take their first step toward financial literacy and stronger career prospects, while earning commission on every subscriber and product sale you bring in.

What You'll Do

Represent TAG at local community events, veteran resource fairs, church financial\-literacy nights, and small\-business meetups across Metro Atlanta

Introduce prospects to the TAG Starter and Command Center subscription tiers, the "Stock Investing For Poor People" book series, and a la carte products — most notably The Read Resume Service (a personally hand\-reworked resume, done by the founder or his team — not AI self\-service — with a built\-in veteran discount)

Build simple relationships and follow\-ups with local organizations (referral partnerships, group presentations, tabling)

Track leads and closed sales using a shared log (Google Sheet or CRM provided)

Report weekly to the founder on activity and results

Compensation

Base: $15/hour for 12–15 hours/week (flexible scheduling, some evenings/weekends for events)

Commission: Additional per\-sale commission on top of base —

$10 per new TAG Starter subscriber ($19\.99/mo)

$20 per new TAG Command Center or Command Center Plus subscriber ($39\.99–$59\.99/mo)

$50 per new TAG Business subscriber ($150/mo)

15% commission on a la carte sales — including The Read Resume Service ($147 standard / $124\.95 veteran / \+$105 rush) and book sales

Commission paid monthly; no cap on earnings

Who We're Looking For

Lives in or near Metro Atlanta and can travel locally to events

Comfortable talking to people one\-on\-one and in small groups — no prior "tech sales" background required

Genuine interest in financial literacy, career development, or community outreach

Self\-starter who can manage their own schedule and follow up on leads

Bonus: existing ties to veteran organizations, churches, or community groups in the Atlanta area

About TAG

Tossie Advisory Group (TAG) blends faith, financial literacy, and street\-level wisdom to make investing and career growth accessible to people who've been left out of traditional financial education — grounded in the 3F Framework: Faith, Finance, Foundations. TAG is founded and owned by a retired military veteran and retired VA employee, which shapes its work with veterans, transitioning service members, and federal job seekers directly.

Soli Deo Gloria.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**
===================

**Business Development Representative (BDR) – YM Careers Network**

YM Careers is seeking a motivated, ambitious, and relationship\-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our growing sales team. This role is ideal for early\-career professionals who are eager to learn consultative sales, develop business development expertise, and help organizations connect with highly qualified talent through industry\-specific career centers.


As a BDR, you will be responsible for identifying and engaging recruiters, talent acquisition leaders, and hiring managers at organizations that have not yet utilized the YM Careers Network. You'll introduce prospective employers to our portfolio of niche career centers, uncover hiring challenges, and create opportunities for our Account Executive team to demonstrate how YM Careers can help organizations reach specialized professional audiences.


This role is an excellent fit for someone who enjoys building relationships, is energized by prospecting and outreach, and wants a clear path for career growth in sales and recruitment marketing. YM Careers provides comprehensive training, structured onboarding, ongoing coaching, and mentorship from experienced sales leaders.


**A Day in the Life**

* Research and identify prospective employers, recruiters, and talent acquisition professionals within target organizations.
* Prospect new business opportunities through cold calling, email outreach, LinkedIn networking, and other outbound sales activities.
* Engage hiring decision\-makers in consultative conversations to understand their recruitment challenges, hiring goals, and talent acquisition strategies.
* Educate prospective clients on the value of niche career centers and how YM Careers helps employers connect with highly qualified industry\-specific talent.
* Qualify opportunities and schedule introductory meetings and product demonstrations for the sales team.
* Utilize tools such as Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, and other prospecting platforms to build and manage pipeline activity.
* Collaborate with sales leadership and teammates to refine messaging, outreach strategies, and prospecting best practices.
* Maintain accurate records of prospect interactions, activities, and opportunities within Salesforce.
* Develop expertise in recruitment advertising, talent acquisition trends, and the unique hiring needs of professional associations and their employer communities.
* Collaborate with Marketing to plan and deliver monthly webinars for recruiters, generating engagement, nurturing prospects, and creating new business opportunities for the sales team.
* Attend recruiting and talent acquisition industry conferences and trade shows to network with prospective clients, increase brand awareness, and identify new sales opportunities.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Consistently generating qualified sales opportunities for the Account Executive team.
* Building a strong pipeline of prospective employers across multiple industries.
* Developing confidence in outbound prospecting, discovery conversations, and value\-based selling.
* Becoming a trusted resource for organizations seeking effective ways to attract specialized talent.
Contributing to the continued growth and success of the YM Careers Network.  
* 

**What You Bring**

**Qualifications**

* **Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or related field preferred OR 1–3 years of relevant work experience** (internships, part‑time jobs, campus leadership, customer service, volunteer roles, etc.)
* Strong proficiency in **Microsoft Office** (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook)
* Clear, professional communication skills — written and verbal
* Interest in learning sales and building a long‑term career in a customer‑facing role

**Characteristics**

* Curious and eager to learn new skills
* Proactive self‑starter with a positive, can‑do attitude
* Resilient when facing challenges or rejection
* Strong critical thinking and problem‑solving abilities
* High attention to detail and good organizational habits
* Comfortable talking to new people and building relationships

Team player who enjoys contributing to a supportive, collaborative environment  

* 

**Work Environment \& Flexibility**

This role follows a **hybrid work schedule** based at our Buckhead office in Atlanta (3495 Piedmont Road NE Atlanta, GA 30305\):


* **Onsite:** Tuesday–Thursday
* **Remote:** Monday, Friday

This structure supports team collaboration, coaching, and hands‑on learning — all essential for early‑career success.

============

Momentive Software amplifies the impact of over 20,000 purpose\-driven organizations in over 30 countries, with over $11 billion raised and 55 million members served to date. Mission\-driven nonprofits and associations rely on Momentive’s cloud\-based software and services to address their most pressing challenges – from engaging their communities to simplifying operations and growing revenue. Designed to help organizations connect more, manage more, and ultimately expect more, Momentive's solutions are built with reliability at the core and strategically focus on fundraising, learning, events, careers, volunteering, accounting, and association management. Momentive partners with organizations that believe "good enough" is never enough – so they can bring on better outcomes for everyone they serve. Learn more at momentivesoftware.com .  

  



**Why Work Here?**
==================

At Momentive Software, we’re a team of passionate problem\-solvers, innovators, and volunteers who believe in using technology to make a real difference. We dream big, support each other, and take pride in creating solutions that help our customers drive meaningful change. If you’re looking for a place where your work matters and your ideas are valued, you’ll find it here.

jobs.description:
**Location:** Remote **Job Type:** Full\-Time **Compensation:** Draw \+ Lucrative Commission \+ Performance Incentives

 **The Opportunity**


Are you a self\-motivated "hunter" who thrives on variety? Guide Book Publishing, an industry leader since 1991, is looking for a strategic Advertising Account Executive. Unlike traditional sales roles where you call the same list for years, our team moves to a **new assignment every 2\-3 weeks**, helping local businesses across 24 states reach "micro\-communities" through high\-quality direct\-mail advertising.

 **How it Works**

* **The Workflow:** You’ll switch assignments frequently, focusing on businesses within a 3\-5 mile radius of a specific congregation or community center.
* **The Method:** 70% of your time is spent on high\-energy outreach (phone, email, and video meetings); 20% on market research; and 10% on contract execution.
* **The Flexibility:** This is a remote role, but does require getting your materials back to the Post Office to return to the Home Office.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* **New Business Development:** Identify and close new advertising partnerships to meet production goals.
* **Consultative Sales:** Educate local business owners on the ROI of being featured in our community guides and directories.
* **Relationship Management:** Act as the primary liaison between your clients and our operations staff to ensure an excellent experience.
* **Account Growth:** Nurture and maintain large\-scale accounts within your metro area.
* **Administrative Precision:** Manage contracts and paperwork accurately and return assignment materials via USPS upon completion.

 **Compensation \& Benefits**


We offer a structure that rewards high performers and provides security through a comprehensive benefits package via ADP TotalSource.

* **Draw \& Commission:** Payroll is based on "Cash In" from sales, with a Draw program available to stabilize income as you build your funnel.
* **Performance Bonuses:** Additional incentive pay for hitting Assignment, Monthly, Quarterly, and Annual targets.
* **Benefits:**
	+ Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
	+ 401(k) with Company Match
	+ Life Insurance
	+ Paid Time Off (PTO)

 **Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 1\-2 years of sales experience preferred (or equivalent education).
* **Mindset:** A self\-starter who can manage their own schedule without being micromanaged.
* **Skills:** Proficient in Excel, scanning, email, and PDF management. Strong ability to calculate discounts and commissions accurately.
* **Communication:** Persuasive verbal skills and clear, professional written communication.
* **Requirements:** Valid Driver’s License and Auto Insurance.

 **Why Guide Book Publishing?**


We serve the communication needs of over 800 micro\-communities. If you are looking for a role that balances the freedom of remote work with the fast\-paced nature of community\-based sales, we want to talk to you.

 **Physical Demands and Work Environment:**

* Requires Valid Driver’s License and Auto Insurance
* Frequently required to sit and utilize a keyboard and phone.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
About Allegis


At Allegis, we live and breathe access hardware opening doors to unparalleled quality and innovation. We help solve customer\-specific problems and supply thousands of products, including handles, latches, hinges, drawer slides, gas springs, sealing profiles, adhesives, and more. To us, these are more than components; they are a factor in contributing to our customers’ success. Our global supply network and engineering expertise ensure you get the perfect part for your application. If we don’t have it, we will find it; if it does not exist, we will create it, providing a customized solution experience.  

  

The Opportunity


The Sales Development Representative is responsible for converting inbound interest and targeted outbound prospecting into qualified sales opportunities. Besides having a target list to engage, you will research accounts, engage business and operational stakeholders, conduct initial discovery, and schedule well\-qualified meetings for Allegis sales professionals.


This is a good fit for a process\-oriented B2B seller who wants meaningful ownership, direct exposure to Sales and Marketing leadership, and a clear path toward Senior SDR, Account Executive, or sales\-development leadership roles.


What You’ll Do


As a foundational member of the company’s sales development function, the SDR will follow clear qualification, routing, and follow\-up standards while helping refine Allegis’ messaging and playbooks through direct market feedback and prospect conversations.

* Respond to inbound inquiries and marketing\-qualified leads promptly, prioritizing high\-intent requests and meeting the established speed\-to\-lead service level.
* Research target accounts and build thoughtful prospect lists using HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Clay, and other available data sources.
* Execute coordinated outreach through phone, email, and LinkedIn, using automation to support—not replace—relevant, personalized communication.
* Conduct initial discovery to understand businessneeds,fit, stakeholders, urgency, and next steps.
* Schedule qualified meetings and provide Account Executives with complete context, notes, and agreed follow\-up actions.
* Maintain accurate lifecycle stages, activity records, qualification details, and disposition data in HubSpot.
* Partner with Sales and Marketing Operations on enterprise account plays and targeted campaigns.
* Share weekly feedback on lead quality, prospect objections, competitive signals, channel performance, and messaging opportunities.


How Success Will Be Measured


During onboarding, goals will be prorated while you complete product, market, process, and HubSpot training. At steady state, the scorecard will balance activity, quality, and pipeline outcomes:

* Timely follow\-up on assigned inbound leads, with at least 95% completed within the established service level.
* Consistent, high\-quality outbound prospecting across assigned accounts and segments.
* Approximately30–45sales\-qualified leads per month, calibrated to territory, lead volume, and segment mix.
* Approximately15–20AE\-accepted opportunities per month, with a target SQL\-to\-opportunity conversion rate of 60% or better.
* $400,000 or more in qualified pipeline created per quarter, subject to assigned segment and average opportunity value.
* At least a 70% held\-meeting rate and 95% CRM activity\-logging compliance.


Final definitions, crediting rules, quota, territory, ramp expectations, and incentive\-plan terms will be reviewed in writing before the start date.


What You Bring

* An outgoingand energetic personality with the confidence to make calls and build a connection with people as you go.
* One to three years of B2B prospecting, inside\-sales, customer\-development, or closely related experience.
* Evidence of meeting goals in a role that required consistent outreach, follow\-through, and accurate documentation.
* Strong phone, email, and LinkedIn communication skills; you communicate clearly and professionally.
* Curiosity and the ability to learn industrial products, customer operations, and technical value propositions.
* A coachable, resilient, and accountable working style.
* Comfort using a CRM and learning new prospecting and sales\-enablement tools.


Helpful, but Not Required

* Experience in manufacturing, distribution, industrial services, or technical B2B sales.
* Hands\-on experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, or another modern CRM.
* Experience with account\-based prospecting, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Clay, or similar tools.
* Exposure to a structured qualification method such as BANT, PAINS,or MEDDIC.
* Thoughtful use of AI tools for research, preparation, personalization, or call notes.


Your First 90 Days

* By day 30:Complete onboarding; build fluency in Allegis offerings, customers, playbooks, and HubSpot; begin executing supervised outreach.
* By day 60:Manage assigned inbound and outbound activity consistently, conduct effective qualification, and contribute qualified pipeline.
* By day 90:Operate independently against a prorated scorecard and contribute actionable feedback that improves conversion and messaging.


Compensation, Benefits \& Development

* Base salary:$60,000–$80,000, based on relevant experience, capabilities, and location.

* Target OTE:$85,000–$120,000\.
* Competitive benefits package including medical, dental, vision and profit sharing.

Your pivotal role involves creating a well\-structured sales funnel through proactive prospecting, ensuring a steady flow of activity and opportunities for our sales team.

* Effectively communicate with prospective customers to understand their needs, answer inquiries, and provide information about our RV products and services.
* Utilize provided scripts and talking points for both initiating and receiving phone calls.
* Proactively make 8\-10 outbound calls per hour with the primary objective of scheduling sales appointments.
* Utilize the CRM system to record and manage customer information, appointments, calls, and sales interactions. Maintaining accurate and up\-to\-date data is essential for efficient follow\-up and tracking.
* Stay up\-to\-date with all ongoing marketing campaigns and promotions. Align your efforts with marketing initiatives to leverage their impact on lead generation and sales conversion.
* Regularly track and analyze your personal performance metrics, including appointments scheduled, calls made, sales achieved, and customer engagements.
* Be receptive to coaching and work closely with the Sales Development Manager to improve departmental success.
* Ensure complete customer satisfaction by helping to proactively manage online reputation through review sites and social media outlets.
* Collaborate with sales team to ensure total department symbiosis and ensure a seamless journey from initial contact to sale.
* VinSolutions experience is a huge plus!

**What You Need to Have for the Role:**

* Clear and concise written and verbal communication
* Results driven and motivated for sales
* Excellent customer service
* Effectively manages responsibilities with time management to reach goals
* Ability to multi\-task while demonstrating strong organizational skills
* Has prior CRM experience and is very computer savvy
* Previous sales experience a plus
* May lift up to 25 lbs and/or move up to 50 lbs. with assistive devices

You are a highly organized, detail\-oriented project professional who enjoys bringing structure, clarity, and follow\-through to complex work. You are comfortable coordinating multiple priorities, maintaining accurate project information, communicating with a variety of stakeholders, and identifying issues before they become larger problems. You take ownership of your commitments, learn quickly, and bring a collaborative, client\-focused mindset to every interaction.


**About The Role**



As a Project Coordinator within the Project Management Office (PMO), you will support Project Managers and Program Managers in the planning, coordination, tracking, and successful delivery of client\-facing technology projects. You will help maintain accurate project schedules, documentation, action items, risks, dependencies, financial information, and status reporting so project teams and stakeholders have timely visibility into progress and emerging concerns. This role is well suited for someone who can balance detail\-oriented administrative execution with proactive communication, sound judgment, and a desire to grow within project management.


**Must be based in the United States of America.** The role may support multiple projects, clients, and internal teams simultaneously and may occasionally coordinate with stakeholders across different time zones.


**Other responsibilities include:**


* Support Project Managers and Program Managers with project planning, coordination, tracking, and follow\-through from initiation through closeout.
* Maintain accurate project schedules, milestones, deliverables, action items, decision logs, risk registers, dependency trackers, and other project controls.
* Coordinate project meetings, prepare agendas and materials, capture notes and decisions, distribute follow\-up actions, and monitor completion.
* Prepare recurring project status updates, dashboards, and health reports using current and validated project information.
* Track project progress against scope, schedule, budget, resource plans, and key client commitments; escalate variances and emerging risks promptly.

* Proactively identify missing information, schedule conflicts, unresolved decisions, and delivery risks; research issues and coordinate resolution with the appropriate owners.
* Support project closeout by confirming deliverables, documentation, financial information, lessons learned, and handoff requirements are complete.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of PMO templates, reporting standards, workflows, and project coordination practices.


**Desired skills and experience:**


* Two to four years of experience in project coordination, project administration, operations support, or a related field; equivalent professional experience will be considered.
* Experience supporting multiple projects, workstreams, customers, or stakeholders while managing competing priorities and deadlines.
* Working knowledge of project management fundamentals, including schedules, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks, issues, and status reporting.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills with exceptional attention to detail and consistent follow\-through.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate professionally with clients, vendors, subcontractors, and internal teams.
* Ability to collect, validate, organize, and summarize project information for project teams and leadership.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Microsoft 365 tools; comfort working with spreadsheets, trackers, shared documents, and presentation materials.

* Ability to identify gaps, ask effective questions, investigate unresolved items, and escalate concerns with appropriate context and urgency.
* Demonstrated ability to build trust, collaborate across functions, and maintain a client\-focused, service\-oriented approach.
* Self\-motivated and dependable, with the ability to work independently in a fully remote environment while staying connected to the broader team.
* A proactive, preventive mindset and eagerness to learn, grow, and take on increasing responsibility within project management.

The Program Coordinator, Maternal Child Health (MCH) Male Involvement is a grant\-funded role responsible for program coordination and administrative oversight of Westside Healthy Start male involvement activities. This position is responsible for coordinating the functions related to program implementation, data collection, and reporting. The position provides education, referrals, and support to expectant fathers and new parents in individual and group settings.

Engages assigned or referred father/male participants in Westside Healthy Start male involvement case management curriculum across all Westside Healthy Start sites, including, assessing participant needs, developing service plans, and connecting participants to appropriate community resources

Strong phone skills.

Focused/organized.

HubSpot and Salesforce proficiency preferred.

jobs.title: Carrier Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Carrier Sales Representative

**Roots Logistics \| Chicago, IL**  
**Full\-Time \| Monday through Friday**

In This Role as a Carrier Sales Representative you will work alongside an experienced Carrier Sales team responsible for securing reliable transportation capacity, negotiating rates, building carrier relationships, and supporting the successful movement of customer freight throughout North America.

This is a hands\-on role that requires strong communication, urgency, organization, negotiation skills, and the ability to manage multiple shipments and carrier relationships at the same time. You will be expected to perform the full responsibilities of a Carrier Sales Representative while also placing a strong emphasis on identifying, developing, and maintaining new carrier relationships.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable working within a close\-knit team environment while taking personal ownership of growing their carrier network. Success in this role requires someone who can service today’s freight while continuously building the carrier relationships Roots Logistics will need tomorrow.

We are looking for someone who views every carrier conversation as an opportunity to build trust, strengthen our network, and create a long\-term partnership.

**Working for Roots Logistics**

At other large companies, employees can easily get lost among numerous departments and layers of management. That is not the case at Roots Logistics.

Although we manage a large and complex transportation operation, we maintain a collaborative team structure that allows employees to communicate seamlessly across departments and locations. Regardless of your job title, you will play an important role in helping the company move forward, meet customer expectations, and continuously improve its operations.

Our Carrier Sales Representatives work closely together, sharing information, supporting one another, and helping the team secure the best possible transportation solutions for our customers. This is an environment where teamwork matters, individual effort is recognized, and your ability to build strong carrier relationships can directly contribute to the company’s growth.

**About Roots Logistics**

Roots Logistics is a growing transportation and freight brokerage company headquartered in Chicago, Illinois. We provide dependable transportation solutions throughout North America by combining an experienced operations team, an extensive carrier network, industry\-leading technology, and around\-the\-clock support.

Our operation is supported by team members in Chicago, Miami, Tampa, Colombia, Serbia, and the Philippines. This structure allows us to provide continuous coverage and responsive service to our customers and carrier partners.

Our vision is to be a progressive company within the complex logistics industry by providing reliable, solutions\-driven service that exceeds our customers’ expectations. We are committed to building long\-term partnerships while creating an environment where employees can develop professionally, expand their skills, and advance their careers.

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**

* Work alongside other Carrier Sales Representatives in a highly collaborative and team\-oriented environment.
* Secure qualified carrier capacity for customer shipments throughout North America.
* Communicate with carriers, dispatchers, drivers, owner\-operators, and fleet managers regarding available freight and equipment.
* Negotiate competitive and sustainable transportation rates.
* Match available carrier capacity with customer freight based on location, equipment type, timing, service requirements, and pricing.
* Prospect for and develop relationships with new carriers.
* Build a personal network of dependable carrier partners that can support recurring and future freight opportunities.
* Maintain and strengthen relationships with existing carriers.
* Conduct regular outbound calls to identify available equipment and new transportation partners.
* Use load boards, referrals, internal systems, industry contacts, and outbound prospecting to source carrier capacity.
* Present available freight clearly and professionally to prospective carrier partners.
* Understand carrier needs, preferred lanes, equipment availability, and operational capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to convert transactional carrier relationships into consistent, long\-term partnerships.
* Assist with carrier onboarding and ensure all required information and documentation are completed.
* Confirm that carriers meet company, customer, insurance, safety, and compliance requirements before being assigned freight.
* Work closely with Operations, Tracking, Customer Sales, and other internal teams to support successful load execution.
* Communicate shipment requirements, appointment information, routing instructions, and customer expectations accurately.
* Confirm carrier acceptance and verify that all load details are clearly understood.
* Monitor assigned shipments and remain engaged throughout the transportation process.
* Assist with resolving carrier\-related delays, service failures, missed appointments, fall\-offs, and communication issues.
* Recover loads when a scheduled carrier cancels or is unable to complete an assignment.
* Maintain accurate carrier, rate, shipment, and communication records within the company’s Transportation Management System.
* Provide timely and accurate updates to internal team members.
* Monitor freight market conditions, carrier availability, capacity changes, and transportation pricing.
* Meet established activity, carrier development, gross margin, service, and performance expectations.
* Demonstrate consistent attendance, dependability, professionalism, and punctuality.
* Perform additional duties as business needs require.

**Qualifications**

* Three years of previous freight brokerage, carrier sales, dispatch, transportation, logistics, or related experience preferred.

Our solutions streamline all working capital\-related processes, including Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Cash Flow Management, and Treasury, across both cloud and SAP environments.

Join us as we lead the future of finance automation!

  

**About the role:**


Customer Success is a core pillar of Serrala's revenue organization. The Scaled Customer Success Manager owns the success of a high\-volume portfolio of SMB and Mid\-Market customers through a one\-to\-many, data\-driven engagement model.

  

This role is being built from the ground up. You will design the playbooks, health scoring, and Early Warning System that don't yet exist, on a product line that is being re\-engineered in parallel. Today, the role runs a high\-engagement, digital\-first cadence with your most strategic accounts, roughly 50% of the book, including QBRs, while managing renewals across the rest. As the model matures, you will lead the shift of this majority of the portfolio toward a fully scaled motion.

  

This is a high\-visibility position, central to Serrala's retention and growth strategy in North America, and to shaping our Tech\-touch approach going forward.

jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Essentra Components is a global market leader in plastic injection molded, vinyl dip molded and metal components. We have a history of over 65 years, producing essential components across a huge range of industries and applications. Making it easier for our customers is our top priority. That's why we operate internationally in 29 countries across 4 continents. With every order, we offer a hassle\-free experience through our 14 manufacturing facilities, 34 distribution centres and 40 sales and service locations.  

We have over 45,000 standard parts and one of the world’s most extensive product offerings, all available for immediate dispatch and fast delivery. Our product range features caps and plugs, wire and cable management, flange protection, knobs, handles and grips, access hardware, PCB and electronics hardware.
Our Vision is to be “The world’s leading responsible hassle\-free supplier of essential industrial components”. **Job Description**  

Essentra is currently hiring an Inside Sales Representative (ISR) who will focus on day\-to\-day development and execution of the inside sales strategy at Essentra Components to drive revenue and sales growth. This individual will act as the liaison between the company and the customer, responsible for creating long\-term, trusting relationships, develop existing business, and actively seeking new sales opportunities. The Inside Sales Representative will utilize customer, product, and industry specific knowledge to engage and grow the customer base. This is a **hybrid position** that will work in our **Schaumburg** office (3 days in the office, 2 days from home). **Typical Accountabilities:*** Develop new business with existing customers and/or qualify new opportunities.
* Coordinate with the Manager to manage large projects and multi\-step opportunities through CRM Pipeline Report.
* Collaborate with purchasing departments, managers, and other staff to confirm that orders are processed with accuracy and efficiency and that products are distributed properly.
* Periodically prepare and report results, status of accounts, and leads to manager.
* Apply knowledge of the field and product features to match products to the needs of clients.
* Answer inquiries from clients concerning products, their uses, and the industry at large.
* Provide product information, quotes, credit terms, and other bid specifications to clients.
* Ensure orders, samples are entered and shipped accurately and on\-time.
* Responsible for quoting catalog items as well as simple non\-stock items.
* Report weekly updates within territory in regard to new opportunities, wins or losses.
* Maintain customer database by entering new accounts, maintaining existing accounts and consistently adding relevant notes.
* Ensure that the Essentra Components service proposition is being executed on a daily basis.
* Acquire and maintain product knowledge and market trends.
* Participate in weekly meetings as well as cross functional management meetings.
* Perform other related job duties as assigned.

 **Qualifications:*** At least 2 years of related work experience in a sales or customer service\-oriented role.
* A college degree in business, marketing or related field is a plus but not required.
* Experience working for an industrial products company is preferred but not required.
* Must be motivated, persuasive and dedicated.
* Willingness to be managed by KPI's and work toward specific daily/weekly/monthly goals.
* Must be able to identify and assess customers’ needs to exceed their expectations.
* Willingness to work in the office 3 days a week.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Works effectively with others by openly sharing ideas, identify with common goals, encourage communication and avoid conflict
* Delivers expected results by acting in a focused way and reacting positively to frustration. Be willing to adapt to changes and different circumstances
* Continuously seeks ways to improve process and increase productivity
* Ability to multi\-task, prioritize, and manage time effectively
* Must be patient, empathetic and be able to put oneself in the customers’ shoes
* Must be a positive thinker and team player.
* Excellent reasoning and analytical ability
* Strong personal integrity and ethics
* A hands\-on/can do attitude driven by the will to accomplish tasks
* Experience using a CRM tool to track sales activity is strongly preferred
* Proficient in MS Office software (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams)
* Have the ability to manage challenging customers in a professional and diplomatic manner.
* Willing to adapt to changes and different circumstances
* Continuously seeks ways to improve process and increase productivity
* Willingness to respond within 2 hours to customer inquiries

 **What We Offer:**  

This position offers a competitive base salary, quarterly bonus incentive, full benefits package, and generous paid time off.  

The expected base salary for this position is $52,000 \- $60,000\. The actual salary offered will depend on skills, experience, and overall qualifications of the individual hired for this role.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close\-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

  

**Department Overview**
-----------------------

The Sales Development Representative is responsible for following up on leads and building pipeline for sellers across all of Motorola's North American Government Sales organization. We represent all of Motorola Solution's products and endeavor to help our customers in their quest of "Solving for Safer" by using our end\-to\-end suite of safety products.
**Job Description**
-------------------

The Sales Development Representative is a key contributor in a rapid growth company while representing a product suite that makes an impact on people's lives. Motorola Solutions is a global leader in public safety and enterprise security. Join our team and help us continue to grow!


**Responsibilities include:**

* Run call cadences (with support of an automated dialer) to educate our future customers on the value our solutions bring and drive interest in an initial conversation.
* Ask smart, targeted questions to build rapport with our prospects and identify opportunities.
* Focus on targeted outbound list.
* Collaborate with seasoned sales professionals within a territory you support to find, develop and build key stakeholder interest, and crystalize the needs of the organization across multiple customer profiles and buyer groups.
* Re\-engage lapsed and long\-term leads as we introduce new product features with a focus on bringing them back into the funnel.
* Record prospect interactions and update records within our CRM.

**Qualifications:**

* Ability to articulate value propositions via phone, video, email, and other various social networking platforms.
* Detail oriented, take exceptional meeting/activity notes, and effective in task and time management.
* Highly motivated, passionate, and results driven.
* Willing and able to contribute to team efforts by accomplishing related tasks as needed .
* Commitment to company vision, mission and values.

Target Base Salary Range: $48,000 \- $52,000 USD


Consistent with Motorola Solutions values and applicable law, we provide the following information to promote pay transparency and equity. Pay within this range varies and depends on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The actual offer will be based on the individual candidate.


\#LI\-RO1

  

**Basic Requirements**
----------------------

* Graduating with a Bachelor's Degree on or before July 2027

**Travel Requirements**
-----------------------

Under 10%
**Relocation Provided**
-----------------------

None
**Position Type**
-----------------

New Grad
**Referral Payment Plan**
-------------------------

Yes
**Our U.S. Benefits include:**

* Incentive Bonus Plans
* Medical, Dental, Vision benefits
* 401K with Company Match
* 10 Paid Holidays
* Generous Paid Time Off Packages
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Paid Parental \& Family Leave
* and more!

  

***EEO Statement***

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally\-protected characteristic.


We are proud of our people\-first and community\-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. Business Development Representative – Intermodal
  
LOMBARD, IL or CHARLOTTE, NC
  
  

Odyssey Logistics moves freight globally for over 6,000 customers — and we're looking for a Business Development Representative who's hungry to build a book of business in intermodal and get paid for every win. In this role you're on the phone, in the inbox, and out on LinkedIn, hunting cold accounts and turning them into qualified meetings for an assigned Outside Sales Representative.
  
  

**What You Bring:**  

* 1\+ years in freight brokerage, 3PL, transportation sales, or a related intermodal/logistics role
* Working knowledge of intermodal, truckload, and/or LTL
* CRM chops (Salesforce or similar) and comfort using ZoomInfo or other sourcing tools to find the right contacts
* A hunter mentality — confidence on the phone, in email outreach, and navigating gatekeepers to reach true decision\-makers
* Ability to identify a prospect's pain point, connect it to our value proposition, and earn the next meeting


**Nice to Have:**  

* A bachelor's degree in business, supply chain, or logistics
* Existing shipper or carrier relationships you can bring with you
* Knowledge of key competitors and how to position Odyssey against them


**What's In It For You:**  

* Base salary in line with your experience level
* Commission eligible — reps with strong numbers can see $80,000–$90,000 in total on\-target earnings
* A running start into a sales career, working side\-by\-side with an experienced Outside Sales Representative
* Backed by an established global logistics company with real operational muscle behind your deals — intermodal, LTL, and FTL operations plus a pricing team ready to move fast


**What You'll Actually Do:**  

* Prospect mid\-market shippers daily by phone, email, ZoomInfo, and LinkedIn, building and maintaining targeted contact lists
* Navigate gatekeepers and administrative assistants to identify and reach true decision\-makers
* Run discovery calls that qualify prospect interest and secure introductory meetings for the Outside Sales Representative
* Work side\-by\-side with your Outside Sales partner and pricing team to turn set meetings into submitted bids and RFQs — then track results through to award
* Maintain accurate opportunity data, activity logs, and lead data in Salesforce.com to support performance tracking and coaching


Ready to help grow Odyssey's intermodal business and get paid what you're worth? We look forward to speaking with you!
  
  

**Compensation \& Schedule Details:**  

**Base Pay Range:** $50,000 to $70,000 \[annual]

**Visit us at:** www.OdysseyLogistics.com/careers

* Choice of medical plans with FSA, HRA and HSA options.
* Vision insurance;
* Company\-paid dental and life/disability Plans;
* 401K with company match;

You are a highly organized, detail\-oriented project professional who enjoys bringing structure, clarity, and follow\-through to complex work. You are comfortable coordinating multiple priorities, maintaining accurate project information, communicating with a variety of stakeholders, and identifying issues before they become larger problems. You take ownership of your commitments, learn quickly, and bring a collaborative, client\-focused mindset to every interaction.


**About The Role**



As a Project Coordinator within the Project Management Office (PMO), you will support Project Managers and Program Managers in the planning, coordination, tracking, and successful delivery of client\-facing technology projects. You will help maintain accurate project schedules, documentation, action items, risks, dependencies, financial information, and status reporting so project teams and stakeholders have timely visibility into progress and emerging concerns. **Job Summary**

The Marketing Coordinator supports the day\-to\-day operations of the Marketing team, ensuring campaigns run smoothly across all channels and stores. This role manages Trello workflows, organizes assets and files, and communicates deadlines to keep projects on track. The person who will excel in this role has excellent attention to detail, and high\-level proofreading/editing skills.

The Marketing Coordinator also acts as a key liaison between the Marketing team, store teams, and creative partners assuring everyone what they need to execute effectively. Additional responsibilities include managing the marketing communications calendar, building and scheduling email campaigns in Alpine IQ, and tracking print production and delivery to store locations.

**Essential Functions and Responsibilities of the job include but are not limited to:**

* Keep our Trello boards tight: update cards, assign tasks, close loops, and follow up.
* Constantly **audit public\-facing assets (website, printed materials, newsletters)** for accuracy, timeliness, and compliance.
* **Track and manage our comms** calendar across channels (email, SMS, IG, in\-store signage).
* Provide graphic designers with content, specs, and promo specifics, based on input and direction from other members of the Marketing team.

* Double\-check promos and **verify deal accuracy** on marketing assets, including the website by adding discounted items to cart.

**Supervisory Responsibility:** None.

**Working Conditions/Environment:** Work five (5\) days in the corporate office. Occasional travel to retail store showrooms, and off\-site events. Exposure to cleaning agents. The noise level in the work environment is usually low to moderate.

new_jobs.title: Event Marketing Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Title:** Events Marketing Manager


**Reports to:** Chief Marketing Officer


**Location:** Brooklyn, NY or Marina del Rey, CA — onsite Monday–Friday


**Who is Flip?**



There are 3 runaway categories in B2B AI — coding, legal, and customer support. We're at the center of the third, with a one\-of\-one market position and hundreds of diehard fan clients, from Under Armour to Tory Burch to some of the largest healthcare institutions in the country.



The market is dividing into two camps: generic tooling\-and\-FDE players building custom agents from scratch, and industry\-specific solutions winning on client love due to speed of ROI. We're firmly the latter. Retail and healthcare alone represent $5B\+ TAMs each, and we're still early.



We built the company on a simple idea: the best way to grow is to have a reference list as long as your customer list. We're a team of 100\+ now, with offices in NYC, LA, and the UK. Many people here will tell you it's the best place they've worked and the hardest they've worked. Both are true.


### **The Role**



Events are one of the biggest ways we grow across the three industries we serve — retail, healthcare, and transportation. From major trade shows and conferences to client experiences (Flippin' Legends), brand activations, and internal company events, you'll own Flip's event presence end to end.



You know the B2B trade show world inside and out, love planning the work and working the plan, and hold everyone around you to the same standard. Our creative and content teams bring the ideas — your job is to execute them exceptionally. Not just done, but done right, on time, and on budget.


### **What You'll Own**


* **Trade shows \& conferences.** Own Flip's presence end to end. Identify the right events across retail, healthcare, and transportation, negotiate sponsorships and booth packages, manage all logistics, and ensure Flip shows up in a way that turns heads and drives pipeline. Retail industry trade show experience is a strong plus.
* **Pre\-event planning.** Build detailed event plans and timelines well in advance. Coordinate across sales, marketing, and leadership to align on goals, messaging, and on\-site experience. Manage all vendor relationships, contracts, and deadlines.
* **Budget management \& ROI.** Own event budgets from estimate through reconciliation, delivering maximum impact within a reasonable spend. Track and report ROI for every event — leads generated, pipeline influenced, brand impressions, follow\-up conversion — and use that data to prioritize the events that deliver.
* **On\-site execution \& team leadership.** Lead the team on the ground at every event. Manage setup, staffing, scheduling, and real\-time problem solving. Ensure every detail is executed to plan and the Flip team is set up to have meaningful conversations and capture every lead.
* **Post\-event follow\-through.** Debrief the team, report results, coordinate with sales on lead follow\-up, and document learnings. Every event should make the next one better.
* **Brand activations, swag \& content.** Partner with creative and content to bring activations to life; source and track event merchandise and collateral; coordinate photo, video, and client interview capture for social and post\-event promotion.
* **Internal events.** Plan and coordinate events for the Flip team — company meetings, offsites, industry parties, and client dinners.

### **What We're Looking For**


* **3\+ years managing B2B trade shows and industry conferences**, with end\-to\-end ownership of logistics, sponsorships, and on\-site execution.
* **Retail industry familiarity is a strong plus** — you know its major trade shows and how buyers show up at them.
* **Exceptional organizational and project management skills** — multiple events and deadlines at once, without dropping a detail.
* **Proven budget ownership and ROI fluency.** You've built and managed event budgets, negotiated with vendors and organizers, and used performance data to inform future strategy.
* **Strong leadership on the ground** — comfortable directing teams and vendors in a fast\-paced environment, and holding partners accountable without losing the relationship.
* **A natural collaborator** who translates creative and content teams' ideas into flawless execution.
* **Relentless attention to detail.** You love a checklist, own every open item, and don't stop until everything is closed out.
* **Adaptable and calm under pressure.** If you're a chaos\-wrangler who brings order to complexity, we want to meet you.

### **More About Us**


* We're international, spanning the US, UK, and Canada
* We've raised \+$30M to date including our recent $20M Series A \- backed by Ridge, Next Coast, ScOp, Bullpen Capital, Data Point and Forum Ventures, as well as founders \& executives from Amazon Alexa, Ada, Attentive, and Simon Data
* We are hiring two Customer Content Marketers in this role; one for our eCom/retail vertical and one for our Healthcare vertical.
* Comprehensive healthcare and unlimited vacation, including a mandatory half week for everyone over July 4, and a full week off at the end of the year
* In office 5 days/week

  



\#FlippinLegend

  

Our customers span the globe, and so do our offices. Flip is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all employees, applicants, and covered individuals regardless of protected characteristics. We want our company to be as diverse and inclusive as our customers.

new_jobs.title: Account Manager, Integrated Marketing
new_jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

Great work rarely falls apart because nobody cared. It falls apart in the spaces between people, disciplines, decisions, and deadlines. The Account Manager, Integrated Marketing is the person who closes those spaces and keeps complex client work organized, connected, and moving.

At Rocket Launch, one client initiative may bring together strategy, advertising, creative, digital marketing, public relations, media, web, social media, production, and a small constellation of outside partners. You will turn approved direction into clear plans, useful assignments, realistic timelines, and unmistakable next steps, so everyone knows what is happening, why it matters, and what they own.

You will work alongside Account Directors and discipline experts, applying the judgment of an experienced agency account manager to spot missing information, conflicting deadlines, unclear ownership, and handoffs that are quietly preparing to become tomorrow's emergency.

We are looking for someone proactive, practical, exceptionally organized, and enjoyable to work with. Someone who understands how integrated agency work comes together, brings calm to motion and clarity to complexity, and occasionally finds a smarter worksheet, cleaner Monday board, or better way to keep everyone aligned.

**What Will You Make Happen?**

* Manage the day\-to\-day coordination of multiple integrated marketing accounts and projects from kickoff through delivery, maintaining clear plans, timelines, milestones, dependencies, approvals, and next steps.
* Partner closely with Client Leaders to translate approved strategy, scopes, briefs, and priorities into organized workback schedules, clear assignments, and coordinated next steps for the right teams.
* Connect the work across marketing, advertising, creative, digital, public relations, media, web, social media, production, and outside partners, making sure handoffs happen and connected deliverables stay aligned.
* Coordinate and facilitate project kickoffs, status meetings, and client working sessions that earn their place on the calendar. Prepare the agenda, gather the facts, identify needed decisions, document actions and owners, and follow through.
* Maintain reliable account and project information and concise status updates so Client Leaders and project teams can quickly understand progress, priorities, decisions, risks, and next steps.
* Make sure assignments are truly ready before work begins, including the objective, deliverables, specifications, source materials, budget parameters, due dates, reviewers, and approval path.
* Manage the routing, review, feedback, approval, and delivery of briefs, copy, creative, web content, media materials, proofs, and final assets without allowing feedback to disappear into the mist.
* Coordinate approved work with printers, photographers, videographers, translators, media vendors, fabricators, installers, freelancers, and other production partners, including quotes, specifications, schedules, proofs, and delivery details.
* Track project scope, estimates, approved budgets, outside costs, and changing requirements. Understand the effect on timing and resources, then raise potential variances promptly with the appropriate Client Leader or business operations contact.
* Stay ahead of the work. Monitor risks, bottlenecks, dependencies, and competing deadlines; offer practical options and raise decisions when they fall outside your authority.
* Make day\-to\-day work easier to manage. When a shared worksheet, better Monday board, cleaner notes system, or simple workflow adjustment would reduce confusion or rework, set it up, recommend it, and help the team use it.
* Be a steady, generous teammate. Communicate respectfully, stay constructive when priorities shift, share what others need to know, and help people leave conversations clear about what happens next.

**What Will You Bring?**

* Four or more years of account management, client services, or closely related project\-management experience in an integrated agency environment.
* Demonstrated success coordinating multiple concurrent client accounts, multi\-channel campaigns, or integrated projects with overlapping teams, deadlines, approvals, and outside partners.
* A working understanding of how strategy, account service, creative development, copy, digital marketing, paid media, public relations, websites, social media, analytics, and production connect during delivery. You do not need to perform every discipline, but you should understand how the pieces affect one another.
* Strong command of agency account and project fundamentals, including briefing, workback schedules, milestones, dependencies, resource coordination, routing, approvals, risk tracking, scope awareness, and closeout.
* Exceptional organization and attention to detail, paired with the judgment to know which details matter most to timing, quality, scope, and the client experience.
* Excellent written communication. Your agendas are useful, your recaps are clear, your action lists identify owners, and your status reports tell people what they actually need to know.
* Confident, tactful verbal communication with clients, agency leaders, specialists, vendors, and partners. You can ask a direct question, surface a concern, and keep the relationship intact.
* A proactive, solutions\-oriented approach. You anticipate needs, investigate gaps, offer workable options, and follow through without waiting to be reminded.
* Experience coordinating creative or production vendors and managing specifications, quotes, proofs, schedules, deliveries, and final assets.
* Practical budget and scope awareness, including the ability to track estimates and outside costs and recognize when a request needs leadership review or a scope adjustment.
* Comfort in a fast\-moving, hands\-on agency where priorities can change, several disciplines may contribute to one outcome, and being unflappable is a genuine professional advantage.

new_jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative – PCBA KING
new_jobs.description:
Outside Sales Representative – PCBA KING

**PCBA KING \| U.S. Field Sales**

**Pay:** $40,000–$60,000 per year

Job Description

PCBA KING is looking for a driven, competitive **Outside Sales Representative** to develop new business and grow our customer base across the U.S.

**This is a true boots\-on\-the\-ground outside sales position.** We are looking for someone who will literally **knock on doors, visit customers and prospects in person, follow up on leads, and hand\-deliver line cards and sales materials.**

This is **not an order\-taking or desk sales role.** We want a hunter who enjoys getting out into the market, meeting customers face\-to\-face, opening doors, and creating new business from scratch.

What You'll Do

* **Visit customers and prospective customers in person**
* **Knock on doors and introduce PCBA KING to new businesses**
* **Visit and qualify leads face\-to\-face**
* **Hand\-deliver line cards and sales materials**
* Prospect aggressively for new accounts within your territory
* Cold call, email, network, and prospect in person
* Connect with purchasing, procurement, engineering, operations, and supply\-chain professionals
* Develop relationships with OEMs, electronics manufacturers, technology companies, and other B2B customers
* Identify customer needs related to **PCB and PCBA manufacturing**
* Generate RFQ opportunities and work with our team to support customer requirements
* Follow up consistently and persistently with prospects
* Build and manage an active sales pipeline
* Turn cold prospects into long\-term customers
* Maintain and grow relationships after opening an account
* Take ownership of your territory and sales results

Who We're Looking For

We want a **true sales hunter** who is:

* Comfortable walking into a business and starting a conversation
* Willing to spend significant time in the field
* Persistent and comfortable hearing “no”
* Competitive, self\-motivated, and results\-driven
* Confident meeting new customers face\-to\-face
* Excellent at prospecting and follow\-up
* Able to build relationships from the ground up
* Organized and capable of managing a territory independently
* Professional in appearance and communication
* Focused on generating new business rather than waiting for inbound opportunities

Preferred Experience

Outside sales or business\-development experience is strongly preferred.

Experience selling **PCBs, PCB assemblies (PCBA), electronics manufacturing services (EMS), contract manufacturing, electronic components, or related technology products** is a major advantage.

Experience calling on **OEMs, electronics manufacturers, engineering teams, purchasing departments, procurement teams, and supply\-chain professionals** is highly valued.

What Success Looks Like

We are looking for someone who wakes up thinking about **where the next customer is coming from.**

You should be willing to get in your car, visit companies, knock on doors, deliver a line card, introduce **PCBA KING**, find the right decision\-maker, uncover an opportunity, generate RFQs, and keep following up until you earn the business.

**Find the opportunity. Open the door. Build the relationship. Win the business.**

How to Apply

Please submit your resume and tell us:

* What products or services you've sold
* Who you've sold to
* Your outside/field sales experience
* The U.S. territory or geographic market you know best
* Your experience with PCB, PCBA, EMS, or electronics manufacturing
* The largest new account you've personally opened

If you're a hunter who would rather be **in front of customers than sitting behind a desk**, we want to hear from you.

**Work Location:** In person / Field Sales

Pay: $50,000\.00 \- $60,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person
